name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I don’t want you to miss this
body:
Dear Peter,

I know I’ve written to you a lot recently about our $125,000 Matching Challenge going on right now.

But with the End of Quarter deadline TONIGHT, this is our last chance!

With everything that’s at stake in November, it’s so critical we hit our goals!

You see, thanks to a VERY generous donor who pledged $125,000 as a Matching Challenge, every dollar you can give to help us with this effort before 11:59 PM TONIGHT will be matched dollar-for-dollar up to $125,000!

DOUBLE MY IMPACT
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/26wwl00ONCQhljfIu2jTbQ~~/AAVkMwA~
!

>> STUDENTS FOR LIFE ACTION’S $125,000 MATCHING CHALLENGE <<
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/yPax0x1LNUAt7Rpq-l1-7w~~/AAVkMwA~

Peter, I want you to know that your prayers give our team the support they need . . .

. . . But it also takes precious resources to organize and mobilize as many students and volunteers as possible to continue our critical Election Year Programs.

That’s why I’m counting on your support to ensure Students for Life Action is able to continue our Election Year Programs like:

• DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING.

Each door we knock on costs less than $3 each. And studies show that nothing makes more of an impact on a voter than a face-to-face conversation. And that impact lasts beyond one election cycle. Voters who are talked to personally in one election are more likely to vote in subsequent elections;

• THE “VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST” DIGITAL CAMPAIGN.

Our “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign runs targeted, survey-style ads to young people aged 18-35 who we’ve identified as swing voters with a low propensity to turnout. We’ve found we can secure a pledge to “Vote Pro-Life First” from these young voters for less than $2;

• CAMPUS OUTREACH.

Our student leaders will host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvassing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride;

• EARLY VOTER & VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS.

The Left holds a big advantage in early voter turnout, which must be stopped. That’s why SFLAction is prepared to target ideal voter bases like mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting; and

• PHONE BANKS & TEXT MESSAGING.

Time-tested methods like peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.

So, will you please consider making a contribution to show your support for Students for Life Action through our $125,000 Matching Challenge
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/lNjIqR2zaZk5ImkC9snQjw~~/AAVkMwA~
?

But don’t forget your deadline is TONIGHT at 11:59 PM, so act quickly!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

clean_body: | | | Hey Peter, it’s Jon Tester. I’m about to take the debate stage against Tim Sheehy, but first I need a quick favor. Mitch McConnell might think this race is personal to him. After all, he’s spending nearly $90 million for the chance to finally replace me with his handpicked candidate. Well this race is even more personal to me. I’m the only working dirt farmer in the U.S. Senate and every day I go to bat for Montana’s values in Washington. I’ll never bow down to special interests or play partisan games. I’m running for reelection because I’m not done fighting for Montana, and I’m looking forward to sharing my vision with all the Montanans watching tonight. But I need your help to make sure our message breaks through. Right now, we’re hours away from the debate and our final end-of-quarter FEC deadline. Our report will go public, and if we don’t post our strongest numbers yet, McConnell will take that as a sign to double down on his attacks. The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

Peter,

It's simple.

We cannot fix Washington without independent, common sense leaders who bring
people together.

I'm running for Senate because Washington is broken, and I'm ready to get
right to work with bipartisan, common sense solutions to finally fix the mess.

But with my race in a deadlock, Marylanders already beginning to cast their
votes, and my final FEC end-of-quarter fundraising deadline just hours away,
pulling off a victory will require all hands on deck.

Can I count on your support before my official FEC deadline tonight at
midnight?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/urgent-request-email-2-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aaej_acs&amtposition=2>

Extreme partisanship and inaction have held us back for too long. Many
Washington politicians simply choose to argue with each other instead of
getting anything done for the people.

With your help, we can send a loud and clear message to all the politicians
in Washington that will be heard all across America this November.

Please consider chipping in your most generous contribution to my campaign
today. We’re running out of time to reach our fundraising goal before our final

Gov. Larry Hogan

A Personal Message from Governor Larry Hogan:

<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aaej_acs&amtposition=2>
Hi, it’s Governor Larry Hogan.

When I launched my campaign for the U.S. Senate, I did so with a deep resolve
to maintain the leadership style and principles that guided me during my eight
years as governor.

Fifty years ago, my father, Maryland Congressman Larry Hogan Sr. made a tough
decision. He became the first Republican to come out for the impeachment of
President Nixon. He put aside party politics and his own personal
considerations and stepped up to do the right thing for Maryland and the nation.

Today, Washington is completely broken because that kind of leadership and
willingness to put country over party has become far too rare. But it’s not in
my nature to sit back and watch the dysfunction continue without doing what I
can to roll up my sleeves and get to work.

I’m under no illusion this will be an easy road. But I’m no stranger to
uphill battles, and I know I can’t do it without your support.

I don't aspire to be a United States senator. I don’t need a title and I
don’t need a job, but I’m more concerned than ever about the direction of the
country and I have become more convinced that I can make a difference by taking
the approach and style of leadership I had during my eight years as governor to
Washington.

It’s no surprise this mindset has made me a target of the Washington
partisans. Despite early polls showing a lead, I know I’m the underdog in this
race. And that’s why your support TODAY is so crucial.

So if you can chip in a donation of $25 or more, it will go a long way in
helping me continue building a strong campaign.
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aaej_acs&amtposition=2>

For eight years, we proved that the toxic politics that divide our nation
didn’t need to divide our state, and we got results! Let’s get back to work
again and send a message to Washington that will be heard loud and clear across
the country!
Will you join me today and help end the dysfunction in Washington?
<https://secure.winred.com/hogan-for-maryland-inc/bio-footer-acs?utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20240930_urgent-request-email-2_aaej_acs&amtposition=2>
Thank you,
Larry Hogan

Thanks to this incredible team we have achieved more than anyone thought was possible. We launched an organizing program earlier than ever, opened more regional offices, expanded our voter protection programs, and have *slight* leads in the key districts Democrats need to take back the U.S. House.
Now, for the final time in this election, I'm asking you to help us keep up the momentum by donating to an FEC End-of-Quarter deadline goal. My personal link is below, I hope to see your gift come in:

body:

## Are you Oppressed or an Oppressor?
---
Peter Ohtaki
---
Generations of kids have been raised on a world view of **Oppressed versus Oppressor** by teaching a counter narrative that **casts Israel (and America) as Oppressors**. In contrast, we grew up learning in school that America and Israel are beacons of **freedom** and **democracy** in the world.
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66fb6d5038f5060874d2295c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fs%2FEthnic-Studies-M-A-18-111.pdf%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66fb53005de6aa4c097df19c%26ss_email_id%3D66fb6d5038f5060874d2295c%26ss_campaign_name%3DAre%2Byou%2BOppressed%2Bor%2Ban%2BOppressor%253F%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-10-01T03%253A32%253A45Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_66fb53005de6aa4c097df19c&l=en-US&s=tclYouZDOpZSGNUuz84QVkI1aA8%3D)
---
| We were appalled after downloading a one-sided lesson on the Israel-Gaza war from our youngest son’s Freshman Ethnic Studies class last November. The slides don’t mention Hamas is a terrorist organization, declared by both the U.S. and E.U.
---
**The slides don’t mention Israel fought for its survival in 1948, 1967 and 1973, and on the 50th anniversary of the 1973 Yom Kippur War - Hamas attacked Israel** I watched as Black September terrorists took Israeli athletes hostage at the 1972 Munich summer olympics, and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) highjacked commercial airliners every few months. On Oct 6, 1973, I was on a camping trip to Yosemite Valley when Egypt and Syria surprise attacked Israel during the Yom Kippur holiday, exactly 50 years before Hamas’ attack on Israel on Oct 7, 2023. They say history repeats itself.**Nor do they mention the Camp David, Oslo and Abraham peace agreements Israel has reached with its Arab neighbors.****Nor do the slides mention Iran, Hezbollah or Houthi** Iranian protestors took 53 Americans hostage in 1979-80 in Tehran as Ayotollah Khomeni arrived from exile. 50 years later, the repressive Iranian theocracy and Revolutionary Guard still chants, “Death to America/Death to Israel” and in 2022, its morality police killed Mahsa Amini for not wearing her hijab properly. Iran is the true bully in the Middle East equipping Hamas, Hezbollah and Houthis. On April 13, the Iranians fired 300 rockets and missiles toward Israel.The news media doesn’t report that **Hezbollah killed 240 U.S. Marines** in Beirut on a peace keeping mission in 1983 during the Lebanese civil war I remember Al Qaeda’s attacks on our African embassies, the U.S.S. Cole bombing while in the Yemeni port of Aden, and finally on America itself on Sept. 11, 2001. In [Ramadi, Iraq, American forces convinced local sheiks in 2006, known as the Anbar Awakening](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66fb6d5038f5060874d2295c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FBattle_of_Ramadi_%25282006%2529&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_66fb53005de6aa4c097df19c&l=en-US&s=CsYaAfly3gpvYFqR8F_AucWbxgE%3D) to reject Al-Qaeda in Iraq (AQI), who would later evolve into ISIS. It took until 2019 for our coalition to defeat ISIS in Syria. [**7,000 American soldiers died fighting the War on Terror and 3,000 died on 9/11**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66fb6d5038f5060874d2295c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FWar_on_terror%23United_States&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_66fb53005de6aa4c097df19c&l=en-US&s=iuVKpSVAouCet7C99jLyuXW1Uaw%3D) \- and now we want to negotiate with terrorists?Oct. 7, 2022 - Hamas attacked and murdered 1200 Israeli civilians, and took over 200 hostages to Gaza. Pro-Palestinian protestors in the U.S. carry signs “By all means necessary” meaning this heinous act of terrorism is morally acceptable, and “From the river to the sea” means the elimination of Israel from the River Jordan to the Mediterranean Sea. It’s horrible that 40,000 Palestinians have died, of which 15,000 are estimated militants. Since Oct 7, Hezbollah has been firing rockets into northern Israel, including killing 12 Israeli children playing soccer on July 28.**Palestinian children are taught in schools to hate Jews and blame Israel for their misery.** Hamas uses Palestinian families as human shields, and many Palesti-nians willingly hide Hamas fighters, and even hold hostages. **Until the Palestinian people renounce the destruction of Israel and reject Hamas leadership, can a two-state solution be realistic.**_Palo Alto Daily Post question to Congressional candidates:_** **_How do you think the United States government should respond to the war in Gaza?_**For our national security, we must stand by Israel against Iran-backed terrorists. History shows this conflict is part of a much broader conflict between Iran, who funds and equips Hamas, Hezbollah and Houthi terrorist armies, all determined to eliminate Israel. The U.S. must act as a deterrent to Iran and Hezbollah to prevent this war from escalating throughout the Middle East.****There’s no question that Israeli and Palestinian casualties are a tragedy. But for a two-state solution to work, Hamas must be replaced with a democratic government in Gaza willing to recognize Israel’s right to exist.** We want teachers to teach controversial issues, but we want them to teach our kids HOW to think, not WHAT to think. The teacher did not follow clear District policy stating both sides are to be taught on contentious topics. The ethnic studies lesson wound up in a 45-minute documentary [Killing America](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66fb6d5038f5060874d2295c&u=https%3A%2F%2Fmanofsteele.substack.com%2Fp%2Fwatch-killing-america-full-movie&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_66fb53005de6aa4c097df19c&l=en-US&s=gH_PwqQyIMk1uqhqE2uPdBG6geY%3D) about the loss of meritocracy in our high schools.

subject: We can’t retreat into our homes
body:
I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.

---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative,
---
| | I'm writing to ask you to stand beside me at the top of a very slippery slope.Actually, in my case, it's a slippery _slide_. My name is Riley Gaines and I'm the University of Kentucky swimmer who had to compete against a fully intact 6'4" _male_ swimmer dressed in a women's bathing suit.And after he stole the victory I had worked for my entire life, I had to go back to the women's locker room and undress out of my wet bathing suit while he did the same next to me.
---
| [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z2sjv5o470if3f7el072ffiba9f1rmkjqs4qum5o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)
---
| | I know the images I'm bringing up are horrible. But please don't stop reading -- because God-fearing, faith-filled people like you and me have a job to do today. We can't retreat into our homes and hope our government's evil culture just passes us by. **[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today -- before it's too late.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zlde058f417102bhnpm20o5bpe4el9se5ea4b9f8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)** My fellow conservative, you know this slippery slide.It's the same one you got pushed down when the Left told you abortion was going to be "safe, legal, and rare."_Now abortion is a "right" and "women’s healthcare." And if you don’t support it up until the moment of birth, you must "hate women."_ It's the same slippery slide you got pushed down when the Left told you limiting gay couples to civil unions was "mean." You were told, "They just want to use the word "marriage" like everyone else. It's just a word."_Now if you don't fully embrace a homosexual lifestyle by displaying rainbows and celebrating gay pride, you're a "hate-filled bigot."_ Enough with their lies. We have Truth on our side. And we need to start acting like it.**God created man. And God created woman. It isn't any more complicated than that.** Letting men believe they are women... letting girls believe they are boys... is a bold-faced rejection of God’s truth. And if we give this deranged movement one more inch, a year from now when you're forced by law to call boys "she"... when it becomes normal for kids to be taken away from parents who oppose this evil... I don't want you looking back with regret wishing you had done something when you still had a chance.**Your chance is right now -- and right by my side.** **[Please stand with me against the radical transgender movement by making an urgent tax-deductible donation today -- before it's too late.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2znjeblb7or1bp6btvpef1f92lpv0tht8cmk03u10_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs) **The radical transgender movement has parents backed into a corner. But when I'm speaking around the country, I meet so many seniors who say, "I wish someone had told me about this sooner." The good news is that right now, you still have a chance to help me stop the radical transgender movement before they push us down their slippery slide.And today I'm writing you on behalf of a group that is doing more work to block the transgender movement than anyone I know. **It's the legal non-profit the Center for American Liberty.** **[And your tax-deductible gift today is going straight to help them.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zm9gf2jt9hf9riasf5gclfukth6al8v9d3ieq6dg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)** With the help of patriots like you, the _Center for American Liberty_ fights the transgender movement _in the courts_ because that’s the only way to stop them. And the _Center for American Liberty_ is attacking this evil from all sides with their comprehensive three-pronged approach.
---
**#1. They're fighting radical schools**.
---
---
**#2. They're fighting radical doctors.**
---
---
**#3. They're fighting for _your_ right to speak out against this evil.**
---
**[**When you make your tax-deductible gift today**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zk2bmq6710ahu7h2ut0lmn50qvqbeq0npj2u93og_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)** , you're helping the _Center for American Liberty_ protect every American's right to speak out against this evil! I know you'd probably love to fund an entire court case on your own after all I've told you.**[But all I'm asking you to do is make a tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 or more today -- before it's too late.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z16b8j9ftjrfmm3h8m8nltpvbd23oakrjjkp1dt0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)** Please donate whatever amount is right for you whether it's smaller or larger. _The Center for American Liberty_ needs and appreciates every dollar that comes in.And because I believe so strongly in the work they're doing -- and because they are one of the few groups who've stood shoulder-to-shoulder with me in this fight... I**t will be my honor to send you my new book _Swimming Against the Current: Fighting for Common Sense in a World That's Lost Its Mind_ as my free gift** **[**when you donate $100 or more to the Center for American Liberty.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zu5ht06pfccqog28ti84ncrrpeorvplld33vaj88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76cjh2bs)** Before I go, please let me share one last thought with you.Every morning as a competitive swimmer, I would get up and think of this verse: _For I consider that the sufferings of the present time are not worthy to be compared to the glory that is about to be revealed to us. Romans 8:18_ I applied it to my swimming: work hard now and wins come later. But now I see that God has a much bigger plan for my life just as He does for yours.Thank you for reading my letter all the way to the end. I'm praying for you, and I hope you'll pray for me too.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Riley Gaines
---

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlmt79lticp0ht0nv52aargc2i7kn1057esvjp9o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76c9h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsd878jmeic8oif9rqj7bf401au3eh30ask93g80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76c9h2bs)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdofs9e0a790rki22j61glhk219s2n344l1df190_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76c9h2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbo2ra3ct1j52fc012sf1qbraug1lo2vq4q86gb8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm6o76c9h2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

1600 Daily

body:

This sponsored message from GOP Presidential is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z9hutuu50m2r86e8n729342kkqtc2k2li4351o80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm1or6cjh2bs)

| |
Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk85rst2mogjlcd64dfkg5u7hrqsat8mkkg2uhao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm1or6cjh2bs)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqt71970jr5as72ri7go3fbi09uv644d8a0h63ho_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm1or6cjh2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf57cgjubh09bh0u6b963ttsdfo7eaac0e3sql30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7ctjm1or6cjh2bs)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

| | | CBS now says it will NOT fact-check candidates during the VP debate this week—even for patently obvious lies. Meaning JD Vance can spew a stream of blatant BS with no pushback whatsoever from the moderators. [**Add your name, and demand CBS reverse this horrible decision.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te3fbe8da-b399-47df-bc0c-9489c71c126a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) What the hell is the point of having moderators if they're just going to sit there and say nothing about obvious lies? CBS says it will be up to the candidates to do it. But it shouldn't be Tim Walz's responsibility to use his limited time to do the moderators' job for them. Worse yet, CBS actually has a "misinformation unit" that will be doing the fact checking and posting it on a blog, where approximately zero people will see it. Why not give this content to the moderators so they can present it to the debate audience during the actual debate? [**Don't let CBS do this unchallenged. Demand they practice actual journalism, fact-check the VP debate, and not let Vance tell lie after lie unchallenged.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7c47fd01-08d1-48e4-9ceb-0306bd4274fe/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e97b1119ce3a433da1d16256065f3bac&_e=V8emNv_xoFeF-HBuNBgZ5pFrqXmdUtoFu0Ekyc0TjjTdRxHtJr0cKpTEOdQ2PRcmM6y_7EIii0jht1eD8MH1LeIv8np0js9c0yuEJmv_-UqKnpZwVYi0hnsBxZuAsS6pHM98rBaaUaPOzgaQlZAImZOWYtJfL2iNebLLzBUELaviNGRB14Lmm71NcKnce86mHknUrWFA7O607hv5YMxMfatmo6aKh5JC3lhpnnoTMBPrULEeIp5bNiGcMeP2cpV_M1XMGLzFsnSTi0uGdpwP1mlCj_ohA5P5Ozj90HHs2iXFylqWykT5ezo0uP9fIFoMCGF6UZur0VIWj_XiJGKm9mj3no_moki6GcymwsbH2KEaghNS4I4CLLMMtYKV5fYqVguqxxMBS5Au6eyPqVECOV7aAPNuDBF7xVR_03V_Yrs%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e97b1119ce3a433da1d16256065f3bac&_e=V8emNv_xoFeF-HBuNBgZ5pFrqXmdUtoFu0Ekyc0TjjTdRxHtJr0cKpTEOdQ2PRcmM6y_7EIii0jht1eD8MH1LeIv8np0js9c0yuEJmv_-UqKnpZwVYi0hnsBxZuAsS6pHM98rBaaUaPOzgaQlZAImZOWYtJfL2iNebLLzBUELaviNGRB14Lmm71NcKnce86mHknUrWFA7O607hv5YMxMfatmo6aKh5JC3lhpnnoTMBPrULEeIp5bNiGcMeP2cpV_M1XMGLzFsnSTi0uGdpwP1ol7YlFZCaM98EOdDNic9eqy-qkonkiulEjqOd8rm7VXKPaFGYLDFVZd4RIub4W0dFKv4MsaVgPd-F_eVxcR8fCH7xlrmxdavFGtgwKGkd-vXPEB2059QhwMVp67kB8GjpELLKJN9xFxyehlAp9Br0g%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8246b3a03370414eaa2a5905bd61c95c&_e=dTPNv0I48cd7zD0jDNwfnVtVWQa_PTHzGPmXukXK6HP-vyAtECfzvtGFvG2sisRspLxkox3n5Urzb0fUK4xrO0xIl7M26vhRmXM_T2zh1ScGHBIXmif-Ow4dn5jnBCLd_jfLeNsQLRs686Xmk4x9facwXnw9DCj7da7DO7Qt4XbHsyK8O8sQdJmzYibZw-50DWJNXyWUmfFbk16yIN88bvWwd6tqY0GJ45rR4KQkb0ivyEkBHYFwZBlb5Pj4t1ZWfRbY1aaXX58H8N1hBy1cbp1-hzVQBon_12eTsX2PbR4AcT1xWHoMu3NH1o0UQcFwqMDrM_j0ecv6xpxDhD9f8LWvAe_Dxe4Odar_LVgY5NaA9V-iX7cX4FpiBa7lBZK_qnB2fHrkfBP4h-Yqn8RScbuLv1aQjU01bO1h5xtOOyU%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8246b3a03370414eaa2a5905bd61c95c&_e=dTPNv0I48cd7zD0jDNwfnVtVWQa_PTHzGPmXukXK6HP-vyAtECfzvtGFvG2sisRspLxkox3n5Urzb0fUK4xrO0xIl7M26vhRmXM_T2zh1ScGHBIXmif-Ow4dn5jnBCLd_jfLeNsQLRs686Xmk4x9facwXnw9DCj7da7DO7Qt4XbHsyK8O8sQdJmzYibZw-50DWJNXyWUmfFbk16yIN88bvWwd6tqY0GJ45rR4KQkb0ivyEkBHYFwZBlb5Pj4t1ZWfRbY1aaXX58H8N1hBy1cbtm0PnE1-Uzjh6o_t_9kgh3mMuin2-CnDP14WX_A11KPlIf7ks03RAeXonR23kMK0MdJs8yg_bIKxJx9zgDIuVDCkwrk0kyA8qgODLJCNfILAG3FyysYW5la5xmPu7reMUBFYjs1BNiq9XLRre_93Gk%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8246b3a03370414eaa2a5905bd61c95c&_e=dTPNv0I48cd7zD0jDNwfnVtVWQa_PTHzGPmXukXK6HP-vyAtECfzvtGFvG2sisRspLxkox3n5Urzb0fUK4xrO0xIl7M26vhRmXM_T2zh1ScGHBIXmif-Ow4dn5jnBCLd_jfLeNsQLRs686Xmk4x9facwXnw9DCj7da7DO7Qt4XbHsyK8O8sQdJmzYibZw-50DWJNXyWUmfFbk16yIN88bvWwd6tqY0GJ45rR4KQkb0ivyEkBHYFwZBlb5Pj4t1ZWfRbY1aaXX58H8N1hBy1cbjpGX9Hoz13qt_gYqMVGD8x_9hV9W6K51Gbq2mvXh7ElL6TUfByupJvpw9vRdkwTevgenwcNUakXpr_S5Qee0nOVRaipi6ldO8AsQetklk1cBJ3e5kc5Cov9vIMHeFO9WA5EZ-jUE5_-twvZ3O0i9OM%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=387a4a528ef94015a2c2526493d61b30&_e=lSeRjv1qhm4p7eoDqXOERfe3SeA3go3F-F9qIxWltylEFTd3hiOGFWrXECRO04Kt80MnidQ39-34C8wSvP-9BzOYItnl76GYufCaYvjIUFjoowQZXvLZBAc3buKD2Nw47PnbExSWZ6UmtQ_Eh8ywGofDggY-9A0wp3krRSW0rXCIJNjj-rwU6E2w0XbAlQJl6Vsw7fNtyu4Q_jkHipqkW6RFAGv2mLjbs0_T70I0y2_unx0OGKb1PKy98zV4FC28NGib34fUBdCrH1zhAkLA705bo6iYt2AcMJVoN2NbEqsuRuYxTx4bYCO-ibf7MHGlqRivW7tz8Tevc8X1lAKXQafZsSC6y-naAbb4HtiMQThoKUH-N8_75v_-Kujjm4S1CKavEoQxh7lqlSGDlUy1i1vxYDezmn2clKfvZ-uxe5c%3D)

Dear Fellow American,

Dr. Arnn asked us to reach out to you. Do you have five minutes to take our survey on the Electoral College? We would greatly value your input.

If so, here is a link to the survey:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=387a4a528ef94015a2c2526493d61b30&_e=lSeRjv1qhm4p7eoDqXOERfe3SeA3go3F-F9qIxWltylEFTd3hiOGFWrXECRO04Kt80MnidQ39-34C8wSvP-9BzOYItnl76GYufCaYvjIUFjoowQZXvLZBAc3buKD2Nw47PnbExSWZ6UmtQ_Eh8ywGofDggY-9A0wp3krRSW0rXCIJNjj-rwU6E2w0XbAlQJl6Vsw7fNtyu4Q_jkHipqkW6RFAGv2mLjbs0_T70I0y2_unx0OGKb1PKy98zV4FC28NGib34fUBdCrH1zhAkLA7xtgWvUeXVh17YVSKpweF4Sw13SobfZOci7PbCLMUjeq_7-20tdq969ZOtwDFejUm-4YfAfspvPwQ---O-yO-_Z4MGpdo3PJFl6VLVoKSB02KdqS2C89zPZYjpOPRDT50qM--9Qcu6T8nxC9QP3AsvU%3D)

** Sincerely,

Hillsdale College**
** \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Larry P. Arnn
Subject: Survey on an urgent matter Friend, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=387a4a528ef94015a2c2526493d61b30&_e=lSeRjv1qhm4p7eoDqXOERfe3SeA3go3F-F9qIxWltylEFTd3hiOGFWrXECRO04Kt80MnidQ39-34C8wSvP-9BzOYItnl76GYufCaYvjIUFjoowQZXvLZBAc3buKD2Nw47PnbExSWZ6UmtQ_Eh8ywGofDggY-9A0wp3krRSW0rXCIJNjj-rwU6E2w0XbAlQJl6Vsw7fNtyu4Q_jkHipqkW6RFAGv2mLjbs0_T70I0y2_unx0OGKb1PKy98zV4FC28NGib34fUBdCrH1zhAkLA7xlxH9KASAUtmGgPiCfv2b3lfIvsAkgKVa5os5ttgWGmp2FAZh1czWIt3LVDldF2GGOLhHIhfzwgZHgi-vVMBS056blSqennnzEHRKn03cyN_F4hXil5VtHYdvvdyqPycP2q-kF-zBm1zWi9MNrCOLs%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

**[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=387a4a528ef94015a2c2526493d61b30&_e=lSeRjv1qhm4p7eoDqXOERfe3SeA3go3F-F9qIxWltylEFTd3hiOGFWrXECRO04Kt80MnidQ39-34C8wSvP-9BzOYItnl76GYufCaYvjIUFjoowQZXvLZBAc3buKD2Nw47PnbExSWZ6UmtQ_Eh8ywGofDggY-9A0wp3krRSW0rXCIJNjj-rwU6E2w0XbAlQJl6Vsw7fNtyu4Q_jkHipqkW6RFAGv2mLjbs0_T70I0y2_unx0OGKb1PKy98zV4FC28NGib34fUBdCrH1zhAkLA7929O7vLANgpqGP7ZhMfkZ_w9rb97vGppa_PnRA3iq60LIUXqoVX3ZCojCpyvkYla5UiJ5mENlU3z0ZdDP9QBp3rqtQ3tveMevibIQclHUoB54KiGrm9_V5UxWoasHF2MEg5MWPZuvjLWdb3KEs838c%3D)**
** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Reclaiming American Freedom
---
_PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522_

## Dockworkers' Strike Shuts Down Major Ports
Dockworkers' strike [shut down major U.S. ports](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAQQH-NvRFxx5c9MHTJlq4dLQxHcg0xFkaJ-u-rdO749Jan93VZLoELb9fP8CDfc11C7PykBaQAgXrRY_KZCEmN5MGhczMY0OPNq8mGlKzOdoUkwcRV5ahcAKXcZOZpZI8SNUgJIKUz8mRNWk0OeaJ5dtHQoCUl7rWdvitv_Ua5_NQntVOsj7H4W-_7MaiPAc8DnsO-0et4qze0zrHQgOe9ti6O3vhOgksQqcb7q7Y7tUOsdOXtEGS0nchZmbUNVpNWiAmcxJVWyA7H5tP-4lL4sG7Q8voIXP4a-v9Hnh5_AwAA___1_mHg) on Tuesday. The 45,000-strong walkout threatens product shortages and higher prices ahead of the holiday shopping season. The White House is urging negotiations but says President Joe Biden [doesn't plan to intervene](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vgzAQQH-NvQWdzyYXBg9d2NK1I_LHOXFrMAIL2n9fpXO3Jz3pSe_jPt1dLnl5vLuZbUt1cqHlgycFF3VBMxkZbWJG1pKtIiQaVK-MfFrSPgTSOmL0QwJkxujJuVvUBIadzBYBjQJQCoB66K599H1y6cbDQKFnYYBjbnXrPmte2pNT-akHb12osyz22dq6C_0mcBQ4nufZeR9eTuC48LkLHN3Wcij8wqCPr7jq7VtRlZuN65lLyfuVhIHH7HL5q7b_Hw-LvwEAAP__GbRUBg), despite warnings from business groups that a strike could cost the economy an estimated $5 billion per day.The International Longshoremen's Association and employer group United States Maritime Alliance are at an impasse over wages and automation at 36 ports that handle about [half of the nation's cargo](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOgzAQRL8GukVrgzEULq6hy7VXIgevgy8mjuwlKH9_IvU1r5jRSE_zc5kvNsTwuH3bjQz7NNuFw4tmgSBAdnNXO-OJJLU1GaGl1qNQoqtX016Vt5aGQfeorRZ9Ny7eKRzUFb3ubR2MRNkJRCEQtcKmV-7c-IHGUS-Kqg7JBU65-U3hwSv5-E4vys2StjqalflZqvarklMlp-M4mkw7Uy5nfyYpR1fJaS8fANnCsKSTz5QZCudwJ4gpbQV4p-LsG47AKzwSsI33AmVZye2RHJyqgCO0WMmpzsY9jxBjKL2uOrxtNsSPFf__0cvIvwAAAP__GzdqDQ).Many retailers have rushed to import holiday merchandise early, but a prolonged strike would disrupt supply chains as the Christmas season approaches.
## U.S. Sends More Troops to Mideast

| | | Trump went on a fully unhinged tirade at one of his recent rallies, calling Kamala Harris "mentally impaired," "mentally disabled," and a "stupid person." These attacks are disgusting, untrue, and offensive – and Republicans need to hold him accountable. A few Republicans, including former Maryland Gov. Larry Hogan, have called out Trump for these personal attacks – but more need to step up now. If they care even a little bit about this country, our elections, and common decency, they need to grow a backbone and stand up to Trump – and make it clear that this behavior is unacceptable. ## AT&T Selling DirecTV
Dallas-based AT&T is [selling its 70% stake in DirecTV](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00DGPtCAQxvFPgx0GxlGwoHgbu33bKw3CqCS4bmCie9_-stdf9yS_4kn-X4_54VNOz-2_P8jxez1nHzhdNGsltQScsYluUXHUDTltwBjba9TN7sLSa4s0mECxszZY7HuL3TJqi2r1a5McKECtlNaqHzpsQY3BDmSXUaMF0wtUFBOfpeWdmN6-rvn7vKi04Tya7HbmVxXdPwGTgOm-7zYs9Ul3_biA6TMFTJ4ly5gKBb5k9ZmkkYNcUs7pfEp-bTKmusuDykZFwNQUF1_3h-tgBKrt8Cn_XvIfBS4HPwEAAP__23RdhA) to private equity firm TPG for $7.6 billion, exiting the subscription TV market to focus on its wireless 5G and fiber optics businesses. The move follows its 2021 sale of a 30% stake in DirecTV to TPG for $16.2 billion. AT&T [acquired DirecTV for $48.5 billion](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOozAQgOGnMZ3RzNhgKFxcQ5drr0QOHoJ1Bkd4RJK3X-322__Sr-_fbb6FlNPx-Bt29vJeyxwWSRfPCBo12dk20d8hjtiwR0fODR1abDYPbuwdY3SG1t4as3IXBkeWKIxkzdIkT0AWARCh641tCcZl6Hm4j2gHcp2ywDFJOVvZWPgd6po_5eKzXcreZL-JPKsyfxRNiqY1HeFYuP2ErZTvQtF08KsqmkRXzrlqB7pK-M86ppMXuTQCGRiMce0me25OH5-vlHOqvVMWHntI-eclv9AvT18BAAD__3DaWTw) in 2015. AT&T has struggled to grow its base of TV customers in the face of stiff competition from over-the-top services like Netflix and Hulu that provide programming over an internet connection. In a separate deal, DirecTV said it will [acquire competitor Dish Network](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb8Gd1jDmBgoKF7jLq_d0sJAYlbYWDCyk79fZfstr650dHS-7vPdpZz253-3RUuvR5mdp3TGWQAXHOUsu2AXCEZ00QqFSumbkKJbbfDGyMegALTQRstxUcYrhUEjeBVElywCSgEgBNzGQfYIxusx6sUIqVHdmIQYEpXa0xopvlx75Hc5Y-192bpsV6KjseEfw4nhdF1X7_fFf06G04fNcALDcBqA4RT9Whq5yqnwFnPmIbX1M0Kq0dPJfdmWtKf9yTf3XSo_3JvTyY9azhRibf1KW-6qDceVck5tVEzCc3Mp__rQH3lOiz8BAAD___kJZr4) and its Sling TV service for $1 plus $9.8 billion in debt.
## Flock Cameras Hit Over Privacy Issues
The Texas Department of Public Safety [issued a cease-and-desist order](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGuozAQAL_GdEbexcFQuLiGLtdeiRx7HawzGLEOJH9_uvSvn5FG8-c-313KaXv-divZ-o5ldr6mk2ZQEiTqWTfBPlQYoSELBo0ZbqChWaxH1eFotAYXA3QdxehVBEWmj0GTaZJFhRqUAlC3vtMtqtEPPQ2PEfSA5ia0opBqOdq6UKW345g_5aSj9WVtsl1q3Vl0vwROAqfrutpY3tgv5cW1bP8hgdNGFwucvroMO0umLUhPjkkG4sRVxlz8X8kuUv1I71Y6nNyPdLpKcikrsXy8OG3ExNwcNuxXyjlxb4RWz9Wl_O2pP-w5Lf4LAAD__0LhaoM) to surveillance company Flock Safety for installing their products at residences and businesses while operating without a private investigator's license. The company's automatic license plate readers are [used by law enforcement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL_u3CAQhJ8Gd5yAwwYXFGnc_dKmtNaw2KtgY5nV_Xn76K5PO6MZffr-_Mw_QIWO9TfsGPiV6wyR6YGzVlJLY2fbpbCoNOoOg3bGOd9rq7stxOzU4nw_eFg8RoXqriA6VEYv0ffQUTDKWK2U1qof7vZm1Bj9gH4ZtfXG9cIqTMT1uvGGjC9oubzrA69brHtXwsZ8NnH_JcwkzLTVmgod-CmFmT7fwkxqFGb6bmU6m0y4w5Ga3KCw5CpzqfGvbJCR37KeeAFTPZqEJxA3WSji0ehYJeyUZLxoR5lp3fiTYc714ibM1F0hnU8qhdrghFXrDlS-lPwfaY9g_gUAAP__Ah9wxQ) to solve crimes but have raised privacy concerns. "They've implemented a massive program of spy cameras to track the movements of every law-abiding citizen that passes by a camera," said Baytown resident Bryon Schirmbeck, who filed a complaint with DPS in May. Flock Safety says its technology is used by over 300 law enforcement agencies across the state and is [working with DPS](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdEbrxYApXPwNXf72SmTsBawzGMGGJG9_SqQrrxppNCN9-r5uw83FFLf5v1vJ8nPKg_McLxoUSCVRD7oIdoTQqYKsarFtTa20KhZLELpqglobcGiwraChseu8HmuslTFFtAioFYBSUDeVLhE6bxoyY6e0wbYWGihEzkfJCzE93TmlV77oKH1ei2QX5v0U1T-BvcA-bmcMdJRzvpj88t4I7D83gf1Gj3cE2t3BK20s8yT3-5iil6ebiF9yv_Mpp5T992-TN7lljp6Kw4b9EVOKZ9MKDfPqYvpQ8B9SLos_AQAA__89NGWT) to obtain the required certification.
## Coast Guard Seizes 900 Pounds of Illegal Fish
The U.S. Coast Guard seized 900 pounds of [illegally caught red snapper](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vwyAUAH8N3mzxnjEfA0MXb-na0SL4OUYiBgGy0_76qtk7n3Qn3ddtubkQw_H4dE-y7bWlxfkWTlqA99CjWES32jtfDXRkQaFSegIB3W7vUm0aYPNaCz8aSSjJoRNSgnaT1l2wyFEA5wB8kqMYkBuvJem7AaFRTUxwWkNLZWg7NXq5usXvdFIZfHp20e6t5crGD4Yzw_m6rsHvJR1_lOF80FUZzq604CMxnN-G3idXW18PlzOVvlL4obUHo_loDAx5z12xa75CjKFKxQR_PF2I72L7Z8Bp8TcAAP__S5JcrQ) and shark after intercepting five boats in the Gulf of Mexico on Sunday. Twenty-three Mexican fishermen were [taken into custody](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LHO2yAQAOCnwdtZxwUbe_DwL95SVV06RgQOG4mYiCNx2qev1P1_g0_f7-vt6lJOx_bDPXhpn1huzrf05ptG0EDmZrqw3DHMuuNFW7J2GrTR3b6g9Tg7ex_maIdpojhOBtkZG6MbA_suLYRkNKLWOIwX0xPOfhp5us_aTGQHZZBDaqX2befGHycx_ylvrr0vjy4ve2tPUZcvRaui9TzP_uBT-pf4rX-krGj9WVkEfnFmJyyK1q_aks-saL3MhBeNilZfnDTYXq4GSEfjGpJvAgNkd_jdga98CginvywwI8KzvI4gUCKknHlzGWKSHUqM0PijaO3qEp5nyjnJaJXB7eFS_o9u3xy-F_oXAAD__1aHdHw) and transferred to Customs and Border Protection officials. Prized for its flavor and texture, the red snapper is a bottom-dwelling fish that averages between 2-4 pounds but can reach up to 50 pounds. Prior to last year, when Mexico joined an international treaty to combat illegal fishing, roughly 40% of the country's red snapper catch was harvested illegally.

When I turned 15, I got a job at a local doughnut shop. **It was hard work, but it's what my family needed to make ends meet.**

While I was a teen making minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, Rick Scott was an owner.

**For me, the doughnuts represent a lifeline that helped my family afford rent. ****For Rick Scott, they represent the beginning of his private corporate career.**
I went on to graduate college and become the first South American immigrant ever elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to oversee the largest Medicare fraud in the nation’s history, amass a fortune of hundreds of millions, and buy a Senate seat.

body:
Biden and Harris’ response to Hurricane Helene is part of a disturbing pattern
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hello friends,
The liberal media is going out of its way to ignore a critical story that exposes Secretary of State Jena Griswold’s attempts to mislead Colorado voters. From the truth about remote WiFi access in Douglas County’s voting system (and likely others), to the issues with undeliverable ballots and postal problems in 11 counties, to concerns over the security of drop boxes statewide, there’s a lot at stake.
Meanwhile, they have enough time to battle it out with me on [X/Twitter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over their attendance at the press conference I conducted on this topic. A huge thank you to [Mandy Connell](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Dan Caplis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), and [Jeff Hunt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (I'll be on this AM) for having me on your shows to tell voters the truth!
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, October 1, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Biden and Harris’ response to Hurricane Helene is part of a disturbing pattern](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TOWNHALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Hurricane Helene dissipated over the weekend, but not before smashing into Florida’s Big Bend as a category four storm, inflicting “biblical” damage across the southern United States. After landfall, the heavy rains led to catastrophic flooding that’s killed almost 100 people so far. In the Newport area of Tennessee, about 60 miles outside Knoxville, residents were forced to scramble after the Waterville Dam failed.
And where’s Biden and Harris throughout this crisis? It’s part of an unseemly pattern with this administration: when disaster strikes, everyone runs away. A train derails in East Palestine, Ohio—the Biden White House drags their feet. Severe wildfires strike Maui, the deadliest in 100 years, and it takes Joe forever to get out there. Joe’s mind is applesauce. Kamala is too stupid to know what to do—and the rest of this government is stacked with incompetents and other invalids. Meanwhile, there are reports that hundreds of thousands of people in Ashville, North Carolina, could be without access to water for weeks.
Yes, this is a campaign issue because we have an administration that can’t do disaster response.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado’s bold move to ban oil drilling sparks national debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [OILPRICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado lawmakers have proposed legislation to ban new oil and gas drilling permits starting in 2028 and require existing wells to pause production for five months annually, sparking a nationwide debate.
* The move, seen as a potential model for other states, faces strong opposition from the oil and gas industry and some lawmakers.
* Colorado is a significant oil producer, ranking fourth in the U.S., and the state's crude output has grown substantially in recent years.
* The outcome of Colorado's proposed legislation could influence the future of U.S. energy production and environmental policy as more states consider similar restrictions.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Fort Carson training medical personnel for potential of large-scale European war](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Fort Carson is training military medical personnel from six countries to meet NATO standards for large-scale war scenarios, focusing on seamless patient care and coordination across nations.
* The training is crucial for ensuring consistent medical standards across NATO countries, particularly for evacuations and field hospitals in the event of a major European conflict.
* The training emphasizes speed, standardization, and self-sufficiency in treating injuries under combat conditions, including handling drone attacks while providing care.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Mesa County focused on stopping the spread of zebra mussels threatening water supply](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Zebra mussels threaten Mesa County’s water infrastructure, agriculture, and local economy with rapid reproduction and clogging of irrigation systems.
* First discovered in U.S. waters in 1988, these invasive species disrupt aquatic habitats by stripping water of nutrients.
* Local officials are raising awareness and planning a copper treatment this fall to combat the infestation. The mussels could severely impact Mesa County’s irrigation-dependent agriculture, especially orchards and vineyards.
* Residents are urged to report sightings and assist with the treatment by running their water systems during the scheduled treatment.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Student-led election forum at Liberty Common H.S. will feature three state House, Senate races](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Liberty Common High School is hosting a student-led debate featuring seven candidates from House Districts 52, 53, and Senate District 14 in the Fort Collins area.
* Candidates include Steve Yurash (Colorado Center Party) and Yara Zokaie (Democrat) for House District 52, Andrew Boesnecker (Democrat) and Donna Walter (Republican) for House District 53, and Jeff Brosius (Libertarian), Cathy Kipp (Democrat), and Phoebe McWilliams (Republican) for Senate District 14.
* The event will allow attendees to ask candidates questions, and it will also be livestreamed via Liberty Common’s YouTube channel.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Jefferson County candidates offer views on budget, housing, metro districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jefferson County Commission candidates debated budget priorities, housing, and metro district reform.
* District 1 candidates presented differing views on county spending, with some advocating for cuts and others focusing on essential services.
* District 2 featured incumbent Andy Kerr and challenger Natalie Menten, clashing over fiscal policy and housing affordability.
* Key priorities included crime, wildfire preparedness, and tax cuts, with varying approaches to affordable housing and government transparency.
* Proposals for proportional representation and metro district accountability were also discussed.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Donald Trump: Kamala Harris would ‘decimate’ social security and medicare](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump claimed that Kamala Harris would "decimate" Social Security and Medicare if elected, urging voters to support him to protect these programs.
* Trump criticized Harris for avoiding discussions on Social Security and Medicare, linking her policies to the inclusion of migrants and rising costs.
* Trump emphasized his support from working-class voters, including Teamsters union members, citing their discontent with Harris and her policies.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Dills: Along with America, Alex Clark is waking up to the lies of ‘big food’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY ABI DILLS, [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I am grateful to Alex Clark and others like her who have taken on the fight against the food lies we’ve all been fed for years._
_When I was 12 years old my parents decided to try a gluten-free diet. Within weeks, my dad’s indigestion disappeared, both parents lost weight, and they were free from muscle pain. Although they were in their mid-30s, they felt better than they had in years._
_They were astonished but also confused. Why had no one suggested this to them before? Why was our food made with such harmful ingredients?_
_My parents had always been relatively healthy, but from that point on, our family embarked on a journey into health and wellness. We stopped eating fast food, began researching vitamins and supplements, and started uncovering the lies that government was, quite literally, feeding us._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Securing Colorado’s elections: United Sovereign Americans to champion integrity in ’24](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | SEPTEMBER 27** _By law, if there are more than 21 errors in an election, the results aren’t reliable enough to certify. The Help America Vote Act (HAVA) sets this threshold: one error per 125,000 ballots._ __
**[Sloan: The long arm of Beijing into American politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY KELLY SLOAN | COMMENTARY | SEPTEMBER 26** _When Alger Hiss, a well-placed official in the U.S. State Department, was revealed to be a Soviet spy in the late 1940s, it shook Congress (and the American public) hard enough for them to take the matter of Soviet penetration of U.S. governmental entities seriously._
**_[A race with no candidate: 7th Judicial District attorney Seth Ryan withdraws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | SEPTEMBER 26** _Citing a nationwide shortage of attorneys and an inability to hire and retain them, along with for political and personal reasons, 7th Judicial District Attorney Seth Ryan, a Republican, is resigning._

Friend --
First and foremost, let me thank you for bearing with the barrage of FEC deadline fundraising requests.
At this point in the race, our campaign is funded primarily through small-dollar donations, so hopefully you see them as a small price to pay for holding this Senate seat and helping Kamala Harris win in Michigan.

Now you may be thinking, what does the vice presidential debate have to do with Michigan's Senate race? That's a fair question.
To start, everything that impacts the presidential race also impacts Michigan. A big night for Tim Walz (here's hoping) is also good news for us. A bad night for him, and that's likewise bad news for us.
It would not be the first time a debate had a major impact on this race.
But also, these debates tend to be motivating factors for those who pay close attention. More people volunteer to knock doors on days like this. More people donate as well.
Depending on how the debate goes, it could be good for my opponent. But because we have always received lots more small-dollar donations than he has, I am hoping it can be a big advantage for us.
Voting has started. The election is upon us. And we still have some big goals to reach.

[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5)
---
**Why the Trump Knife Collection Stands Apart:****8 Distinctive Knives, Each Telling a Story** This collection is thoughtfully[ designed to commemorate pivotal moments from Trump’s presidency](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5). * **Razor-Sharp Stainless Steel Blades** : Each blade is forged with precision, ensuring durability and a sharp edge, reflecting the steadfast spirit of American craftsmanship.
* **American Craftsmanship** : Designed and forged in the USA, each knife is a testament to American quality, pride, and tradition.

---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5)
---
**A Showcase of Elegance: The LED Display Case** The collection comes complete with a **[custom-designed wooden display case](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5)** , made from premium cherry wood and featuring a shining gold strip with a hinged glass cover. The addition of **eight built-in LED lights** enhances the beauty of each knife, casting a soft glow that captures the essence of this elegant tribute.
* **Protective and Elegant** : The hinged cover provides easy access to your knives while ensuring they remain protected from dust and wear.
* **Showcase Presidential Pride** : The display case is adorned with a raised golden medallion, inspired by the American presidential seal, making it a stunning centerpiece for any home or office.

---
[](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5)
---
**An Heirloom for Generations** This collection is more than a tribute to Trump’s presidency—it’s an heirloom piece that captures a moment in history with elegance and pride. Each knife's patriotic theme is carefully chosen to resonate with the values that define America: freedom, strength, and resilience. Displayed together, they create a narrative that will be admired for generations. **What Our Collectors Are Saying:**
* **“The detail and craftsmanship are unparalleled. Each knife is a conversation starter, and the display case elevates them to a true work of art.” – Lisa M., Verified Buyer**
* **“I’ve never seen anything like it. Each delivery brings a new piece of history to my collection, and the quality is outstanding.” – Tom L., Verified Buyer**

**Secure Your Place Among History’s Collectors** The **Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection** is available for a short time. With each knife delivered monthly, anticipation builds until your set is complete. This isn’t just about owning knives; it’s about curating a piece of history. **[CLICK HERE TO CHECK AVAILABILITY AND ORDER YOUR SET](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/18695/6374453/60574c739a64fa3f6fa46acf06052479553a55f2/deba137f19d2c346d377b535cb43b89f55b681e5)** Sincerely,

name: Ted Cruz
subject: Two sides of the same coin.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michelle Steel for Congress
body:
They sacrificed everything to escape communism. Now it’s our turn to continue their legacy.

| |
---
| | | Hey, Friend, it's Ted Cruz.

_I 'm reaching out to you today to tell you two quick stories._
The first one is about the man I admire most in this world - my father. He fled communist Cuba after being imprisoned and tortured and came to Texas with just $100 to his name. He got a job washing dishes for 50 cents an hour and learned English before attending the University of Texas at Austin. He sacrificed everything to get to America and find a better life for himself, and I am so proud to be his son.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2ziuinlbp4pcd6u5vprpkne3nke3ofnovmq8ngcl0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c3g64p72c5h2bs)
---

The second story I want to tell you is about my dear friend, Michelle Steel. Her parents escaped communist North Korea and moved to Seoul, Japan, and finally to America in search of a better life for their children. Their courage to leave everything behind and flee a communist regime gave Michelle the opportunity to experience her own American Dream, and not a day goes by where she takes their sacrifices for granted.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z03upjrfi634v5gej7119b6ifdakhigbhe8smjr0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c3g64p72c5h2bs)
---

Our stories are two sides of the same coin, Friend. Our parents fought and clawed to escape communism, and we honor their battle every day in office by ensuring we keep those same principles far away from our shores.

But the hard truth is, right now, Democratic leadership is more focused on ensuring their entire radical agenda gets passed than standing up for what is right. **They 've bowed down to these regimes and allowed their threat to our nation to grow rather than do what is necessary to keep Americans safe.**

It's truly disgraceful, Friend, and if the Left wins the House this November, no one will be able to stop them from continuing down this path. _Simply put, me and Michelle 's fight to defend the values that our parents sacrificed everything for will be over. _

But there is good news. The #1 seat the Democrats need to flip to take the Majority is Michelle's, and if we can give her a huge boost tonight, we'll be able to hold them accountable for their actions and push back against their agenda.

_**[So please, Friend, will you contribute anything you can spare tonight to make sure Michelle can continue this important fight?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zcnb4eiiiuev35hngc0f79nff5ju2adr89lqi74o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj7c3g64p72c5h2bs "So please, Friend, will you contribute anything you can spare tonight to make sure Michelle can continue this important fight?")**_

Thank you and God Bless,

Ted Cruz

For too long, extremist Republicans like Scott have co-opted the protection of personal liberties as a top priority — **but if we're honest with ourselves, the only "freedoms" he's fighting for in Congress are his own, trying to:**
* Control women's private medical decisions

* Prevent seniors from retiring with dignity

* Get even richer off the taxpayers' dime

**Scott's understanding of "freedom" begins and ends with himself and his ability to do, say, and spend _anything_ to convince voters otherwise.**
But because of grassroots supporters like you, we're finally busting his monopoly on the airwaves and letting voters know that they deserve better.
As Florida's next senator, you can count on me to fight for everyone's freedom to live as they choose — and not as extremists like Scott demand.
