* Heinrich [voted against](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=fb744e3d9a&e=780129cd82) funding to crackdown on illegal fentanyl smuggling along the Southern border and voted against efforts to provide $300 million for U.S. Customs and Border Protection narcotic and opioid detection efforts.
* In August 2022, Heinrich was the [deciding vote to kill](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=5fd276c8da&e=780129cd82) an amendment that would provide $500 million to ICE for narcotic and drug detection.

INCENTIVIZING ILLEGAL BORDER CROSSINGS
* Heinrich twice [voted against](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=714736440d&e=780129cd82) implementing the “Remain in Mexico” policy.
* Heinrich voted twice against continuing Title 42, the program allowing immigration enforcement agencies to quickly expel illegal immigrants.
* Heinrich has [voted repeatedly against](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=674d54d285&e=780129cd82) Kate’s Law, which would set mandatory minimum imprisonment for deported felons who illegally re-enter the United States.
* Heinrich [opposed](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=1029e3c4fc&e=780129cd82) the Laken Riley Act, legislation that would prohibit migrants who are “charged with, arrested for or convicted of burglary, theft, or larceny” from receiving “any immigration status of benefit.”
* Heinrich has [repeatedly voted against](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=032c824ef6&e=780129cd82) blocking funds from dangerous sanctuary cities and even [praised](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=0be0b5b762&e=780129cd82) sanctuary policies on Twitter.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The United Nations has teamed up with Mexico to SUE American gun manufacturers for the out-of-control crime in lawless Mexico.

Not only are they suing, but they’re DEMANDING a ban on production of semi-automatic AR-15 and AK-47-style weapons.

And this case has the backing of the Biden-Harris Administration!

But we still have a chance to stop this this madness in its tracks – **[if you’ll agree to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court by signing your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM immediately](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=1d7jrejhi5qwq3e1pg4lxhelhhuep5rjolfaulq1trk43en7eham7hiis1a5es2302w18fqd0209qk2dunxk9vzizpnnwerg1xgnl9ih7w3rmcddwhzxbxbopyrqeb00373mxdyxg14i4ccrwa4yowe2aak1n81uznqtzz3ih8fega8evgult8l7dcpl1go1l2ynv14pe&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skoj7t&__onlt=h)**.

Please read Dudley’s Brown’s email below about this dangerous UN-Mexico lawsuit against U.S. gun manufacturers. And take action!

**Sincerely,

The Hon. Rand Paul
U.S. Senator (R-KY)**

* * *

Dear Fellow Patriot,

With the full backing of the United Nations and the blessing of the Biden-Harris Administration, the country of Mexico just filed a court case that could finally impose the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on America.

If successful, this lawsuit would effectively allow foreign dictators to dictate gun policy in the United States – _resulting in the swift death of our Second Amendment freedoms_.

You see, Fellow Patriot, Mexico – a country that’s signed on to the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” – is mad that disarming law-abiding citizens across their country has resulted in violent drug cartels controlling up to 35% of the country (_according to a 2022 U.S. Senate resolution_).

Instead of blaming their own draconian gun laws (_as they should_), they’re suing U.S. gun manufacturer _Smith & Wesson_.

But not for any __AMERICAN LAW__ any of Smith & Wesson broke...

**Mexico is suing this gun manufacturer for supposedly “allowing” the guns they’ve built to be trafficked into the hands of Mexican criminals...**

**...As if there was any way a firearms manufacturer could have predicted their firearms would be illegally trafficked!**

That’s not all: Mexico is also asking the courts to _BAN the production and sale of AR-15 and AK-47-style rifles_.

_And the Boston-based First Circuit Court of Appeals just announced this case can proceed!_

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please sign your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name presented before the U.S. Supreme Court to help me stop this madness IMMEDIATELY](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=1d7jrejhi5qwq3e1pg4lxhelhhuep5rjp01t42lr5yx6l3d3165z7ztyp9o8zo4vprmtjbjz6xaxi0qxlvkcq8307e3nqi9p3zxoxmsyu8kcki68qe3zxeha54fny0oc8ivl50258t2azjykshoebxkpcve1zlnwh66sbp4fdohwqj8y9u278stwbwulqt6gi22eeawfj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skoj7t&__onlt=h)**.

As you’ll see, this _CIVIS DIRECTIVUM_ – Latin for “Citizen’s Directive” – demands that the United States Supreme Court: **1)_Immediately dismisses the case_** , forbidding it from proceeding to trial; **2)_Sends a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message_** that _NO FOREIGN ENTITY_ will ever have standing to file lawsuits related to our Second Amendment freedoms in U.S. courts. PERIOD. Because if they don’t, it won’t be long until the United Nations gets their ultimate wish – which is the power to control the United States and our gun laws though the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty.”

And make no mistake.

**That’s what this new legal assault is really all about**.

In fact, after this case was filed, two separate UN-affiliated entities filed _amicus curae_ briefs with the First Circuit.

And the United Nations’ Office on Drugs and Crime issued a statement: _“This case exemplifies the illicit nature of a firearm transfer in circumstances in which weapons could be used to commit human rights violations, which fits into the broader trend of engaging the concept of complicity in developing legal standards for corporate accountability.”_ This is right out of the UN “Small Arms Treaty” playbook!

Following the Tenth Conference of State Parties in August, the United Nations has laid the groundwork to FORCE: *****_ALL firearms manufacturers who seek to export firearms to ask for permission and report on how they believe the guns they sell will be used_.**

The UN ultimately wants final say on whether any firearms transfer should be allowed. After all, they know guns in the hands of the “wrong” people is the biggest threat they face toward imposing their brand of one-world socialism around the globe; *****_ALL Treaty countries to allow firearms manufacturers to be sued for crimes committed with their products_.**

Imagine how outrageous it would be if Ford was sued because an F-150 owner ran a red light and caused a crash! That’s what the gun grabbers want to do with firearms because they know this could END gun manufacturing; and *****_That ALL countries involved in the export of firearms – including the United States – establish a “National Control System_.” **

This is nothing more than GUN REGISTRATION, plain and simple – the first step toward outright GUN CONFISCATION. Now, Mexico is demanding that arms manufacturers provide them with full information on every gun sale! And this case out of the First Circuit Court of Appeals shows how serious they are about forcing the UN’s “Small Arms Treaty” on the United States – _especially while they still have a puppet in the White House_.

The fact is, President Biden took an oath to “defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.”

_But he’s said nothing as his anti-gun allies in the First Circuit are rolling out the red carpet for a FOREIGN COUNTRY – with the complete backing of the United Nations – to start hacking away at our Bill of Rights_!

As the Defendants in this case stated in a recent court filing: _“Mexico’s brazen attempt to regulate the American firearms industry based on its foreign interests poses a grave threat to the sovereignty of the United States, its citizens, and their Second Amendment rights.”_ But Joe Biden and Kamala Harris couldn’t care less – so long as it results in less freedom for you and me!

And while Mexico is blaming U.S. gun manufacturers for “allowing” guns to fall into the hands of drug cartels, _part of me wonders if it’s Biden’s ATF that’s truly to blame_.

You probably remember how, during the Obama administration, the ATF launched Operation Fast and Furious, where they stood by silently, allowing guns sold in the U.S. to be illegally trafficked to Mexican gangs – _until U.S. Border Patrol agent Brian Terry was killed with one of those guns_.

**Would you put something like this past this President, or even his potential predecessor – who would be the two most lawless, anti-gun Presidents in American history**?

That’s why I’m counting on your IMMEDIATE action.

The good news is, even as I write you, National Association for Gun Rights’ attorneys are drafting a hard-hitting _amicus curae_ brief for the United States Supreme Court, insisting the Court: >>> Bars this case, which is currently residing at the U.S. District Court in Massachusetts, from moving forward to trial – and; >>> Sends a clear message that ANY and ALL foreign entities will forever be barred from filing lawsuits in American courts that seek to undermine our Second Amendment freedoms. But I’m counting on you to make sure we’re heard.

And the more signatures I can gather for this **[CIVIS DIRECTIVUM](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=1d7jrejhi5qwq3e1pg4lxhelhhuep5rjp099b6weff89gr6k9sz07r2omt0nu86lce0kyysvp5okp2cssenuuiu3e6hn902i5bop7n0pejg2z1wb8avbu01liz78rnbsqy0za8tayj0t74vtp2wl2z4aeqy20cxz30krd35czsjnl68rl5xqlzljzqzld41zf1vm2o19r&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skoj7t&__onlt=h)** , the louder our message will be when tens of thousands of American gun owners have their names read before the U.S. Supreme Court.

Yes, Fellow Patriot, this case should be an open and shut one.

_After the Supreme Court’s 2022 _Bruen_ decision, how could they possibly even think of siding with Mexico on this case_?

Well, that’s not really my fear...

My fear is that Chief Justice John Roberts twists enough arms on the Court to “punt” the case, allowing Mexico’s lawsuit before U.S. District Court in Massachusetts (_an extremely left-wing court_) to work itself out – with the intent of just getting to it later.

Since this case touches on international trade – something the Supreme Court typically avoids – I’m concerned that’s what the Court will do.

_And that’s exactly what the Biden-Harris Administration and their pals are banking on!_

They know court cases like this can often take YEARS.

**And by the time it comes back around to the Supreme Court, it may not be as friendly to our Second Amendment as it is now**.

That may happen sooner than you and I would like to believe . . .

_After all, the radical, anti-gun Left has been threatening to pack the U.S. Supreme Court ever since President Biden’s election_!

**[That’s why I’m counting on you to please fill out your CIVIS DIRECTIVUM to have your name read – along with tens of thousands of other American patriots just like you – before the U.S. Supreme Court IMMEDIATELY](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=1d7jrejhi5qwq3e1pg4lxhelhhuep5rjp0t2mm66tlhobcyftd4p76z27aaqp49s44drnulrvb1mg52mk0amzwj7oxzn33ir7d3pfnw53ybqn6l62wldq78na5x58z26wnto7sj81ok9cns099f5ramlg9s2pthbmhcqef6zvwl3vr89af4ychumx8f03cisc0ldnltbs&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skoj7t&__onlt=h)**.

Of course, in a perfect world, I wouldn’t have to ask you to do this...

But that’s not the one we live in.

_After all, you’ve heard how judges rule on the law and never take into account public opinion_.

But how many Supreme Court decisions can you rattle off the top of your head where justices got it completely backward?

The reason is that there are many judges who like to stick their fingers in the air to judge which way the political winds are blowing before they pick a side.

Worse, they often make those decisions based on what they see in the media and the swamp elites they rub shoulders with...

Fellow Patriot, it’s this bubble you and I have to break through.

**[That’s why your signed CIVIS DIRECTIVUM – along with a mountain of other signatures from Second Amendment supporters just like you – can help make all the difference](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=1d7jrejhi5qwq3e1pg4lxhelhhuep5rjp0aghpdw66urx22ac1xc6k7e4iot80nittti0runc8bzn7q5r912e9omj0rmj7bk9egqro3iqnwblopyitrfmqqzrzl21kqic0k0cbodrei29uov5t1nebtmi4m2c95ducupgv7wrb0h3a83qszgu30zv2k0spd9z0s8xyk50&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=skoj7t&__onlt=h)**.

But I hope you won’t stop there.

Given the stakes in this battle, I hope you’ll consider giving generously as well.

You see, to make the biggest and LOUDEST possible impact at the Supreme Court, I need to alert Second Amendment supporters across the country to this threat.

Needless to say, that won’t be cheap.

But we have no choice.

The UN is NOT going to stop with destroying our Second Amendment freedoms, Fellow Patriot – as if that wasn’t bad enough.

| | | | Hey folks, Tonight’s vice presidential debate between Tim Walz and JD Vance is set to be a pivotal moment in this election cycle. While VP debates are often lower-stakes, this one carries a lot more weight as both candidates are key figures in shaping their parties’ populist messaging. Walz, Kamala Harris' running mate, has the opportunity to solidify Democratic positions on issues like economic policy and civil liberties, all while reinforcing the Democrats’ strategy of painting MAGA Republicans as extremists. Walz's “everyman” appeal — from his upbringing in rural Nebraska to his career in education and service in the Army National Guard — gives him an edge in connecting with voters. His natural authenticity contrasts sharply with JD Vance, whose rapid political transformation from a Trump critic to a MAGA loyalist may leave him more vulnerable in the debate. Expect Walz to lean into his record of public service, support for unions, and successful social policies in Minnesota, while exposing the hollowness of Vance's newfound populism, which often hides a deeper allegiance to corporate interests. [**_Tonight is a chance for Tim Walz to show voters who the real champion of the people is — and with the stakes this high, it could be a defining moment for Democrats as we head toward November. Let’s rally behind Walz and use this debate to push forward in our fight to send Trump and MAGA packing for good._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uxo6b-f6x6rv-kyd76rh7/)

September was a busy month for our campaign—as you probably know from all our emails!

And thanks to your support, we exceeded our goal for the end of the quarter. To say I’m grateful would be an understatement.

In a district this close, and in a race that Republicans have made a top target, that’s a big deal.

These goals really make a difference—every donation makes a difference, no matter the dollar amount. And I know how hard it is to donate your hard earned dollars to a political campaign—so thank you for believing in me and supporting this campaign.

Today marks 35 days until Election Day. We have a lot of hard work ahead of us and there’s a lot at stake this election year.

I don’t say that to scare you Derek, I say it because we can’t slow down for a single second. Western Pennsylvania needs a leader who will fight for us day in and day out, not someone who wants to roll back our rights and undermine our democracy. But that’s what we’re up against in this race.

I’m so proud of this grassroots team and what we accomplished over the last month, but I’m here to remind you that we can’t let up—not now. In fact, we have to fight harder than ever.

Thank you for standing with me Derek. Now let’s get the job done,

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this conservative news alert from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source in Illinois that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
Judson University’s World Leaders Forum Welcomes Former Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper to Suburban Campus This Week (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/judson-universitys-world-leaders-forum-welcomes-former-canadian-prime-minister-stephen-harper-to-suburban-campus-this-week.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0173e4d782-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Prime Minister Stephen Harper speaks about the Trans-Pacific Partnership trade deal at a press conference in Ottawa on Monday, Oct. 5, 2015. (Nathan Denette / THE CANADIAN PRESS)
By Illinois Review

On Thursday, Judson University’s World Leaders Forum welcomes former Canadian Prime Minister Stephen Harper to its Chicagoland campus for its annual WLF event which raises funds for student scholarships.

Harper, the founder of the modern-day conservative movement in Canada, served as prime minister from 2006-2015 – the longest of any conservative PM leader since 1891.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/judson-universitys-world-leaders-forum-welcomes-former-canadian-prime-minister-stephen-harper-to-suburban-campus-this-week.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0173e4d782-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
A strong advocate for free trade and open markets, Prime Minister Harper led a government that focused on simple growth-oriented economic policies and results-driven social policy. Under his leadership, Canada reduced federal taxes to their lowest level in 50 years, created 1.3 million new jobs, balanced the budget while making critical investments in healthcare and infrastructure, attracted new investment and fostered innovation.

During his time as PM, Harper was a vocal critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin’s aggressive and expansionist foreign policy, particularly Russia’s invasion and ongoing occupation of parts of Ukraine. He openly expressed concern about the erosion of transparency in Russia, the consolidation of political power, and the suppression of dissidents. Prime Minister Harper led the global call for sanctions against Russia, and was the first to call for Putin’s expulsion from the G-8.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/judson-universitys-world-leaders-forum-welcomes-former-canadian-prime-minister-stephen-harper-to-suburban-campus-this-week.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0173e4d782-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Judson – a well connected university, hosts the WLF (https://www.judsonu.edu/world-leaders-forum/main-event/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=0173e4d782-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) each year to raise money for Roeser student scholarships and Judson’s RISE Program – which is a unique program designed for students with intellectual disabilities. Less than one percent of colleges and universities around the country offer a program similar to RISE.

Over the last decade, the WLF has hosted leaders including former U.S. President George W. Bush, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Soviet Union President Mikhail Gorbachev, former Mexican President Felipe Calderon, Queen Noor of Jordan, Ambassador Caroline Kennedy and retired U.S. Army General David Petraeus.

To purchase a ticket for the event, please visit

name: Jill Stein for President
subject: Outrageous changes to student loan debt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Biden-Harris turn their backs on people in debt

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, Have you heard the outrageous news about draconian changes coming to student debt? Last year, the Biden-Harris administration allowed all pandemic-related student loan relief to come to a crashing halt. But those with student loans were given a year to start their re-payments without the risk of devastating consequences such as default and reporting to credit agencies. Now those payments, which have been accruing interest all year, must be paid - and if they’re not, people struggling with student debt can see their credit scores tanked. This puts their ability to own or even rent a home at risk, and even jeopardizes their job prospects!
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ads?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=fundraising_10_1_am&n=1)
---
We’ve already seen evictions skyrocket to record levels since pandemic-era protections were pulled out from under renters. Now we’re looking at the potential for record numbers of people in student debt - many of them young people - being punished by predatory creditors for nothing more than striving to better themselves and their lives with a higher education. Our government never has a problem coming up with billions to pour fuel on the fire of wars around the globe, catapulting us towards WWIII. But when it comes to the needs of the American people, from education to housing to medical care, the Wall Street parties throw us to the merciless “free market”. It doesn’t have to be this way.

Jill and Butch believe that higher education shouldn’t be a privilege for the few; it should be a right for all who seek it. A Stein/Ware administration will cancel all student debt for 43 million Americans burdened by that debt. | | Dear Fellow American,

Are you enjoying your _Imprimis_ subscription?

Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most interesting conservatives each month?

I hope so.

You will never have to pay for _Imprimis_ because we want its message in defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many citizens as possible.

We're grateful that you read _Imprimis_ , and we hope you share your copy with others after you've read it--and that you encourage others you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale relies on a nationwide network of supporters--people like you--to help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and strong national defense.

You're a longtime _Imprimis_ subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our country.

And you understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate the American people about our founding principles of liberty...the importance of reviving limited constitutional government...the need to defend the rule of law...and the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free enterprise.

**[That's why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale College.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b985809431284a8ca5a8b2db492008ef&_e=hBGSxKOvnFUpzTE-aK3MV-klQkpLkUYZK6f-IOZ7sd0vHwMZNZtTp8Ksw_u7oSZ7c7DdbdFQdMS8kCSTo6SjlXxSM436_ugVmC6jboIfuDciCeBU86iVPTlE4BgLYazE7m_T4fgWea8CYWb_-1wYHmzo-rkkKS0eIBP8X7OpP_cXjY1CnA2Ib5jIesAzsVgSjqlusjzLBV2nYaTr3szOLQv-P38w0VVQCFFhO9vtif6rbEWHB9I7CT8B9qwEo_-i0G6tRfQege4aOiU5OAhIAs6Yo9vHFYFwo_wM7uDiZxLvr2xouymN6tm4qONyV6ANVW5Zkpp25mpE1j_mZ99ufaCUJxCYQjCO5N6KBiMjbYfCVydcgvXvrnJO60Ye7KE2dyEb4SRD7R9oreoFU9PNgA%3D%3D) **

Other colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural relativism and the oppression of "political correctness"--Hillsdale has not--and it continues to fulfill its mission of defending civil and religious liberty through education.

**Will you help?**

In addition to sending _Imprimis_ to more Americans, you will help us...

* Teach Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American Heritage, the Great Books, and more through **free online courses (to date, more than _4 million students_ have registered for one or more courses)**;

* Launch and support dozens more **classical K-12 schools** nationwide--schools where students receive an education rooted in the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands more are on waiting lists.

Your support is especially needed today because **Hillsdale College does not accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. We refuse to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

body:
| | | | STANDING UP WILL COST YOU
---
---
| Friends, Sunday morning at church I was talking to a gentle lady who is a prominent successful business owner in Virginia. I had found out weeks ago that my two future daughter-in-laws used to work for her business when they were teenagers and looked forward to speaking with her and making the connection. I was super excited that she lived right here in Appomattox and now we were attending church together. As I shared with her my story of why I had to leave Chesterfield, I could sense her compassion as I shared with her the highlights of political persecution that I had endured for years, that ended with the girlfriend of a former disgruntled aide falsely accusing me of assault and battery when I was simply trying to cast a vote. It was lawfare used to try to take away my ability to carry a gun. To this day, this aide continues to follow me.
Watching the persecution of President Trump as they came after him personally, politically, financially, to include multiple failed assassination attempts, has hopefully opened your eyes.
President Trump is not alone. Other politicians including myself have also suffered persecution for taking a stand against the political establishment.
I have a history of standing up for you. While my political adversaries dismiss the claims saying, I'm just trying to get attention, you should ask a question.
Did they accept the covid mandates in 2020 or did they stand up and fight for your individual rights?
Did they defend President Trump when he correctly claimed that the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen or did they just go along with Liz Cheney who tried to instead prosecute and imprison those standing up for our Constitutional Republic?
Did they stand up for you when it wasn't popular to do so and when they would face personal persecution?
You can count on me. I've stood up for you in the past, and you can count on me to stand for you in the future.
---
|
---
---
---
---
---
|
# MY FAITH IN JESUS
---
|
# WHY I STAND
---
| My faith in God through Jesus is central to who I am. It doesn't mean I'm perfect, but through all of the trials, persecution and struggles, it's my faith that I turn to and from which I draw strength during the good times and the more challenging times.
I accepted Jesus into my heart when I was in the 2nd grade. As a young teen and young adult my relationship with the Lord became more personal. I felt compelled to go on several missions trips and while in college at Virginia Tech was very involved with Campus Crusade for Christ, which is now called Cru.
It was during my college years that I began to study the Bible and my faith strengthened. I remember spending my spring break in Daytona sharing the gospel of Christ with people on the beach.
As a young adult who worked full time in management in the finance and banking field, I spent some week nights and weekends visiting people who had visited our church and led several small group Bible studies.
As a young mother, I left corporate America to raise and homeschool our 4 children under a religious exemption statue. It was then I began to volunteer for the Family Foundation and led various programs and coops for homeschool families seeking opportunities for their children. It was also then that I began to volunteer for various political campaigns for conservative Republicans.
One thing lead to another and my volunteerism lead to serving as campaign staff, political director and even campaign manager for various federal, state and local elected officials.
Ultimately, I would run and win a state senate seat, overcoming a 28 year incumbent. I served in the Virginia Senate for 8 years from 2016 to 2023, until I was "defeated" by 375 mail-in and early votes out of 22,000 votes, in which my campaign was denied overseeing of the early voting machines.
I contested the race, but was ultimately ignored by the Virginia State Board of Elections and the Republican Party of Virginia. We sought justice legally, but we were ignored. The people of Senate District 12 were disenfranchised but no one had the boldness to investigate our concern, despite our best efforts to fight the injustice. It was a frustrating experience but at the end of the day I trusted the Lord to ultimately bring justice.
Many of you have heard me say the Holy Spirit is my GPS. That is true.
Like many of you, I too get distracted and take the longer route because I wasn't paying attention. However, my heart is to put God first every morning, listen to His voice and follow the path that He has laid before me through doors that I believe He opens and closes. While I believe my loss was nefarious at best, it was a door God closed. And one I had a hard time accepting because of the appearance of cheating.
I've had former employees who had worked for me in the past and been good to literally stab me in the back. They accepted money from other elected officials who I had challenged on various policies to betray and defame my good character and reputation. They came after me politically, professionally and personally. A Richmond General District Court judge granted me a protective order against one employee who continues to follow me to this day.
Why? Because I wasn't popular with the other politicians. I wouldn't just go along to get along. I took a stand.
Life begins at conception, not 15 weeks, for starters. I refused to approve a Health and Human Resources Cabinet member because they refused to reverse Governor Northam's position regarding healthcare providers ability to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
I refused to rejoin the Republican Senate Caucus until the leader resigned because he had introduced bills to increase taxes and even introduced a gun control bill. I could not in good conscience sit under a leader who was introducing bills only a Democrat would introduce. Standing came at a cost.
I had my committee assignments taken away, my seniority taken away and my seat moved to the farthest side of the Virginia Senate chamber and my colleagues . All in an attempt to shame me into submission.
No matter what they did to me or said about me, I chose to stand.
---
|
# TAKING A STAND DURING COVID
---
|
# REFUSING TO WEAR A MASK
---
| During Covid, I refused to wear a mask. As a result, the Senate staff built a plexiglass wall around my desk. I referred to as my "Wall of Freedom."
Overnight, we saw America become a socialist nation. Our basic ability to breathe was now being governed by an overreaching tyrannical government.
Even the manufacturer of the masks printed a disclaimer stating the masks did not protect people from the spread of viruses. In fact, it was later proven that masks actually cause harm and increase a person's chances of contracting a respiratory virus.
I introduced many bills to make it illegal for employers, educators and even small businesses from violating our civil rights. These decisions of body autonomy we could determine for ourselves. I called on the government to stop restricting our ability to work, get educated or simply perform everyday activities like shop and visit the doctor for simply refusing the experimental jab.
I introduced legislation that would allow doctors to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid.
---
|
---
| Our Constitutional rights were being violated and I had to take a stand, no matter the cost. Wearing a mask or not should have been a choice, not a mandate.
---
|
---
| My colleagues complied with the mandates. I did not. I was both isolated and ostracized by my colleagues for standing. The Senate Clerk staff put my desk at the back of the room in a far corner. They tried to break me, but I stood strong.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, I was running for Governor. During the day I would serve in the Senate of Virginia. In the evenings, I campaigned across the state. No mask. No vaccine. People were desperate for someone who would stand up for them under the Constitutional mandates.
---
|
---
| Here's a picture of the Virginia Senate in 2021, during the height of Covid. We were forced to meet at the Science Museum of Virginia so that we could comply with social distancing mandates, which we've now discovered were a hoax and nothing more than political science.
---
|
---
| During the height of Covid, who stood up for you? Who fought the unconstitutional mandates? I did. And it came at a cost.
---
|
---
| Who can you count on to stand with you in the future? Who has had the courage, fortitude and history of standing with you in the past?
Standing wasn't easy. Even comedian Jimmy Kimmel mocked me nationally for refusing to wear a mask. They wanted to break me, but I stood strong in the midst of isolation, being mocked and ridiculed.
I continued to challenge the mask and vaccine mandates. They were making decisions based on political science, not science. Today, 4 years later, we know know the truth.
You can count on me. I've stood with you in the past. I will stand with you in the future.
---
| | [WRIC INTERVIEW](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001W171YbJM-CHqmNbuqHniQIw1PNpW3dXBE5TrVsXDUJZzOaNxGyWnTqYRnwMNFZ4pBy0pEqQXnXfRnPeGECGQwjJrBpB2Yb5QUsgqPWpsaR9eAdyybBMwFyile-z2JUeOSYTBl1L-sGzyeMGzuLxK_DE5RAm3gQObcLtdDFrL6T4GR7BLLhJRHck21pupWNhe0eewlNB5pwOMooIqEJKklz4_QWGy1gTQIpqAgqB_lrEUe1d6Xfwqd7cB4h5Jea-C&c=BnVbxAdqmesiR19Ff8jeV2cxBytWcuzfzjEEYqMEmM8INTZuNb_yQg==&ch=CzZQXMMAY9eAsla1xAqO5Qe8b0qFPmtczpMaCPpFK9H60skF97yxNg==)
---
|
# I STAND FOR MEDICAL FREEDOM
---
| I did not get the jab. And I fought for your right not to get the jab. The government should not mandate an experimental "vaccine."
---
|
---
|

---
|
---
| Dr. Sheila Furey, the President of VAMFA Virginia Medical Freedom Alliance and I worked very closely together on legislation that I sponsored to push back against onerous and unconstitutional mandates.
---
|

---
|
---
| Pictured: Dr. Robert Malone, Senator Amanda Chase and Dr. Paul Marik.
Dr. Robert Malone was the inventor of the Covid vaccine. Although he took the jab, he later withdrew his support and is now actively exposing the truth about the side effects of the vaccine, to include death.
Dr. Paul Marik spoke as a subject matter expert on several of my medical freedom bills. People want choice not mandates.
---
|
# STANDING FOR THE 2ND AMENDMENT
---
| Many of you heard me speak at the 2020 VCDL Legislative Day at the Capitol when there were well over 50,000 gun loving Virginians who arrived in Virginia.
You can trust me to protect your gun rights. To me it's personal. You can trust me to stand up for the 2nd Amendment.
---
|
---
| | [LISTEN HERE VCDL 2020 RALLY](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001W171YbJM-CHqmNbuqHniQIw1PNpW3dXBE5TrVsXDUJZzOaNxGyWnTqYRnwMNFZ4pk-jP7jFxTBJE5z95V5nc04_oVmlipZEDghmNioW1OVvcib5X75PR6qCn9gkBLu5pS_D85XV5ZFkDJ1jc9LFRkrdtsuGgPOPvlZb7SUlJ3spQ4VkyqsAuANc35YVkN-he&c=BnVbxAdqmesiR19Ff8jeV2cxBytWcuzfzjEEYqMEmM8INTZuNb_yQg==&ch=CzZQXMMAY9eAsla1xAqO5Qe8b0qFPmtczpMaCPpFK9H60skF97yxNg==)
---
|
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Some politicians say that they support the 2nd Amendment. I have both a public history and legislative record of opposing gun control. Action should trump rhetoric. I've actually introduced legislation to repeal the gun control laws that the Democrat controlled General Assembly passed in 2020.
---
|
---
| After I was assaulted on multiple occasions on Capitol grounds, I decided to open carry. It worked. The national protestors that flooded our state capitol finally stopped laying hands on me. I believe with all of my heart that guns save lives. I also believe an armed society is a polite society.
---
|
---
|
---
| Many have taken this picture out of context. My team and I were standing on Bank Street in front of the Virginia Capitol in Richmond with hundreds of pro-2nd Amendment supporters from all walks of life.
---
|
---
| July 4, 2020, I was asked to be speak at a Pro-2nd Amendment Rally in downtown Richmond at our state capitol. I was told it was too dangerous to go. Both Antifa and BLM were supposed to be there. My security team and I made the decision to go anyway. Keep in mind the Richmond Police and just been demoralized by Democrat Mayor Levar Stoney. This picture was taken in the streets of Richmond.
---
| The Democrat Trifecta of 2020 passed scores of gun control legislation like one gun a month, universal background checks, red flag laws and gun free zones could not be created by localities. I spoke out against these bills that were a violation of both our U.S. Constitution and our Virginia Constitution. The Democrats controlled the Virginia Senate, the Virginia House and Governor Ralph Northam was Governor. Legislatively, there was nothing we could do. We didn't have the votes. So I chose to go public and expose to the American people what the Democrats were doing.
---
|
---
Bloomberg and others nefarious actors were dumping millions of dollars into Virginia. It was an all out war on our 2nd Amendment rights. While I knew we didn't have the votes, I chose to be creative and get vocal.
---
---
| To implement socialism, I knew they would first come for our guns. And they did. Instead of protecting individual rights for people to protect themselves, the Democrats were more interested in protecting the criminals, including violent offenders.
---
|
---
|
# STANDING UP FOR INNOCENT LIFE
THOSE WHO CAN'T SPEAK UP FOR THEMSELVES
---
| The Pro-family, non-profit group, The Family Foundation issues a legislative scorecard so that Virginians can see how their legislator scores on pro-family issues.
For my entire 8 year legislative career, year after year from 2016 through 2023, I received a perfect score of 100%.
You can trust that I will stand for life, because I have a voting record you can trust. Not just my words.
---
|
---
| Life begins at fertilization. Even 98% of scientists agree. I introduced a Life Begins at Conception bill. The Senate Rules Committee refused to make a motion to vote up or down on the bill. If they voted for the bill, they would have to agree that life begins at conception. If they voted down the bill, they would oppose the opinion of 98% of scientists.
---
|
---
| I've been honored to speak at Family Foundation organized pro-life rallies at the Virginia State Capitol. After SCOTUS overturned the Landmark Roe vs Wade Case, CNN asked for an interview. I'm not afraid to stand for life.
---
|
---
---
---
| | [CNN INTERVIEW after DOBBS DECISION](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001W171YbJM-CHqmNbuqHniQIw1PNpW3dXBE5TrVsXDUJZzOaNxGyWnTtuO4S06VKA4uqH4jYPmcFd1QV1r0CWkJoOSuwkPsMEiOUvF18QoPQKmgodQpoqHNCK0tQn8Q2QxS9apzyiDJBVoxqaw_ytg58Yp8nhKds13&c=BnVbxAdqmesiR19Ff8jeV2cxBytWcuzfzjEEYqMEmM8INTZuNb_yQg==&ch=CzZQXMMAY9eAsla1xAqO5Qe8b0qFPmtczpMaCPpFK9H60skF97yxNg==)
---
| I led the effort in the Virginia Senate to defeat the so called Equal Right Amendment, a failed amendment that was resurrected from the 70s. The false claim was that it should be passed to give women equal rights and codify it in the Constitution. The real agenda was to promote gender fluidity, a concept that seemed so foreign until today. I was an outspoken leader against the so called Equal Rights Amendment.
Listen as I speak against SJR 284 on the floor of the Virginia Senate.
---
| [](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001W171YbJM-CHqmNbuqHniQIw1PNpW3dXBE5TrVsXDUJZzOaNxGyWnTqYRnwMNFZ4pFeimHm1HkxIijx22BMLpCvuTl7YpvYFR60ScVv-do--FiO5D4nGSy-HPUvIxqd6zFSLNFpg40wNOvsXZUAQmqAZ7fMwVhZ_H&c=BnVbxAdqmesiR19Ff8jeV2cxBytWcuzfzjEEYqMEmM8INTZuNb_yQg==&ch=CzZQXMMAY9eAsla1xAqO5Qe8b0qFPmtczpMaCPpFK9H60skF97yxNg==)
---
| I've worked under two Democrat governors and one Republican governor. There are different strategies that have to be used for each. Under a Democrat governor, we know pro-life legislation will not pass. So do we continue to introduce legislation even when we know it will not pass?
I believe that we should and I do. It's important that we put legislators on the record so that voters know how they will vote when we do have the votes and it does count.
---
| |
---
| |
---
| The late Virginia Senator Eva Mae Scott (R-Amelia) and I speak at a press conference organized by The Family Foundation against the so-called Equal Rights Amendment.
---
|
# STANDING UP FOR SECURE ELECTIONS
MAKING SURE YOUR VOTE COUNTS
---
| | When voters in my senate district went to cast their vote in 2020, many said that they couldn't vote because someone had already cast their vote for them. I was determined to investigate and get to the bottom of this, despite efforts to be shamed into not questioning the 2020 Presidential Election results.
---
|
---
| I flew to Arizona to witness the first ever full forensic audit so that I knew what legislation to introduce in Virginia. Clearly there was a national effort to steal our elections and what they were doing in Arizona was happening all across the country, but only Republican controlled legislators were able to investigate. I worked very closely with the Arizona legislature. My hope was to have a full forensic audit right here in Virginia, but the legislature was completely controlled by the Democrats. So I sought to expose what was happening across the country, and eventually right here in Virginia.
---
|
---
| Pictured: Arizona State Senator Wendy Rodgers, Senator Amanda Chase, Representative Mark Finchem and Senator Sonny Borrelli.
---
|
---
| The Voter Confidence Restoration Act was just one of many bills that I introduced to put the guardrails back on our Virginia elections and restore voter confidence in our elections. While my goal was ultimately a full forensic audit of the 2020 election, I knew that wouldn't happen with a Democrat controlled legislature. So, I led the effort to simply go back to our Virginia Election Law best practices prior to covid, back when we required photo ID to vote, we had an election day instead of an election season and there were no drop boxes.
---
|
---
| While in South Dakota at the Mike Lindell Cyber Symposium I founded the National Election Integrity Caucus for legislators across the country. Together we worked on and shared legislative ideas and bills to assist with our election integrity efforts.
---
|
---
|
# STANDING UP ON JAN 6
---
| I was there on January 6. But I did not go into the nation's Capitol. Many of us believed the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen and joining the protest at the Capitol in DC with President Trump to exercise our First Amendment right to free speech and to contest the election results. We were counting on Vice President Mike Pence to do the right thing. Unfortunately, he did not and his political career is over. I stand up for true election integrity. As a result, I was censured by the Virginia Senate with 3 Republicans joining.
---
|
---
|
---
|
#

---
|
# STANDING UP FOR SAFER COMMUNITIES
LOCKING UP VIOLENT CRIMINALS
---
| Over the past 8 years, I have introduced legislation to support our law enforcement to include the Law Enforcement Bill of Rights. I voted against repealing qualified immunity.
---
|
---
---
---
|
# YOU CAN TRUST ME TO STAND
---
| When you are considering who you are going to support for State Senate in District 10, (Appomattox, Amelia, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Powhatan, Hanover and the Shady Grove precinct in Henrico) ask yourself who has the experience to start on Day One?
The Republican Mass Meeting to fill Senator John McGuire's seat will likely occur this December 2024. The General Election will likely occur on January 7, 2025, the day before session begins.
I am the only candidate running for state senate who will be able to hit the ground running on Day 1.
In addition, you know that I'm pro-life, pro-gun, pro-school choice, pro-medical freedom, pro-election integrity because I have a history of fighting for you and have a voting record you can trust.
I have 8 years of experience as a Virginia Senate. Plus I have an 8 year voting record you can trust.
Today, I humbly ask for your financial support and your vote.
---
|
---

clean_body: | | | | STANDING UP WILL COST YOU | Friends, Sunday morning at church I was talking to a gentle lady who is a prominent successful business owner in Virginia. I had found out weeks ago that my two future daughter-in-laws used to work for her business when they were teenagers and looked forward to speaking with her and making the connection. I was super excited that she lived right here in Appomattox and now we were attending church together. As I shared with her my story of why I had to leave Chesterfield, I could sense her compassion as I shared with her the highlights of political persecution that I had endured for years, that ended with the girlfriend of a former disgruntled aide falsely accusing me of assault and battery when I was simply trying to cast a vote. It was lawfare used to try to take away my ability to carry a gun. To this day, this aide continues to follow me. Watching the persecution of President Trump as they came after him personally, politically, financially, to include multiple failed assassination attempts, has hopefully opened your eyes. President Trump is not alone. Other politicians including myself have also suffered persecution for taking a stand against the political establishment. I have a history of standing up for you. While my political adversaries dismiss the claims saying, I'm just trying to get attention, you should ask a question. Did they accept the covid mandates in 2020 or did they stand up and fight for your individual rights? Did they defend President Trump when he correctly claimed that the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen or did they just go along with Liz Cheney who tried to instead prosecute and imprison those standing up for our Constitutional Republic? Did they stand up for you when it wasn't popular to do so and when they would face personal persecution? You can count on me. I've stood up for you in the past, and you can count on me to stand for you in the future. | | MY FAITH IN JESUS | WHY I STAND | My faith in God through Jesus is central to who I am. It doesn't mean I'm perfect, but through all of the trials, persecution and struggles, it's my faith that I turn to and from which I draw strength during the good times and the more challenging times. I accepted Jesus into my heart when I was in the 2nd grade. As a young teen and young adult my relationship with the Lord became more personal. I felt compelled to go on several missions trips and while in college at Virginia Tech was very involved with Campus Crusade for Christ, which is now called Cru. It was during my college years that I began to study the Bible and my faith strengthened. I remember spending my spring break in Daytona sharing the gospel of Christ with people on the beach. As a young adult who worked full time in management in the finance and banking field, I spent some week nights and weekends visiting people who had visited our church and led several small group Bible studies. As a young mother, I left corporate America to raise and homeschool our 4 children under a religious exemption statue. It was then I began to volunteer for the Family Foundation and led various programs and coops for homeschool families seeking opportunities for their children. It was also then that I began to volunteer for various political campaigns for conservative Republicans. One thing lead to another and my volunteerism lead to serving as campaign staff, political director and even campaign manager for various federal, state and local elected officials. Ultimately, I would run and win a state senate seat, overcoming a 28 year incumbent. I served in the Virginia Senate for 8 years from 2016 to 2023, until I was "defeated" by 375 mail-in and early votes out of 22,000 votes, in which my campaign was denied overseeing of the early voting machines. I contested the race, but was ultimately ignored by the Virginia State Board of Elections and the Republican Party of Virginia. We sought justice legally, but we were ignored. The people of Senate District 12 were disenfranchised but no one had the boldness to investigate our concern, despite our best efforts to fight the injustice. It was a frustrating experience but at the end of the day I trusted the Lord to ultimately bring justice. Many of you have heard me say the Holy Spirit is my GPS. That is true. Like many of you, I too get distracted and take the longer route because I wasn't paying attention. However, my heart is to put God first every morning, listen to His voice and follow the path that He has laid before me through doors that I believe He opens and closes. While I believe my loss was nefarious at best, it was a door God closed. And one I had a hard time accepting because of the appearance of cheating. I've had former employees who had worked for me in the past and been good to literally stab me in the back. They accepted money from other elected officials who I had challenged on various policies to betray and defame my good character and reputation. They came after me politically, professionally and personally. A Richmond General District Court judge granted me a protective order against one employee who continues to follow me to this day. Why? Because I wasn't popular with the other politicians. I wouldn't just go along to get along. I took a stand. Life begins at conception, not 15 weeks, for starters. I refused to approve a Health and Human Resources Cabinet member because they refused to reverse Governor Northam's position regarding healthcare providers ability to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid. I refused to rejoin the Republican Senate Caucus until the leader resigned because he had introduced bills to increase taxes and even introduced a gun control bill. I could not in good conscience sit under a leader who was introducing bills only a Democrat would introduce. Standing came at a cost. I had my committee assignments taken away, my seniority taken away and my seat moved to the farthest side of the Virginia Senate chamber and my colleagues . All in an attempt to shame me into submission. No matter what they did to me or said about me, I chose to stand. | TAKING A STAND DURING COVID | REFUSING TO WEAR A MASK | During Covid, I refused to wear a mask. As a result, the Senate staff built a plexiglass wall around my desk. I referred to as my "Wall of Freedom." Overnight, we saw America become a socialist nation. Our basic ability to breathe was now being governed by an overreaching tyrannical government. Even the manufacturer of the masks printed a disclaimer stating the masks did not protect people from the spread of viruses. In fact, it was later proven that masks actually cause harm and increase a person's chances of contracting a respiratory virus. I introduced many bills to make it illegal for employers, educators and even small businesses from violating our civil rights. These decisions of body autonomy we could determine for ourselves. I called on the government to stop restricting our ability to work, get educated or simply perform everyday activities like shop and visit the doctor for simply refusing the experimental jab. I introduced legislation that would allow doctors to prescribe ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine for the treatment of Covid. | | Our Constitutional rights were being violated and I had to take a stand, no matter the cost. Wearing a mask or not should have been a choice, not a mandate. | | My colleagues complied with the mandates. I did not. I was both isolated and ostracized by my colleagues for standing. The Senate Clerk staff put my desk at the back of the room in a far corner. They tried to break me, but I stood strong. | | During the height of Covid, I was running for Governor. During the day I would serve in the Senate of Virginia. In the evenings, I campaigned across the state. No mask. No vaccine. People were desperate for someone who would stand up for them under the Constitutional mandates. | | Here's a picture of the Virginia Senate in 2021, during the height of Covid. We were forced to meet at the Science Museum of Virginia so that we could comply with social distancing mandates, which we've now discovered were a hoax and nothing more than political science. | | During the height of Covid, who stood up for you? Who fought the unconstitutional mandates? I did. And it came at a cost. | | Who can you count on to stand with you in the future? Who has had the courage, fortitude and history of standing with you in the past? Standing wasn't easy. Even comedian Jimmy Kimmel mocked me nationally for refusing to wear a mask. They wanted to break me, but I stood strong in the midst of isolation, being mocked and ridiculed. I continued to challenge the mask and vaccine mandates. They were making decisions based on political science, not science. Today, 4 years later, we know know the truth. You can count on me. I've stood with you in the past. I will stand with you in the future. | | == | I STAND FOR MEDICAL FREEDOM | I did not get the jab. And I fought for your right not to get the jab. The government should not mandate an experimental "vaccine." | | | | Dr. Sheila Furey, the President of VAMFA Virginia Medical Freedom Alliance and I worked very closely together on legislation that I sponsored to push back against onerous and unconstitutional mandates. | | | Pictured: Dr. Robert Malone, Senator Amanda Chase and Dr. Paul Marik. Dr. Robert Malone was the inventor of the Covid vaccine. Although he took the jab, he later withdrew his support and is now actively exposing the truth about the side effects of the vaccine, to include death. Dr. Paul Marik spoke as a subject matter expert on several of my medical freedom bills. People want choice not mandates. | STANDING FOR THE 2ND AMENDMENT | Many of you heard me speak at the 2020 VCDL Legislative Day at the Capitol when there were well over 50,000 gun loving Virginians who arrived in Virginia. You can trust me to protect your gun rights. To me it's personal. You can trust me to stand up for the 2nd Amendment. | | | == | | | | | | | | | | Some politicians say that they support the 2nd Amendment. I have both a public history and legislative record of opposing gun control. Action should trump rhetoric. I've actually introduced legislation to repeal the gun control laws that the Democrat controlled General Assembly passed in 2020. | | After I was assaulted on multiple occasions on Capitol grounds, I decided to open carry. It worked. The national protestors that flooded our state capitol finally stopped laying hands on me. I believe with all of my heart that guns save lives. I also believe an armed society is a polite society. | | | Many have taken this picture out of context. My team and I were standing on Bank Street in front of the Virginia Capitol in Richmond with hundreds of pro-2nd Amendment supporters from all walks of life. | | July 4, 2020, I was asked to be speak at a Pro-2nd Amendment Rally in downtown Richmond at our state capitol. I was told it was too dangerous to go. Both Antifa and BLM were supposed to be there. My security team and I made the decision to go anyway. Keep in mind the Richmond Police and just been demoralized by Democrat Mayor Levar Stoney. This picture was taken in the streets of Richmond. | The Democrat Trifecta of 2020 passed scores of gun control legislation like one gun a month, universal background checks, red flag laws and gun free zones could not be created by localities. I spoke out against these bills that were a violation of both our U.S. Constitution and our Virginia Constitution. The Democrats controlled the Virginia Senate, the Virginia House and Governor Ralph Northam was Governor. Legislatively, there was nothing we could do. We didn't have the votes. So I chose to go public and expose to the American people what the Democrats were doing. | Bloomberg and others nefarious actors were dumping millions of dollars into Virginia. It was an all out war on our 2nd Amendment rights. While I knew we didn't have the votes, I chose to be creative and get vocal. | To implement socialism, I knew they would first come for our guns. And they did. Instead of protecting individual rights for people to protect themselves, the Democrats were more interested in protecting the criminals, including violent offenders. | | STANDING UP FOR INNOCENT LIFE THOSE WHO CAN'T SPEAK UP FOR THEMSELVES | The Pro-family, non-profit group, The Family Foundation issues a legislative scorecard so that Virginians can see how their legislator scores on pro-family issues. For my entire 8 year legislative career, year after year from 2016 through 2023, I received a perfect score of 100%. You can trust that I will stand for life, because I have a voting record you can trust. Not just my words. | | Life begins at fertilization. Even 98% of scientists agree. I introduced a Life Begins at Conception bill. The Senate Rules Committee refused to make a motion to vote up or down on the bill. If they voted for the bill, they would have to agree that life begins at conception. If they voted down the bill, they would oppose the opinion of 98% of scientists. | | I've been honored to speak at Family Foundation organized pro-life rallies at the Virginia State Capitol. After SCOTUS overturned the Landmark Roe vs Wade Case, CNN asked for an interview. I'm not afraid to stand for life. | | | == | I led the effort in the Virginia Senate to defeat the so called Equal Right Amendment, a failed amendment that was resurrected from the 70s. The false claim was that it should be passed to give women equal rights and codify it in the Constitution. The real agenda was to promote gender fluidity, a concept that seemed so foreign until today. I was an outspoken leader against the so called Equal Rights Amendment. Listen as I speak against SJR 284 on the floor of the Virginia Senate. | == | I've worked under two Democrat governors and one Republican governor. There are different strategies that have to be used for each. Under a Democrat governor, we know pro-life legislation will not pass. So do we continue to introduce legislation even when we know it will not pass? I believe that we should and I do. It's important that we put legislators on the record so that voters know how they will vote when we do have the votes and it does count. | | | | | The late Virginia Senator Eva Mae Scott (R-Amelia) and I speak at a press conference organized by The Family Foundation against the so-called Equal Rights Amendment. | STANDING UP FOR SECURE ELECTIONS MAKING SURE YOUR VOTE COUNTS | | When voters in my senate district went to cast their vote in 2020, many said that they couldn't vote because someone had already cast their vote for them. I was determined to investigate and get to the bottom of this, despite efforts to be shamed into not questioning the 2020 Presidential Election results. | | I flew to Arizona to witness the first ever full forensic audit so that I knew what legislation to introduce in Virginia. Clearly there was a national effort to steal our elections and what they were doing in Arizona was happening all across the country, but only Republican controlled legislators were able to investigate. I worked very closely with the Arizona legislature. My hope was to have a full forensic audit right here in Virginia, but the legislature was completely controlled by the Democrats. So I sought to expose what was happening across the country, and eventually right here in Virginia. | | Pictured: Arizona State Senator Wendy Rodgers, Senator Amanda Chase, Representative Mark Finchem and Senator Sonny Borrelli. | | The Voter Confidence Restoration Act was just one of many bills that I introduced to put the guardrails back on our Virginia elections and restore voter confidence in our elections. While my goal was ultimately a full forensic audit of the 2020 election, I knew that wouldn't happen with a Democrat controlled legislature. So, I led the effort to simply go back to our Virginia Election Law best practices prior to covid, back when we required photo ID to vote, we had an election day instead of an election season and there were no drop boxes. | | While in South Dakota at the Mike Lindell Cyber Symposium I founded the National Election Integrity Caucus for legislators across the country. Together we worked on and shared legislative ideas and bills to assist with our election integrity efforts. | | STANDING UP ON JAN 6 | I was there on January 6. But I did not go into the nation's Capitol. Many of us believed the 2020 Presidential Election was stolen and joining the protest at the Capitol in DC with President Trump to exercise our First Amendment right to free speech and to contest the election results. We were counting on Vice President Mike Pence to do the right thing. Unfortunately, he did not and his political career is over. I stand up for true election integrity. As a result, I was censured by the Virginia Senate with 3 Republicans joining. | | | | STANDING UP FOR SAFER COMMUNITIES LOCKING UP VIOLENT CRIMINALS | Over the past 8 years, I have introduced legislation to support our law enforcement to include the Law Enforcement Bill of Rights. I voted against repealing qualified immunity. | | YOU CAN TRUST ME TO STAND | When you are considering who you are going to support for State Senate in District 10, (Appomattox, Amelia, Buckingham, Cumberland, Prince Edward, Fluvanna, Goochland, Louisa, Powhatan, Hanover and the Shady Grove precinct in Henrico) ask yourself who has the experience to start on Day One? The Republican Mass Meeting to fill Senator John McGuire's seat will likely occur this December 2024. The General Election will likely occur on January 7, 2025, the day before session begins. I am the only candidate running for state senate who will be able to hit the ground running on Day 1. In addition, you know that I'm pro-life, pro-gun, pro-school choice, pro-medical freedom, pro-election integrity because I have a history of fighting for you and have a voting record you can trust. I have 8 years of experience as a Virginia Senate. Plus I have an 8 year voting record you can trust. Today, I humbly ask for your financial support and your vote. | | Virginia State Senator (R-District 11) 2016-2023 | | == | | | | | | | | | == | | == | Authorized and Paid for by Friends of Amanda Chase | | | | Friends of Amanda Chase | P.O. In April, 2022 I stood on the outskirts of an illegal Israeli settlement in Occupied Palestine. An Israeli soldier brandished his rifle and demanded my passport.
"_You don 't have any actual authority here under international law, you know_?" I spoke calmly but directly. "_You do know this is illegal, right? Why do you do this_?"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/64be71e2-116a-44a7-b359-08d0bcdee91b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A photo of the only Palestinian flag I found during my time in Occupied Palestine, tucked away from public view. The Israeli government has made it illegal for Palestinians to fly their own flag in their own nation.
## Just following orders
The soldier didn't answer much less look at me. Completely ignoring my protest, or the protest of anyone in our group, he again demanded each of our passports. This behavior and command was normal to him. He appeared desensitized to the fact that he was following and enforcing illegal orders.
I traveled with a delegation of American Veterans and former Israeli soldiers, traversing Occupied Palestine to witness first hand the reality of Palestinian life under illegal military occupation. Our delegation comprised of Jews, Christians, Muslims, and non-believers. And we were united in the cause of upholding international human rights law and collaborating to advocate for an end Israel's illegal military occupation of Palestine. Moments earlier we'd been stopped by Israeli soldiers and forced to '_show our papers_.' It wouldn't be the last time we endured this type of violation.
Who was this soldier? I have no idea. He refused to identify himself. He wore a full face mask, protective eye wear, and a helmet, completely concealing his identity. He held his rifle close, repeating himself incessantly and demanding each of us hand him our passports, or else. Or else what?
"_It 's not worth it to find out_," one of our Israeli hosts assured us.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/bdab8274-9549-47b9-b1af-6db83262081c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Our groups verbal protests, though accurate and aligned with international law, didn't matter to the Israeli soldier. Reluctantly, we were forced to hand over our passports. The Israeli soldier used his personal cell phone to photograph my passport--another clearly illegal act--and once satisfied with his illegal act, returned it to me.
"_If this is how I 'm treated as a U.S. Citizen and human rights lawyer_," I thought to myself, "_how much worse is it for Palestinians_?" On this journey in Occupied Palestine, I would soon find out first hand.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..yZSSJFuydx0rp3z1iAEdTlotHEW6kanGdal7zJYNt9g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144388116)
As you read this article and my forthcoming series titled _My Journey in Occupied Palestine_ , I want you to place yourself into the shoes of the Palestinians I meet. The two young girls near Qinan Jaber who need a military escort to school ‪every morning because the Israeli settlers who illegally took their family's land now throw stones at them. The humble farmers near the ancient village of Susya--whose land and water wells the Israeli military took by force--and who now have to buy back their own water at seven times the price it is sold to illegal Israeli settlers. The families who were forced to evacuate their homes at Mitzpe Yair because illegal Israeli settlers decided to build an outpost at that exact location. Or the college aged student in South Hebron who suddenly disappeared while walking next to me because I'd ventured into a part of Hebron where Palestinians are not allowed to walk. Roads and streets reserved only for illegal Israeli settlers and non-Palestinian foreigners like myself. And these are but a snapshot of the many such similar stories this series will cover.
## Why am I writing this series?
First, to do my best to relate my on the ground experience in Occupied Palestine. As a human rights lawyer, I have always worked to uphold justice to create peace in Palestine and Israel. And given how our tax dollars are being spent [to commit war crimes](https://substack.com/redirect/091dec11-e723-4b41-9630-d3a4d0e5c9d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I feel it is vital my fellow Americans have a window into the on the ground reality--and what needs to change to achieve that peace and justice.
Next, I have contemplated this series for some time. And given the year anniversary of October 7, and after watching [Professor Ta-nehesi Coates' September 30 interview on CBS](https://substack.com/redirect/649ef471-70a2-484f-874a-1eb6c160e03e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I have decided to act. (As an aside, I have already pre-ordered his book, The Message, which chronicles his experience in Occupied Palestine). We need to shed more light on the on the ground realities so people can understand them for what they are, and be empowered take more meaningful action to effectively counter these injustices.
Finally, prior to my visit I considered myself informed on the reality of injustice in Occupied Palestine. In an academic context, I was informed. After my visit, however, I realized that my insight was that of a person who has merely read a textbook about some tragic historical event, and therefore comparatively limited. Reading about an illegal military occupation, and experiencing it, are two very different phenomena--especially given that this illegal occupation is not some historical event, but instead contemporary reality. Thus, given the small fraction of my fellow Americans have actually visited Occupied Palestine, I am hopeful my experience can benefit them too.

## A note about context
Let me also address the elephant in the room. I write this series not as a Palestinian, nor as an Israeli. I write this as a Pakistani American and Muslim American, as an immigrant and U.S. citizen, and as a human rights lawyer. But most of all, I write this as a human being, and [as someone who personally understands the pain and torture of apartheid oppression](https://substack.com/redirect/ab5a3de5-3f08-4aa3-8d2e-ae3332ea60a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I write not to compare atrocities, nor to answer the question of whether Israel has the right to exist--indeed as Professor Coates aptly stated in his CBS interview--Israel already _does_ exist.
I write this series instead to answer questions like these: do our current policies honestly treat Palestine as if it has the right to exist? Do Palestinians have the right to self-determination, sovereignty, and to protect themselves from external powers besieging their lands and lives? And do we as Americans recognize Palestinian humanity and act to uphold justice accordingly? If you were to ask a US State Department official they'd proudly proclaim yes to each of these questions, but as James Baldwin writes in an essay incidentally titled, _[A Report from Occupied Territory](https://substack.com/redirect/78094b1e-63ac-447a-a99a-4d688c850140?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , "I can't believe what you say because I see what you do."
And finally, this is not an academic series--it is a rendering of my experiences in Occupied Palestine. It relates the stories of Palestinians themselves. If you're looking for academic scholarship on this topic, I can recommend [The 100 Years War on Palestine](https://substack.com/redirect/b407c4c0-077b-47f6-aced-4d1196711a2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Rashid Khalidi or [The Question of Palestine](https://substack.com/redirect/ee7ee98b-9354-4a1c-8fa2-04d10220f44e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Edward Said or the recent [landmark documentary titled Israelism](https://substack.com/redirect/a91d26db-b0b7-4ee9-a089-82fe56a702fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Indeed, there is no shortage of [incredible scholarship written by Palestinian authors and academics](https://substack.com/redirect/000dd82b-f31b-46fe-b6a0-77a72f4d3789?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that I encourage you to invest your time and resources to read and understand.
## In Conclusion
Anyone who has followed my work and advocacy over the past several decades knows I have not hesitated to call out injustice no matter the actor--from people of my own faith, to people of my birth country, to people of my home country of the United States, to leaders of the Democratic party as well as the Republican party. As a human rights lawyer, my purpose, my mission, my driving force is to uphold justice in all matters. And that is the purpose of this series--to relate the current injustices imposed upon Palestinians in Occupied Palestine, so we can work together to ensure we uphold justice for Palestine, and indeed for all humanity as equals.
Therefore, in closing Part 1 of this series titled _My Journey in Occupied Palestine_ , I ask you to read future parts with an expanding mind. Reflect on how you would react to the injustices imposed upon Palestinians--often with our American tax dollars--if they were imposed upon you or your loved ones? And what steps you can take to ensure our future elected leaders truly uphold justice, humanity, and the basic right to self-determination.

## **A Wake-Up Call:**
Rockdale’s Chemical Fire and the Threat in Our Backyard
| | |
---
|
### Dear Neighbors,
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MDAyMzEzMjAxMTkwMDIyLFwiclwiOjEzNDAwMjMxMzg4OTA1NTg4OX0iLCJzIjoiN2U5MmVkMWYzZThhOGZiMSJ9) The [recent chemical fire in Rockdale County](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MDAyMzEzMjA2NDMyOTA2LFwiclwiOjEzNDAwMjMxMzg4OTA1NTg4OX0iLCJzIjoiM2ZkYmQ4Yjg4OTIzNWExMiJ9), just miles away from College Park, serves as a sobering reminder of the dangers posed by industrial facilities so close to our homes. This fire resulted in an evacuation order for over 17,000 people and sent a massive plume of smoke across the region—visible even from Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport. The lingering effects on air quality and public health have stretched far beyond Rockdale, impacting daily life for many in neighboring areas. This disaster highlights the very real risks we face with the planned lithium battery storage facility in our own community. Much like the chemical fire in Rockdale, this facility could pose serious dangers to the health, safety, and well-being of everyone in College Park. Fires, explosions, and chemical releases are not uncommon at battery storage plants, and their consequences could easily spill over into our neighborhoods. The residents who live in this community have already successfully fought off this facility in the past, but the "new" City Council’s actions have quietly moved forward against their wishes. Now, more than ever, we must [come together as a community to continue this fight](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTM0MDAyMzEzMjEyNzI0MzY3LFwiclwiOjEzNDAwMjMxMzg4OTA1NTg4OX0iLCJzIjoiNWU4ZWM0NDdmNWM3NmRiYiJ9). We cannot afford to wait until a disaster like this happens in **our own backyard**. Your continued engagement with the challenges facing College Park is what strengthens this effort.
| | |
---
|

The residents who live in this community have already successfully fought off this facility in the past, but the "new" City Council’s actions have quietly moved forward against their wishes. Now, more than ever, we must . We cannot afford to wait until a disaster like this happens in our own backyard. Your continued engagement with the challenges facing College Park is what strengthens this effort. | | | | Lithium Ion Storage Facilities Around the World | | | | To help raise awareness of the dangers posed by these battery storage facilities, here are several recent examples of lithium battery plants that have caught fire in the past year: | | | | One more thing... | | | | | I encourage you to watch this from the City of La Mesa, California, as she speaks about the threat of a battery storage facility being considered in her town. Councilwoman Lothian discusses recent battery fires and the threat they pose to their region if chemicals were to be released during a fire. Her leadership and clear articulation of the risks remind us why we must remain vigilant in protecting our community. Her words are a powerful reminder of what’s at stake, and we should draw inspiration from her leadership in standing up for her town—just as we must continue standing up for College Park. | | | | | Donate Now! | | | | | | | | | VOICES of College Park: Project raises fears and frustrations in neighboring city In her latest episode of Voices of College Park Adrianne Murchinson is joined by Connie and Tiffany Patterson, residents of the city of South Fulton and mother and daughter. They join the podcast to discuss fears and frustrations with the lack of information on emergency measures if a disaster occurs. | | | | | | | Stay Informed. Stay United. | **Tucker Carlson** hit the road on his first live tour early last month, making 16 stops in cities from coast to coast. He was joined on stage by fascinating guests, responding to current events in real time, and **his two Texas stops did not disappoint!** At the Fort Bend stop, Outreach Director Carrie Bigford and Communication Liaison Kelly Vela were not shy about spreading the TFVC mission when they providentially ran into Tucker, Nicole Shanahan and Dr. Wakefield **as they were exiting the VIP Lounge** to head to the stage**.** Nicole spoke passionately about her child's vaccine injury with Kelly. During his conversation with Carrie, Dr. Wakefield sent all of us words of encouragement to stay in the battle. And then... **Tucker told Carrie, "I love TFVC!"****** The Fort Worth stop with Roseanne Barr was equally inspiring. TFVC President Rebecca Hardy reported that it was like a big family reunion with America’s mom on stage. During their on-stage chat, they spoke deeply about restoring the humanity America has lost, staying hope-filled regardless of circumstance, and reminded us that, in the end, **God wins.** _We all know that when mom speaks up, we better listen._ We are grateful to Tucker for platforming some of the heroes in this movement and for inspiring us all to**love our fellow Americans better.**
