# 2024 Florida Election Key dates:
* **[October 7: Voter registration deadline](https://substack.com/redirect/ce273095-3974-4dc5-929a-6363eb2d4385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* **October 24** : Deadline to request a mail ballot
* **October 26- November 2** : Each county is required to hold in-person early voting October 26 - November 2**,** 2024, though some counties have longer early voting periods.
* **October 28** : Suggested deadline for mailing your ballot. Mail ballots must be RECEIVED by Supervisor of Elections by 5:00 pm on November 5. PLEASE do not mail your ballot back after October 28. Instead[, please use one of the many drop-box locations or other acceptable return locations](https://substack.com/redirect/3268ef7b-0093-43a5-bab9-2fa1113dc501?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* **November 5** : Election day.

[Register/Check Your FL Voter Info](https://substack.com/redirect/ce273095-3974-4dc5-929a-6363eb2d4385?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
#### Changes to vote by mail in Florida:
Florida removed all vote by mail requests for every voter in the state last election. Anyone who wants to vote by mail this year [must re-request a mail ballot before Oct. 24, 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/a6493816-b8f5-496a-b0cd-b8f54f7d8c79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
That request must be renewed for every election now, and the state has removed the ability to request a mail ballot online, though you can make the request by phone, email, mail or in person at your local supervisor of elections office.
[Find your local supervisor of elections office here.](https://substack.com/redirect/7e147d69-585b-4bc7-bbae-022f16b4b922?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mail ballots must be RECEIVED by your local Supervisor of Elections office by 5:00 pm on November 5. PLEASE do not mail your ballot back after October 28. Instead[, please use one of the many drop-box locations or other acceptable return locations](https://substack.com/redirect/3268ef7b-0093-43a5-bab9-2fa1113dc501?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* * *
# SIX Ballot Amendments in Florida:
### **YES on 3, 4, 5.**
**Vote YES on Ballot Amendment #3** , which would legalize recreational/personal use of marijuana.
**Vote YES on Ballot Amendment #4** , which protects a woman's right to reproductive healthcare.
**Vote YES on amendment #5** , which would tie the homestead property tax exemption to inflation, providing much-needed relief to families already burdened with rising home insurance costs.
### **NO on 1, 2, 6**
**Vote NO on Amendment #1,** which would change Florida's school board races from non-partisan to partisan. Research shows that liberal ideas are more popular overall than conservative ones, but once the branding on R or D is put on a thought or policy idea, republicans will reject it even if they agree with it. Keeping sanity in Florida's school district necessitates continued non-partisan elections so that best ideas win, not political clubs.
**Vote NO on #2**. Amendment #2 establishes hunting and fishing as a constitutional right, which in itself isn't particularly controversial. However, the amendment would also declare that hunting and fishing are the "preferred means for responsibly managing and controlling fish and wildlife." Such an amendment would nullify conservation laws that use science and evidence-based methodologies to preserve and protect ecosystems and wildlife.
**Vote NO on #6,** which would repeal the 1998 voter-passed law that provides public financing for statewide candidates who agree to spending limits. Florida has tried multiple times to repeal the public financing law, the most recent time being in 2010, when the initiative failed to receive the 60% necessary to pass. In a world driven by massive, dark-money contributions, and in a state where Republicans are well-oiled machines of dark financing, public funding levels the playing field.

Last election cycle of Americans voted early or by mail, up from less than one-third in 2018. Experts believed voting by mail, also called absentee voting, would continue to increase over time, given its broad appeal. However, conservative-run states have been working to smother vote by mail by enacting laws or policies that make the process more difficult. I'll be posting information about elections in key battleground states or in races with national implications this week loom in many states. Today, we're looking at Florida. | | ---|---|--- 2024 Florida Election Key dates: October 24 : Deadline to request a mail ballot October 26- November 2 : Each county is required to hold in-person early voting October 26 - November 2, 2024, though some counties have longer early voting periods. October 28 : Suggested deadline for mailing your ballot. Mail ballots must be RECEIVED by Supervisor of Elections by 5:00 pm on November 5. PLEASE do not mail your ballot back after October 28. Instead. November 5 : Election day. Changes to vote by mail in Florida: Florida removed all vote by mail requests for every voter in the state last election. Anyone who wants to vote by mail this year . That request must be renewed for every election now, and the state has removed the ability to request a mail ballot online, though you can make the request by phone, email, mail or in person at your local supervisor of elections office. Mail ballots must be RECEIVED by your local Supervisor of Elections office by 5:00 pm on November 5. PLEASE do not mail your ballot back after October 28. Instead. SIX Ballot Amendments in Florida: YES on 3, 4, 5. Vote YES on Ballot Amendment #3 , which would legalize recreational/personal use of marijuana. Vote YES on Ballot Amendment #4 , which protects a woman's right to reproductive healthcare. Vote YES on amendment #5 , which would tie the homestead property tax exemption to inflation, providing much-needed relief to families already burdened with rising home insurance costs. NO on 1, 2, 6 Vote NO on Amendment #1, which would change Florida's school board races from non-partisan to partisan. Research shows that liberal ideas are more popular overall than conservative ones, but once the branding on R or D is put on a thought or policy idea, republicans will reject it even if they agree with it. Keeping sanity in Florida's school district necessitates continued non-partisan elections so that best ideas win, not political clubs. Vote NO on #2. Amendment #2 establishes hunting and fishing as a constitutional right, which in itself isn't particularly controversial. However, the amendment would also declare that hunting and fishing are the "preferred means for responsibly managing and controlling fish and wildlife." Such an amendment would nullify conservation laws that use science and evidence-based methodologies to preserve and protect ecosystems and wildlife. Vote NO on #6, which would repeal the 1998 voter-passed law that provides public financing for statewide candidates who agree to spending limits. Florida has tried multiple times to repeal the public financing law, the most recent time being in 2010, when the initiative failed to receive the 60% necessary to pass. In a world driven by massive, dark-money contributions, and in a state where Republicans are well-oiled machines of dark financing, public funding levels the playing field. Peter, have you been following what’s happening in Arizona?
There’s a ballot initiative — ironically named “The Judicial Accountability Act of 2024” by those championing it — this fall that would essentially end term limits for state supreme and appellate court judges.
Worse yet, it would be retroactive. That means that if Proposition 137 passes, it would overturn the results of any election this November that unseats a current state supreme court justice. This includes two GOP judges who ruled to uphold the state’s Civil War-era abortion ban, who some voters are trying to get out of office.
**Proposition 137 would take power away from voters after they cast their ballots — and it’s a tremendous, partisan abuse of power. Full stop.**
That’s why our grassroots team is texting voters in Arizona to mobilize them and push back against the ballot initiative because we know that every Arizonan and every American should be free to make their voices heard at the ballot box.

name: Voter Action Project
subject: We need the USPS to work for all of us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Postmaster DeJoy seems to think he can rely on the private sector for deliveries. But private companies won’t build offices in rural and remote areas because it’s not profitable. In fact, these private companies often rely on the USPS for “ last-mile delivery ” to get mail and packages to remote areas because it would be too expensive for them to do it any other way.
It's called the United States Postal Service for a reason. We want the USPS to be self-sustaining, but unlike private businesses, profit is not -- and must not -- be the bottom line. For our country and our citizens, service must be the USPS bottom-line.
Tell Congress: No more mail slowdowns. Not for rural families. Not for anyone. Restore delivery service standards to every ZIP Code immediately >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=100124_2&amount=25]
Folks, The truth is clear:
We need to act to save the United States Postal Service from Wall Street and Trump-appointed Postmaster General Louis DeJoy.
It’s no accident that DeJoy -- the first Postmaster General in two decades without experience working in the postal service -- was appointed just months after Trumps’ Office of Management and Budget released recommendations that the USPS should be privatized. The result has been the slow decimation of one of America’s most treasured institutions.
Mail slowdowns and historic price hikes have made DeJoy’s claim that the USPS is in a “death spiral” a self fulfilling prophecy . More mail slowdowns would hurt rural communities the most because -- unlike UPS and FedEx -- the USPS is required by law to deliver all mail to all regions timely, and at a flat rate.
This year, our movement, working with Congress, forced DeJoy to pause closures of USPS processing centers until at least January 2025, to help protect vote-by-mail in this crucial election year .
Now it’s time to do it again -- This time to stop the new mail slowdowns set to hit rural communities the hardest, and demand service delivery be restored to 2012 standards to completely erase the damage done by Louis DeJoy.
Sign our petition now: Don’t let Louis DeJoy privatize the USPS! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
DeJoy sees mail service drop off as “inevitable” and says his price hikes aren’t speeding up the decline. He’s wrong. The combination of higher prices and slower delivery virtually guarantees the USPS will lose more customers. Since slowdowns started a little over a decade ago, and accelerated under DeJoy, first-class mail volume has shrunk by 28%.
His decisions affect us all, but folks in rural areas, including many Indigenous communities, seniors, and veterans are the ones who will pay the greatest price, because for many -- the post office is their lifeline . These communities rely on the postal service to receive medications and to vote-by-mail, because some towns are too small for polling places and don’t have a pharmacy.
When DeJoy has faced pressure from Congress and everyday people like you and me, we’ve won . On electric vehicles, he agreed to make a minimum of 62% of new USPS vehicle purchases electric, up from his initial plan of just 10%. We didn’t stop the pressure and he then also committed to a 40% reduction in overall USPS emissions by 2030. We all must step up one more time.
Send a message directly to your members of Congress and the USPS Board of Governors demanding they stop mail slowdowns and price hikes, and restore 2012 delivery standards, to save the post office now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

| "Philadelphia Police Officer Jaime Roman died on September 10th, three months after he was shot while performing a motor vehicle investigation, commonly called a 'car stop' by the police...

... In my many years of covering the police, I’ve gone out on many a ride-along with Philadelphia police officers and I’ve observed the cops pull over cars and approach the car’s driver with apprehension and adherence to professional procedure.

I recall first hearing about the dangers of car stops when I attended the pilot class of the Philadelphia Police Department’s Civilian Police Academy back in 1994..."

Paul Davis is a South Philadelphia writer and frequent contributor to _Broad + Liberty_. He is also a regular contributor to Counterterrorism magazine, and he writes the “On Crime” column for the _Washington Times_. He enlisted in the U.S. Navy when he was 17 and served two years aboard the aircraft carrier USS Kitty Hawk during the Vietnam War. * * *
Recently, Donald Trump shamelessly exploited a photo of the late Vicente Fernández (who supported Hillary Clinton before he died) in his “Latinos for Trump” ad. Vicente was a beacon of culture and values that embody love, unity, and respect—values that Trump consistently tramples on.

Using Vicente’s image without permission is not just disrespectful; it’s a blatant attempt to co-opt the legacy of a beloved icon for his own gain.
This exploitation extends beyond the Latino community. We must recognize how Trump has consistently used marginalized communities including the disabled community as props for his agenda, only to betray us at every turn.

Hey Peter, it’s George.

Month after month, day after day, deadline after deadline — I find myself speechless from the incredible and unwavering support from people like you.

Yesterday was our final FEC deadline in this race, and thanks to you, we surpassed our $15,000 end-of-quarter goal.

Because of your generosity, we are now equipped with the resources to finish this race stronger than ever. Over the next 35 days, we will knock on doors, make phone calls, and send texts to mobilize the voters we need to win in November.

Your support is truly invaluable, Peter. Knowing I have your support means I can continue delivering real results on issues that impact our communities most. When you elect me to Congress, I will keep fighting for working families and pushing to protect our rights — no matter what.

I am so grateful to have you by my side. Now, let’s finish strong!

Thank you for your continuous support and dedication,

George

name: Neil Parrott
subject: Thank you and your invitation for this Thursday
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=930a40cee0)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

Thank you so much for your help in this campaign. April and I are so thankful for the outpouring of support. THANK YOU!!

We are making great progress and p[](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=4a289ea335&e=5a45ee1154)olls show that we are in the lead,
but barely. We must get our commercials and mailers out to win this election, and you are helping us to do just that.

Yesterday was a huge day for online donations -again, THANK YOU! The deadline to receive donations for this reporting period just passed, and we are waiting for today's mail to see if we made it - we are so close, but only because of your help. I'll let you know!

Do you live near Walkersville? Could you drive to Frederick County? Do you like pie? I hope you will come to a special event this Thursday night with Governor Ehrlich. Please join us - we will share exciting news about the campaign and a perspective on the national campaign from Governor Ehrlich who sees it on the ground in Pennsylvania.
---

| Before writing more - the photo of Governor Ehrlich and me is really fun. It dates back to 2010 when Governor Ehrlich and I were campaigning for that Falls election - I was so thankful for his support then, and am so thankful for his support today.

Please make plans to join us on October 3rd in Walkersville for the Pie & Politics Fundraiser. Pie will be served, you'll be surrounded by like-minded people who love our country, and Governor Ehrlich will talk about his new book _142 Ways America Went from Sweet Land of Liberty to Weak, Woke, and Wobbly: A Reference Guide to the Biden Years._

The event will be at the home of Vernon and Cynthia King next to the City of Frederick in Walkersville, MD. It is this Thursday, October 3rd, so please sign up today using the link below. The event will go from 5:30-6:30pm for the VIP meeting and 6:30-8pm main event.

This is going to be a fantastic event, and I am thankful that my wife, April, will be baking a few of her famous pies for this fun and informational event.

To RSVP to meet us in Walkersville with Governor Ehrlich, click the button below or use this link: [https://secure.winred.com/neilparrott/ehrlichatkings](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a2ce601ad1&e=5a45ee1154)

Thanks again for your support, and I hope to see you on Thursday,
Neil

subject: Can we count on your support?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsglGecWRN
Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest
and most interesting conservatives each month?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osglGecWRN

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Are you
enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

Do you
look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most
interesting conservatives each month?

I hope
so.

You will
never have to pay for Imprimis because we want its message in
defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many
citizens as possible.

We're
grateful that you read Imprimis, and we hope you share your copy
with others after you've read it-and that you encourage others
you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale
relies on a nationwide network of supporters-people like you-to
help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government,
free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and
strong national defense.

You're a
longtime Imprimis subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how
the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our
country.

And you
understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to
undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate
the American people about our founding principles of
liberty…the importance of reviving limited constitutional
government…the need to defend the rule of law…and
the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free
enterprise.

That's
why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale
College.

Other
colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural
relativism and the oppression of "political
correctness"-Hillsdale has not-and it continues to fulfill its
mission of defending civil and religious liberty through
education.

Will you
help?

In
addition to sending Imprimis to more Americans, you will help
us…

Teach
Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of
Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American
Heritage, the Great Books, and more through free online courses
(to date, more than 4 million students have registered for one or
more courses);

Launch and support dozens more classical K-12 schools
nationwide-schools where students receive an education rooted in
the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral
character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently
attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands
more are on waiting lists.

Your
support is especially needed today because Hillsdale College does
not accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. We refuse
to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we
rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand
the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever
amount you give today, whether it's…

>> $25
>> $35
>> $50
>> $100
>> $250

…will help us defend the freedom of the American people
and the American way of life through education.

Simply
click the link below and let us know if we can count on your
support.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63596482:sglGecWRN:m:3:2627245898:332AB437E23E6B6016802376AAA6869B:r

Thank you
in advance for your help in reaching and teaching millions more
Americans on behalf of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Dear Friend,

In today's complex geopolitical landscape, staying informed is
more important than ever. The Hoover Institution is pleased to
offer you a free copy of our insightful ebook, China's Playbook
and How to Beat It. This comprehensive collection of essays by
renowned Hoover experts delves into China's multifaceted
strategies and provides actionable recommendations for
effectively countering them.

Why This Ebook is a Must-Read:

1. Analysis of China's Global Strategy:

Gain a deep understanding of China's military, economic, and
ideological ambitions. Our experts break down Beijing's playbook,
revealing the long-term strategies driving China's global rise.

2. Key Recommendations for Policy and Business Leaders:

Discover practical strategies that policymakers, business
leaders, and academics can employ to counter China's influence.
Learn how international cooperation and strategic policymaking
can serve as powerful tools in maintaining global stability and
promoting democratic values.

3. Insights into International Implications:

Understand the broader implications of China's rise on the
international stage. This ebook explores the geopolitical shifts,
economic dependencies, and ideological battles that shape the
current global order, providing you with the knowledge needed to
navigate these complex challenges.

4. Contributions from Distinguished Experts:

The ebook features contributions from leading scholars and
practitioners with deep expertise in China studies, international
relations, and strategic policy. Their insights offer a nuanced
perspective that goes beyond the headlines, giving you a thorough
understanding of the issues at hand.

5. A Valuable Resource for Decision-Makers:

Whether you're involved in policy-making, academia, business,
or simply have a keen interest in global affairs, this ebook is
an invaluable resource. It equips you with the knowledge and
strategies needed to respond effectively to China's global
ambitions.

How to Get Your Free Copy:

We believe that informed individuals are better equipped to
contribute to meaningful discussions and decision-making
processes. That's why we are offering this ebook at no cost. To
secure your free copy, simply click the link below:

Get My Free Ebook

We encourage you to take advantage of this opportunity to
enhance your understanding of one of the most pressing issues of
our time. Stay informed, stay prepared, and stay ahead.

Sincerely,

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development

Hoover Institution | Stanford University

With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and
Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven
policy research organization that seeks to improve the human
condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity,
national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one
hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that
have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the
United States and around the world.

Friend,

body:
They sacrificed everything to escape communism. Now it’s our turn to continue their legacy.

| |
---
| | | Hey, Friend, it's Ted Cruz.

_I 'm reaching out to you today to tell you two quick stories._
The first one is about the man I admire most in this world - my father. He fled communist Cuba after being imprisoned and tortured and came to Texas with just $100 to his name. He got a job washing dishes for 50 cents an hour and learned English before attending the University of Texas at Austin. He sacrificed everything to get to America and find a better life for himself, and I am so proud to be his son.

---
| [](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT-P4yAQxT8N7rBg-OOkoFjdys1pT6drrkQYJg4KxhbgZHWf_uRIqbba-s37vXkzfz_sh4sp5vmXW9DcfLGl2na3tSEm68v-j7bHSmsMWC0wkJQzyrjlXTDh7LXTHRo-wHBiQg6yu5pJOTdcAgY-nYegpVdOTQJOl0mDCgq7aA4OZ4xzLRUMvVQXxRRMWvGLF2dJJHMJS-tviJtf81yw1oLbPqXoXe79unTJXFvbKhFvBEYCY0W_F-wfMRcMxwSBcYn-iinhswuB8dmmNpcDfcR2pS-dbmU9KGIsB6XEPBPx3sqOBPTeFuvdsrk4ZyLeX6vb32_0548_0HMutOS2caUkaEk5P50IaPy0LYZvGJ45a26Y2xF-pzdf6MtMQH_u-f5V6IoJ2yOmFKseiGTz4mJ6Hqh965l3A_8DAAD__1X-osM)
---

The second story I want to tell you is about my dear friend, Michelle Steel. Her parents escaped communist North Korea and moved to Seoul, Japan, and finally to America in search of a better life for their children. Their courage to leave everything behind and flee a communist regime gave Michelle the opportunity to experience her own American Dream, and not a day goes by where she takes their sacrifices for granted.

---
| [](https://email.alert.keepcongressrepublican.com/c/eJyUkT-P4yAQxT8N7rBg-OOkoFjdys1pT6drrkQYJg4KxhbgZHWf_uRIqbba-s37vXkzfz_sh4sp5vmXW9DcfLGl2na3tSEm68v-j7bHSmsMWC0wkJQzyrjlXTDh7LXTHRo-wHBiQg6yu5pJOTdcAgY-nYegpVdOTQJOl0mDCgq7aA4OZ4xzLRUMvVQXxRRMWvGLF2dJJHMJS-tviJtf81yw1oLbPqXoXe79unTJXFvbKhFvBEYCY0W_F-wfMRcMxwSBcYn-iinhswuB8dmmNpcDfcR2pS-dbmU9KGIsB6XEPBPx3sqOBPTeFuvdsrk4ZyLeX6vb32_0548_0HMutOS2caUkaEk5P50IaPy0LYZvGJ45a26Y2xF-pzdf6MtMQH_u-f5V6IoJ2yOmFKseiGTz4mJ6Hqh965l3A_8DAAD__1X-osM)
---

Our stories are two sides of the same coin, Friend. Our parents fought and clawed to escape communism, and we honor their battle every day in office by ensuring we keep those same principles far away from our shores.

But the hard truth is, right now, Democratic leadership is more focused on ensuring their entire radical agenda gets passed than standing up for what is right. **They 've bowed down to these regimes and allowed their threat to our nation to grow rather than do what is necessary to keep Americans safe.**

It's truly disgraceful, Friend, and if the Left wins the House this November, no one will be able to stop them from continuing down this path. _Simply put, me and Michelle 's fight to defend the values that our parents sacrificed everything for will be over. _

But there is good news. The #1 seat the Democrats need to flip to take the Majority is Michelle's, and if we can give her a huge boost tonight, we'll be able to hold them accountable for their actions and push back against their agenda.

subject: Two sides of the same coin.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michelle Steel for Congress
body:
They sacrificed everything to escape communism. Now it's our turn to continue their legacy.

| |
---
| | | Hey, Friend, it's Ted Cruz.

_I 'm reaching out to you today to tell you two quick stories._
The first one is about the man I admire most in this world - my father. He fled communist Cuba after being imprisoned and tortured and came to Texas with just $100 to his name. He got a job washing dishes for 50 cents an hour and learned English before attending the University of Texas at Austin. He sacrificed everything to get to America and find a better life for himself, and I am so proud to be his son.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c3c753ea982e4c2487e10ce7d7d97c03&_e=WZyc8l-LmHAhRQdYFVeQvrq9ovDqLGMaktl3zDArB3hwYGR6pQtIaEtCLEb0PraFAWY0aOd0mFs-S_xYuzm6Cg22sWfqH6HX5dtJQnqIOnoG473X5UIx1SSXm8r3qj0rXVR-FWhiYtkZ2fR_Dl8V0oOk5tON4cQUa_ubDfr8yPV9PMuZMQB8FfdlYPZdjsWzOf4nFiuKpJQwQfaIdN4cNo8zkTPcsCWj2NoAEZ2-B8aTvPP9RUYUadgZMr9Hs6GrUDMbBhSlSiPSc4LZjalgT8kVVIUrCjk-yEdXbmABuLfDRrfQV2Qwh5KLlvOTTM8Uyz5ZB5UHmGsS4LQqZfcWIOViOgKTdaiFMmb1uok_l_7kv71ELv6uPLBu4x2R-HVFIKnXpU5q-4aGgGn4KLzwhbV0JZaTwqDxt2G8w4WP3HZsphJObFAl0DHUEswRynhoGoAEkAE1Hn8k-xGSNNXDMzGYrsiC35lAoCAceh-1dNo%3D)
---

The second story I want to tell you is about my dear friend, Michelle Steel. Her parents escaped communist North Korea and moved to Seoul, Japan, and finally to America in search of a better life for their children. Their courage to leave everything behind and flee a communist regime gave Michelle the opportunity to experience her own American Dream, and not a day goes by where she takes their sacrifices for granted.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=c3c753ea982e4c2487e10ce7d7d97c03&_e=WZyc8l-LmHAhRQdYFVeQvrq9ovDqLGMaktl3zDArB3hwYGR6pQtIaEtCLEb0PraFAWY0aOd0mFs-S_xYuzm6Cg22sWfqH6HX5dtJQnqIOnoG473X5UIx1SSXm8r3qj0rXVR-FWhiYtkZ2fR_Dl8V0oOk5tON4cQUa_ubDfr8yPV9PMuZMQB8FfdlYPZdjsWzOf4nFiuKpJQwQfaIdN4cNo8zkTPcsCWj2NoAEZ2-B8aTvPP9RUYUadgZMr9Hs6GrUDMbBhSlSiPSc4LZjalgT8kVVIUrCjk-yEdXbmABuLfDRrfQV2Qwh5KLlvOTTM8UuMrLHHr8B7cr0TkK9ohGIW_wE_wcMvxfqnrt8euUVGFMpktcOGh3abO8ZumgC_AJZEdEgBI43rrbjJdEHlfiOg2c3kfZ4hTahchaUIxvlBrGDPcbNiI6lQ9NPlY8XMUujtn1E-yY4-P0BZJ1cLORVYkE4GlQ5bSDGSMquv1g0gk%3D)
---

Our stories are two sides of the same coin, Friend. Our parents fought and clawed to escape communism, and we honor their battle every day in office by ensuring we keep those same principles far away from our shores.

But the hard truth is, right now, Democratic leadership is more focused on ensuring their entire radical agenda gets passed than standing up for what is right. **They 've bowed down to these regimes and allowed their threat to our nation to grow rather than do what is necessary to keep Americans safe.**

It's truly disgraceful, Friend, and if the Left wins the House this November, no one will be able to stop them from continuing down this path. _Simply put, me and Michelle 's fight to defend the values that our parents sacrificed everything for will be over. _

But there is good news. The #1 seat the Democrats need to flip to take the Majority is Michelle's, and if we can give her a huge boost tonight, we'll be able to hold them accountable for their actions and push back against their agenda.

body:
They sacrificed everything to escape communism. Now it’s our turn to continue their legacy.

| |
---
| | | Hey, Friend, it's Ted Cruz.

_I 'm reaching out to you today to tell you two quick stories._
The first one is about the man I admire most in this world - my father. He fled communist Cuba after being imprisoned and tortured and came to Texas with just $100 to his name. He got a job washing dishes for 50 cents an hour and learned English before attending the University of Texas at Austin. He sacrificed everything to get to America and find a better life for himself, and I am so proud to be his son.

---
| [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=35e8827f60204194be42bb670ac041c0&_e=_8QvRH7MIeJXSHP-gKKf8R0Pri8uv2IVHYxM2B26Alb0jA-mxjp-jikfH908fKi5pxbCVUo9-8zI7fVhke-tWz_fzdKc_F0K6kPgBHep-xpLlOgeU3C0RY6NRXm9lKG_M57TVm5aTm7ks3zEZiHxEACvzchHlVIa0ga7K3WCcJfLo8sEhWKaqcUg9qLeLpOpkzAo4zi93DoKkUNu2RMvSsjrxfSP0PvLs0TcDccxnRzkl7ylxNjbDAVlP0-85gfvK0yaturlAq-pbqyo9A-rkJ1uBA4RLe5jsPenOYlUpUHqdvoOKhSQD_dzORLPppQzmGUR6eL8RfyVXsKNHFMA6u6WiITz_uy3AUyn1-6QAw-z2Zl05OH7EGdT7BnyuNYBKiB_iyIrpjBE1CDn0Lye9HhhwpXG336HPEnAfimS96aqXLJxWLVBIkUrNhZXzO5XItODT2wTblBGGlZ7T1a9gDngN8W91afFI4Uua0WoLY0%3D)
---

The second story I want to tell you is about my dear friend, Michelle Steel. Her parents escaped communist North Korea and moved to Seoul, Japan, and finally to America in search of a better life for their children. Their courage to leave everything behind and flee a communist regime gave Michelle the opportunity to experience her own American Dream, and not a day goes by where she takes their sacrifices for granted.

---

---

Our stories are two sides of the same coin, Friend. Our parents fought and clawed to escape communism, and we honor their battle every day in office by ensuring we keep those same principles far away from our shores.

But the hard truth is, right now, Democratic leadership is more focused on ensuring their entire radical agenda gets passed than standing up for what is right. **They 've bowed down to these regimes and allowed their threat to our nation to grow rather than do what is necessary to keep Americans safe.**

It's truly disgraceful, Friend, and if the Left wins the House this November, no one will be able to stop them from continuing down this path. _Simply put, me and Michelle 's fight to defend the values that our parents sacrificed everything for will be over. _

But there is good news. The #1 seat the Democrats need to flip to take the Majority is Michelle's, and if we can give her a huge boost tonight, we'll be able to hold them accountable for their actions and push back against their agenda.

Failure is not an option. Kamala Harris has dangerous plans for our country, and our only hope to stop her is a new Republican Majority. |

Fellow American,

**We can’t risk failure; failing to flip the Senate would be a DISASTER.**

Kamala Harris is the most radical Democrat to run for President since FDR, and nonpartisan GovTrack gave her the **“most liberal Senator”** moniker for her party-line voting record in the U.S. Senate.

I served with Kamala in the U.S. Senate, and let me tell you now, she is more radical than you’ve heard.
**
She will raise taxes on everyone, spend trillions of dollars we do not have on wasteful priorities only a tiny minority of Americans support, limit our liberties, restrict freedom of speech, and govern without fear of reprisals.**

If Kamala wins in November, it’s critical that a Republican Senate majority be in place to prevent the worst of her policies from becoming law.

That won’t happen unless we give it our all for the next 35 days.

**That won’t happen if you don’t get involved today.

[That won’t happen if we don’t defeat vulnerable Democrat incumbents like Jon Tester in Montana.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=eade2882d79c4c7b8123c347e28cfc2f&_e=ZLWVdE6xp8LTT9WOkq4ZpG7YmLfxIhZBKEzE8RU1BRIf9e_60_F6XS8bAWXwSX-y_DkAKvxLLIMpmhj0mzj33pLwSIb32yZ93GPbUxO5U3GjlLrPVtn5KyLwdHD9AvP-TrwebKgZuFzat_DsLs3iv0F-TJfV9JNOQtPjNSc5NC6lJ9EtpdZQaf6Mb-T7yxUNzDBcn--s9V1nDLCrJVrqFa9TQriAspN5sY4gUW4Mhz2F2JrSErJPK7_GlVkNPvjATgXZrAG2xVbM2yGvLi-joc8VhYlDz7Q42hi-6Q0K6VJC-du8OkGpGuVkXzEwSdGjIOBAhLWtwDe_rbmJU963YGwG0_8I1OLSvScHKjI30vWlKEpQ_ALadhBRo8Qur6hi-iisBtv2kS9kpGk4CGK_Qg%3D%3D) **

The race that could strip the Democrats of their majority | | |
---
The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

This is what Moreno is up against – lies, lies, and more lies – yet he only trails Brown by 3 points. **MISSOURI** – Senator **Josh Hawley** (R) faces Marine veteran **Lucas Kunce** (D) who is pretending to be a centrist. In a recent debate, Kunce refused to say if he was going to vote for Kamala Harris for President, which is laughable given his liberal record. Hello,
When Lauren Boebert suddenly announced that she was packing up her bags and leaving Western Colorado, we were all shocked. But maybe we shouldn’t have been.
My husband Adam Frisch ran against Boebert in 2022 and came just 546 votes short of defeating her. Our family, campaign team, and all of our volunteers had worked hard – very hard. Adam drove over 24,000 miles with our son Felix meeting with voters across the entire district. But ultimately, we were out-spent and came up short.
This past year, we decided to give it another go, and we’ve been working even harder than the last campaign. With support from grassroots donors like you, we were out-raising Boebert – and Adam had already driven _another_ 24,000 miles to listen to voters. It looked like we were heading for a win... so Lauren Boebert ran off scared.
**But with Boebert now out of the race, things are going to be harder.** We’ve got a new Republican opponent who is trying to hide his extremism, and the Republican Super PACs are already circling to try to stop us from winning.

Thanks for being a part of this, Peter.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE TUESDAY, OCTOBER 1 KELLY LOEFFLER AND JEFF SPRECHER ANNOUNCE $500,000 DONATION TO HURRICANE HELENE RELIEF EFFORT ORGANIZED BY PRESIDENT TRUMP
ATLANTA - Today, former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler (R-GA) and Jeff Sprecher announced a $500,000 contribution to President Donald Trump's [GoFundMe campaign](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ED-u5Scn1nsjduYIcxZHCI6K-LqJdVLMWMYXccllneV54rJH1f9Y35Q-zN01o4AB9yvAXZTaxrb6L5MxRwoWeBcn0k1VF24NpEQttR6C11EXB5W26Ul4mGfV5liQj5rBoD_LCsQ3irqj4gIWp8tsu3kY5A_I13Xole2x5LvP_HjZB1Kya-uAlcx_2Zjdd2RiAm6KVEuoRmtwNRRH6hZ3dB7edzTxVzV_rSo_LXiYXbw=&c=bofzL7XDbtXZcBO1dn9Z7v-OkHJOXt8dOVntkMHjsI688syiFI6KTQ==&ch=OmCqRny5KgIafVa84BFBpqyfn5Okz_yzAEk7KL8MN5ZS5hhenLlrHQ==) in support of Hurricane Helene victims. The fundraiser, which has raised over $3.4 million from more than 20,000 donors, was launched yesterday by President Trump after he joined Georgia officials, including Senator Loeffler, in Valdosta - where he distributed supplies, comforted victims, and offered support to the community.
"The devastation of this storm is staggering, and my heart aches for the families and farmers across the southeast who have lost their loved ones and livelihoods," said Senator Loeffler. "But as I joined President Trump on the ground in Valdosta yesterday, I was reminded that these impacted communities, including Augusta and Savannah, represent some of the strongest and hardest-working people in our state. The road to recovery will be long, but it will be possible thanks to their resilience."
"To aid in the recovery, Jeff and I are contributing $500,000 to the Hurricane Helene relief fund organized by President Trump. We hope this donation inspires others to join us in supporting the relief and recovery effort. We also want to thank President Trump for his leadership in bringing meaningful aid to Georgia, and for personally joining us on the ground to address the disaster in our state."
President Trump is the only national official who has [visited](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ED-u5Scn1nsjduYIcxZHCI6K-LqJdVLMWMYXccllneV54rJH1f9Y35Q-zN01o4AB0IAWiJgIMyQFtwdJax1ETZtr9-FhcLtPiEeDoLp2JxyCYBwmchVVIb02nj2xbdCGTHMW1cUo87qIgizWh1mNEY8Euwqg2fqaZhFHpcDL1ab4zFqWO30JEp8I-vpiJsqF_ShsMbWOSF_6ejMvs91NFBpCAbXMxBS4d947gcLTEhWFeiBzWfDRHw==&c=bofzL7XDbtXZcBO1dn9Z7v-OkHJOXt8dOVntkMHjsI688syiFI6KTQ==&ch=OmCqRny5KgIafVa84BFBpqyfn5Okz_yzAEk7KL8MN5ZS5hhenLlrHQ==) any of the states impacted by the historic devastation of Hurricane Helene. While in Valdosta yesterday, he met with local officials, first responders, and storm victims. He brought fuel, water, and other supplies for the community - and offered words of encouragement to the more than two thousand locals who joined him to hear his remarks.
The proceeds of President Trump's GoFundMe will be distributed to storm victims in Georgia and across the southeast. To join in contributing to the fundraiser, please click [HERE](https://8mpsjjfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ED-u5Scn1nsjduYIcxZHCI6K-LqJdVLMWMYXccllneV54rJH1f9Y35Q-zN01o4AB9yvAXZTaxrb6L5MxRwoWeBcn0k1VF24NpEQttR6C11EXB5W26Ul4mGfV5liQj5rBoD_LCsQ3irqj4gIWp8tsu3kY5A_I13Xole2x5LvP_HjZB1Kya-uAlcx_2Zjdd2RiAm6KVEuoRmtwNRRH6hZ3dB7edzTxVzV_rSo_LXiYXbw=&c=bofzL7XDbtXZcBO1dn9Z7v-OkHJOXt8dOVntkMHjsI688syiFI6KTQ==&ch=OmCqRny5KgIafVa84BFBpqyfn5Okz_yzAEk7KL8MN5ZS5hhenLlrHQ==).

subject: Project 2025 puts me at risk
body:
As a Venezuelan immigrant, I’ve seen firsthand how difficult it is to restore democracy after it’s lost. | | | Peter, My name is Victor, I am a Venezuelan immigrant, and Project 2025 scares the sh*t out of me. I, along with eight million fellow Venezuelans, have fled our country to escape a severe humanitarian crisis and a repressive authoritarian government. I was granted Temporary Protected Status — _something Project 2025 plans on immediately eliminating._ **Millions of American families could be immediately torn apart.** The worst part is that Project 2025 also wants to make it easier for ICE to target, racially profile, and terrorize our communities — allowing them to perform raids at our schools, hospitals, and places of worship. One thing is clear: **Project 2025 aims to make our immigrant communities and people of color feel unsafe everywhere — whether at home, work, school, church, or simply walking in our neighborhood.** As a Venezuelan immigrant, I’ve seen firsthand how incredibly difficult it is to restore democracy after it’s lost. clean_body: As a Venezuelan immigrant, I’ve seen firsthand how difficult it is to restore democracy after it’s lost. | | | Peter, My name is Victor, I am a Venezuelan immigrant, and Project 2025 scares the sht out of me. I, along with eight million fellow Venezuelans, have fled our country to escape a severe humanitarian crisis and a repressive authoritarian government. I was granted Temporary Protected Status — something Project 2025 plans on immediately eliminating. Millions of American families could be immediately torn apart. The worst part is that Project 2025 also wants to make it easier for ICE to target, racially profile, and terrorize our communities — allowing them to perform raids at our schools, hospitals, and places of worship. One thing is clear: Project 2025 aims to make our immigrant communities and people of color feel unsafe everywhere — whether at home, work, school, church, or simply walking in our neighborhood. As a Venezuelan immigrant, I’ve seen firsthand how incredibly difficult it is to restore democracy after it’s lost. I don’t want to see that happen here — but if the authoritarian blueprint that is Project 2025 is enacted, that is where we’ll be. But his actual stance couldn't be clearer. **Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**MIN RAISES OVER $2 MILLION FOR QUARTER 3**
_Mo-MIN-tum Continues For Democrat In Key Congressional Race _
**IRVINE, CA** — The Dave Min for Congress campaign announced today that it had raised over $2 million from more than 17,000 individual donors—**including more than 14,000 new donors** —in the third fundraising quarter of this year, continuing its incredible momentum since the March 5 primary election. This is an improvement on Min’s already impressive Quarter 2 raise of $1.37M, indiciating growing support in the district and across the nation. By contrast, Republican Scott Baugh’s numbers have continued to sag miserably ever since Kevin McCarthy stepped down as Speaker of the House last year.

**“14,000 new donors. That’s what matters,” said Dan Driscoll, Campaign Manager at Dave Min for Congress. “While Dave continues to build momentum and bring new supporters into the fold, Scott Baugh has gone back to the well of his same old cronies: Big Oil, Big Tobacco, the anit-abortion lobby, charter schools and gun manufacturers. They like Baugh because they know he’s a dog on a leash. Grassroots momentum is behind Dave Min because voters know he is accountable to one thing: his constituents.”** ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=704f4e5e14&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44%. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

Every few years, editors of major news publications wring their hands publicly, and promise that they finally figured it out.
After enabling George W. Bush's illegal wars of aggression, they [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/ad9234d9-76ee-4b30-9579-5cbf871358f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to have learned from years of deferring to Pentagon lies, and pledged more independent coverage depicting America's foreign policy. Last year, NPR's Pien Huang [noted](https://substack.com/redirect/9099901d-d172-4129-8434-355d8c0a87d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that "Journalists played a huge role in the spread of misinformation that led to the war of Iraq," and went on to wonder, "[H]ow do so many journalists from some of the nation's top institutions get it so wrong?"
After enabling Trump's election in 2016 and his subsequent war on the Constitution, they claimed to have learned how [their editorial decisions effectively put him in office](https://substack.com/redirect/f601a8d8-18de-44ec-a587-57165b8868bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and made a great show of announcing plans to do better this year.
Yet the reality suggests otherwise. Tonight's vice presidential debate offers a disappointing case study.
Yesterday's Republicans have become today's Democrats. Today's Republicans are yesterday's fascists. And journalists continue to play a crucial role enabling the shift to the right.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ea17ea3a-f018-4989-8a0e-561921e0cff8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **The main event**
The presidential candidates from the corporate political parties, Kamala Harris and Donald Trump, [faced off once](https://substack.com/redirect/211b60b3-bb41-446e-a663-a765883f9668?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a televised debate about a month ago.
Predictably, Harris--a seasoned debater, prosecutor and relatively serious politician whose [ideological conservatism](https://substack.com/redirect/c9b81217-0f01-449f-bb1f-931cc78d1f4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has been largely covered up by journalists--[dominated](https://substack.com/redirect/4a0e43aa-5699-43d7-8f24-e31c286fd05e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Trump. Trump responded by [ducking](https://substack.com/redirect/d5b8d093-2ff2-4c2e-9e66-b6dd41883aac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) any further debates, rendering that one appearance the only example voters will have to discern a direct contrast between the figures at the top of the respective tickets.
Precisely because those opportunities will be so rare, tonight's vice presidential debate attains increasing importance. That's not the only reason why, however.

### **The future of the Republican Party**
Trump has taken over the Republican party and, in the style of a wrecking ball, more or less transformed its ideology. Yesterday's Republicans have become today's Democrats. Today's Republicans are yesterday's fascists. And journalists continue to play a crucial role enabling the shift to the right.
For better or worse, Donald Trump is old and inevitably destined--like all of us--to move beyond this life one day. Given that, the voice of J.D. Vance, as the vice presidential nominee of the Republican Party, has even greater significance given his influence over the future direction of the party.
That's more or less why he was chosen as Trump's nominee in the first place. At the time, Biden was still in the race, Trump was up in the polls, and Vance appeared to Republican operatives like a chance to reinforce critical values among the right wing base, paving a foundation for the indefinite future of fascism in America.
Like Senator Josh Hawley from Missouri (my home state, which was the epicenter of both the movement for Black lives responding to the murder of Mike Brown in 2014, as well as today's right wing attacks on trans communities and students), Vance is one of the intellectual architects of the contemporary right wing movement.
Understanding his background, his views, his policy prescriptions, and his political vulnerabilities is critical for this November's election.
But most voters won't ever have a chance to hear all of the perspectives--or even the most important ones--about Vance's voice.
### **Reporters suppressing news yet again **
Voters rely on mass media to gather information about any number of things related to elections. That's one reason why the press enjoys (an increasingly theoretical, and relatively [meaningless version](https://substack.com/redirect/c61dfc55-776b-4e24-bc47-2f22ec6c5cd4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of) freedom guaranteed under the First Amendment.
But what happens when the press refuses to inform the public, and instead suppresses vital information that could inform voters?
That's not a hypothetical question, but rather a description of what is happening today under our feet--[not for the first time](https://substack.com/redirect/0ff60935-3f10-44cc-9098-2637af423556?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

Independent reporter [Ken Klippenstein](https://substack.com/@kenklippenstein) (whose Substack column I highly recommend) posted [a dossier about Vance](https://substack.com/redirect/0d9abba2-ea69-4f48-934b-f7a37689ff0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) compiled by the Trump campaign in the weeks before he was nominated as Trump's running mate. The dossier is critical to understand for several reasons, yet it remains suppressed by major news outlets because it was obtained through sources that may have included a foreign intelligence agency.
First, the dossier reveals the Trump campaign's view of Vance, at a time before Trump & Vance joined forces. That timing offers critical insight--not only about Vance, but also about Trump, his vanities, and the apparent ignorance of his campaign team, which omitted from the dossier any reference to Vance's controversial views about gender that have helped drag their campaign down in the polls and turn the race into a relative tossup.
Second, it confirms the frailty of Trump's ego. Most of the dossier relates to the extent to which Vance had humiliated him in the past, and potential tension among their viewpoints. In this context, the most significant aspect of the dossier is its documentary confirmation that the Trump-Pence campaign, and the Republican Party more broadly, have been reduced to a mere cult of personality.
### **Double standards and widely shared failure**
It's not as if the dossier lacks newsworthy information. And press outlets have published even less newsworthy leaks from presidential campaigns before, including emails surreptitiously obtained from Hillary Clinton's campaign published in 2016.
Double standards aside, what this moment reveals is the unanimity among editors proudly committed to suppressing the news and impeding public transparency. It's not simply the case that a handful of editors have declined to offer voters the information included within the dossier and insinuated by its various omissions.
The editors of every major news publication have agreed--not in favor of transparency, not in favor of accountability, and not in favor of empowering voters to make fully informed decisions, but instead, in favor of empowering themselves to remain gatekeepers of critical information, and to suppress it at a crucial time.
As much as tonight's debate offers a rare moment of transparency and the 2024 presidential election, the most important thing about it is how journalists continue to do everything possible to keep voters in the dark.

But don't expect news sources to actually offer all the information available about the vice presidential candidates | | | Oct 1| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | Every few years, editors of major news publications wring their hands publicly, and promise that they finally figured it out. After enabling George W. Bush's illegal wars of aggression, they to have learned from years of deferring to Pentagon lies, and pledged more independent coverage depicting America's foreign policy. Last year, NPR's Pien Huang that "Journalists played a huge role in the spread of misinformation that led to the war of Iraq," and went on to wonder, "[H]ow do so many journalists from some of the nation's top institutions get it so wrong?" After enabling Trump's election in 2016 and his subsequent war on the Constitution, they claimed to have learned how , and made a great show of announcing plans to do better this year. Yet the reality suggests otherwise. Tonight's vice presidential debate offers a disappointing case study. Yesterday's Republicans have become today's Democrats. Today's Republicans are yesterday's fascists. And journalists continue to play a crucial role enabling the shift to the right. | | ---|---|--- The main event The presidential candidates from the corporate political parties, Kamala Harris and Donald Trump, in a televised debate about a month ago. Predictably, Harris--a seasoned debater, prosecutor and relatively serious politician whose has been largely covered up by journalists-- Trump. Trump responded by any further debates, rendering that one appearance the only example voters will have to discern a direct contrast between the figures at the top of the respective tickets. Precisely because those opportunities will be so rare, tonight's vice presidential debate attains increasing importance. That's not the only reason why, however. Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts, sign up for a free subscription and you 'll get an email whenever I post a new story. To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber. I would love to be able to dedicate more time to writing. The future of the Republican Party Trump has taken over the Republican party and, in the style of a wrecking ball, more or less transformed its ideology. Yesterday's Republicans have become today's Democrats. Today's Republicans are yesterday's fascists. And journalists continue to play a crucial role enabling the shift to the right. For better or worse, Donald Trump is old and inevitably destined--like all of us--to move beyond this life one day. Given that, the voice of J.D. Vance, as the vice presidential nominee of the Republican Party, has even greater significance given his influence over the future direction of the party. That's more or less why he was chosen as Trump's nominee in the first place. At the time, Biden was still in the race, Trump was up in the polls, and Vance appeared to Republican operatives like a chance to reinforce critical values among the right wing base, paving a foundation for the indefinite future of fascism in America. Like Senator Josh Hawley from Missouri (my home state, which was the epicenter of both the movement for Black lives responding to the murder of Mike Brown in 2014, as well as today's right wing attacks on trans communities and students), Vance is one of the intellectual architects of the contemporary right wing movement. Understanding his background, his views, his policy prescriptions, and his political vulnerabilities is critical for this November's election. But most voters won't ever have a chance to hear all of the perspectives--or even the most important ones--about Vance's voice. Reporters suppressing news yet again Voters rely on mass media to gather information about any number of things related to elections. That's one reason why the press enjoys (an increasingly theoretical, and relatively of) freedom guaranteed under the First Amendment. But what happens when the press refuses to inform the public, and instead suppresses vital information that could inform voters? That's not a hypothetical question, but rather a description of what is happening today under our feet--. Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! This post is public so feel free to share it. Independent reporter (whose Substack column I highly recommend) posted compiled by the Trump campaign in the weeks before he was nominated as Trump's running mate. The dossier is critical to understand for several reasons, yet it remains suppressed by major news outlets because it was obtained through sources that may have included a foreign intelligence agency. First, the dossier reveals the Trump campaign's view of Vance, at a time before Trump & Vance joined forces. That timing offers critical insight--not only about Vance, but also about Trump, his vanities, and the apparent ignorance of his campaign team, which omitted from the dossier any reference to Vance's controversial views about gender that have helped drag their campaign down in the polls and turn the race into a relative tossup. Second, it confirms the frailty of Trump's ego. Most of the dossier relates to the extent to which Vance had humiliated him in the past, and potential tension among their viewpoints. In this context, the most significant aspect of the dossier is its documentary confirmation that the Trump-Pence campaign, and the Republican Party more broadly, have been reduced to a mere cult of personality. Double standards and widely shared failure It's not as if the dossier lacks newsworthy information. And press outlets have published even less newsworthy leaks from presidential campaigns before, including emails surreptitiously obtained from Hillary Clinton's campaign published in 2016. Double standards aside, what this moment reveals is the unanimity among editors proudly committed to suppressing the news and impeding public transparency. It's not simply the case that a handful of editors have declined to offer voters the information included within the dossier and insinuated by its various omissions. The editors of every major news publication have agreed--not in favor of transparency, not in favor of accountability, and not in favor of empowering voters to make fully informed decisions, but instead, in favor of empowering themselves to remain gatekeepers of critical information, and to suppress it at a crucial time. As much as tonight's debate offers a rare moment of transparency and the 2024 presidential election, the most important thing about it is how journalists continue to do everything possible to keep voters in the dark. name: Maureen Braun
subject: Why Mike is the Right Choice for Indiana—From Someone Who Knows Him Best!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE INDIANA REPUBLICAN STATE COMMITTEE
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
Dear Friend,

You may know my husband, Mike Braun, is running for Governor, but I want to tell you more. I have been married to him for 48 years, and I know he will make the best Governor Indiana has ever had! Let me share with you why.
His approach is entrepreneurial, and he has experience rolling up his sleeves and working tirelessly to transform a small company headquartered in Jasper, Indiana into a successful national organization. He sees opportunities that others miss. He handles difficult situations with calmness and persistence. He is a leader and works well with others, even when there are differing opinions. He is not only book smart; he is street smart.

His hands-on experience managing a company for over 40 years separates him from his opponents as he truly understands how to implement solutions that work. His experience as a U.S. Senator enables him to understand all the national issues while also having personal connections with other Senators and Governors. His years serving in Indiana’s House for District 63 have given him firsthand experience with the legislature while also having personal connections with many current members. His years on the Greater Jasper Consolidated School Board have given him insight into how to truly make a difference in the education of our children at all levels. His knowledge gained from conversations with our grown children gives him perspective on today's youth.
His Indiana roots run deep, and so does his passion for his home-state. Mike has visited all 92 counties for five years in a row as a US Senator, and he will complete that goal again this year. He is truly committed to listening to learn the priorities on Hoosiers’ minds: property taxes, high cost of living, health care, inflation, childcare, education, poor roads, rural broadband, small business and agriculture issues, safety, and the list goes on.

What I can promise you is that Mike will get results. He brings people together to brainstorm ideas so that everyone has the opportunity to work together. He is very creative in solving problems. He is very cost-conscious and gets the best value for a solution. He looks both short- term and long-term.
Mike is focused on what he can do for YOU and INDIANA! He knows he can make a difference and is willing to do the hard work to get the job done. Other states will look to Indiana as an example of freedom and opportunity, creativity and courage. Mike could be hunting, fishing, working in his native Indiana garden, or walking the woods, but instead he is committed to giving back to Indiana and sharing what he has learned. He has so much knowledge to give.

How can you help? Please forward this letter to everyone you know in Indiana. Family. Friends. Neighbors. Coworkers. Business connections. Add your personal note to the email. The fact that you have connected with us in some way will help others to spread the word. We need you! Early voting begins October 8. Election Day is November 5. Every vote counts. Every email or letter is appreciated. Donations are very much
appreciated! [www.mikebraunforindiana.com](http://links.email.in-gop.com/u/click?_t=9a0b7d408bc44ce9bb6828c91a267dbf&_m=ca1b10e764c2466f9a99547edfbc9adf&_e=t4ODth6VpFEoQvl4LJdgdxewE17F3xfqAOA1Ldk9vcr_42pkvtkaDpiaQ4-nUPev3f0kFlpy_nwi4en06MJ94bdHhcQFW5dWKlYdDEqZCuBB-u01KCrFdpTgEYp8LsMurMmmR0plTDUtN2ZA5CHI-Fw-gFjl6mbhKAasX7Ku410Q6Sl87UH4Vf3vhVPpqMouJPRCEzvSxlO08u7kw9mVCQ%3D%3D)

This election will affect our country at all levels, especially how much our government will spend in the future, putting the burden on our children and grandchildren. That’s why the Governor's race is so important: It truly impacts our daily lives. Mike, as Governor, will know how to save Indiana money while managing the budget wisely.
We need your vote because Governor races are always very close, so please get your family and friends to vote for Mike Braun for Governor!
Sincerely,

Hey, y’all! Goodness — how the time flies by! We’re just five weeks out from Election Day, and there is NO ONE I’d rather have on my team through this final stretch. | | | As together we pray for and make our plans to watch tonight’s vice presidential debate at 9 pm ET, _**[p](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=fa1e67a895&e=43463f1dee)[](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=66d59b7deb&e=43463f1dee)****l**[ease also watch and ](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=24018021ce&e=43463f1dee)[share ](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=0085058911&e=43463f1dee)[this new Evangelicals for Harris](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=877d8e7791&e=43463f1dee)[ ad ](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=bc4c9f5057&e=43463f1dee)[to inspire others to vote for Governor Walz,](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=be0ba6a9eb&e=43463f1dee)_

Carly was a “youth group kid” in high school who was bullied for openly expressing her Christian faith. But when her teacher Mr. Walz saw what was happening, he put a stop to the bullying. **Then** **_Tim Walz took the time to pull Carly aside and encourage her to always be herself and never fear sharing her Christian faith and what was most important to her in life._**

That experience inspired Carly to become a public school teacher who was recently named “**Teacher of the Year”** in her Texas school district.

Some think the role of Vice President isn’t important. At Evangelicals for Harris, we think it’s very important because our votes are a witness to our faith. **We need leaders like Governor Tim Walz with the character and compassion to live a life of public service and lift up the vulnerable like Carly was when she was bullied.**

__**Please use the links below to share this video and inspire others. Please also pray that Governor Walz does his best tonight.**__ Thank you for all you do. We’re praying for you.

I have always been committed to serving my community with purpose. I served first in the State Legislature, and now I’m running for Congress to help protect our freedoms and ensure our democracy. **[I want to share my story (and a few old pictures) with you, but if you are already with me, please split a gift to help me flip Arizona’s First Congressional District »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060958/502386577/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)** | [CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060959/502386578/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)

My parents are Indian immigrants who came to America seeking a better life as engineering students. They raised me in an environment where education was revered as the cornerstone of success.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060960/502386579/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)
_Me and my mother_
I went to medical school, trained in Emergency Medicine, and helped the NFL develop emergency protocols for their players. I eventually moved to Arizona, where I still practice as an ER doctor today.
**As a physician, I see firsthand the effects of skyrocketing prescription drug costs and the detrimental consequences when the government tries to legislate personal healthcare decisions.**
**And I see a need for leadership that will fix these problems, not shrug their shoulders and sweep them under the rug. **
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060961/502386580/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)
I ran for local office _(and won),_ and I have dedicated my life to public service ever since.
I am proud of the work I have done in the Arizona House of Representatives. I helped defeat one of the most restrictive abortion bans in the legislature, and protected access to mifepristone. **_And with bipartisan support, I passed more bills than any Arizona Democrat in decades. _**
**But my work is not done yet. Extreme politicians are playing games with our healthcare, with Social Security, and with a woman’s right to choose.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060962/502386581/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)
That is why I am running for US Congress in Arizona's first district.
**We need a leader willing to work across the aisle to bring home real solutions for Arizonans.** On Election Day, Maricopa County has the opportunity to stand up for our values at the ballot box and flip AZ-01 blue.
I am ready for the tough fight ahead, but I cannot do it alone.
**[Please, will you chip in any amount to help me win this toss-up race? I am tied in the polls, and anything you can give now will make a difference in our fight. »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94060963/502386582/-1201645270?refcode=AU_AZD_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20241001_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjk4MDU2ZDItMzE4MC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=uZ8Xso6mznzF4Ix6Id9GLcCG0Ob0Yl5VoobnuiXsJWo=)**

Everything we care about – from protecting Medicare and Social Security to ensuring our communities have what they need to thrive – is on the line. That's why knowing you’re standing with us gives me confidence that we have what it takes to fight back, and win. But make no mistake – October is going to be tough. The attacks from my deep-pocketed opponent are only going to ramp up, which means our goals are going to be even more ambitious, and this race is about to get even more competitive. I’ve never been one to back down from a fight before, and I don't plan on starting now. That’s why I’m asking for your continued support as we head into this final stretch. This is a massive win for our clients, the people they serve, and for reproductive rights. [**And it's all made possible by YOU.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94062376/502389640/1124227485?sourceid=1149875&utm_campaign=25emaab-1001aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGFhYmIwOC0zNTgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiCeg9NlmQ5l4E0646mU1EqBCDqwdIbswqWuTmVTbwY=&emci=d872d856-2d80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fdaabb08-3580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

The court ruled that the ban was unconstitutional, finding that the state constitution prohibits government interference with abortion decisions before viability. This ruling recognizes that the Georgia constitution protects the right to abortion and expands access across the region. | [**KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94062377/502389641/1124227485?sourceid=1149875&utm_campaign=25emaab-1001aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGFhYmIwOC0zNTgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiCeg9NlmQ5l4E0646mU1EqBCDqwdIbswqWuTmVTbwY=&emci=d872d856-2d80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fdaabb08-3580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237 "KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING")

Judge Robert McBurney didn't just strike down the law, but criticized it for forcing women to be "human incubators." He stated, _"Women are not some piece of collectively owned community property the disposition of which is decided by majority vote."_

This victory comes less than three weeks after a North Dakota judge struck down that state's abortion ban in a separate case The Center is litigating. In fact, the Georgia decision cites our North Dakota win.

We're determined to sustain this momentum to strike down other abortion bans and build state constitutional protections nationwide. [**That's why we're EXTENDING OUR 3X MATCH FOR 24 MORE HOURS!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94062378/502389642/1124227485?sourceid=1149875&utm_campaign=25emaab-1001aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGFhYmIwOC0zNTgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiCeg9NlmQ5l4E0646mU1EqBCDqwdIbswqWuTmVTbwY=&emci=d872d856-2d80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fdaabb08-3580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

This critical win, led by the Center for Reproductive Rights alongside our partners, means that clinicians can once again provide vital care without fear of criminalization. [**Your support allows the Center to fight for abortion rights in court—and the rulings in Georgia and North Dakota prove that when we fight, we can win!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94062379/502389643/1124227485?sourceid=1149875&utm_campaign=25emaab-1001aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=georgia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZGFhYmIwOC0zNTgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hiCeg9NlmQ5l4E0646mU1EqBCDqwdIbswqWuTmVTbwY=&emci=d872d856-2d80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fdaabb08-3580-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=954237)

Even this fight continues: as I write, Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr has already filed an appeal to the state Supreme Court to reinstate the six-week ban—but we plan to fight back to preserve this win and ensure every Georgian can access the care they need.

This ruling recognizes that the Georgia constitution protects the right to abortion and expands access across the region. | "KEEP THE MOMENTUM GOING" Judge Robert McBurney didn't just strike down the law, but criticized it for forcing women to be "human incubators." He stated, "Women are not some piece of collectively owned community property the disposition of which is decided by majority vote." This victory comes less than three weeks after a North Dakota judge struck down that state's abortion ban in a separate case The Center is litigating. In fact, the Georgia decision cites our North Dakota win. We're determined to sustain this momentum to strike down other abortion bans and build state constitutional protections nationwide. This critical win, led by the Center for Reproductive Rights alongside our partners, means that clinicians can once again provide vital care without fear of criminalization. Even this fight continues: as I write, Georgia Attorney General Chris Carr has already filed an appeal to the state Supreme Court to reinstate the six-week ban—but we plan to fight back to preserve this win and ensure every Georgian can access the care they need. "TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT" Your donation today helps us: Defend this victory in Georgia. Challenge similar bans across the country. * Protect reproductive rights for everyone. Thank you for your partnership, today and every day. We couldn’t do it without you. Onward, Alice Wang Staff Attorney P.S. Our work is far from over—18 states still ban abortion completely or after six weeks of pregnancy, before many even know they are pregnant.
