body:
Democrats on high alert | | |
---
The battle for the Senate is in high gear and the outcome will have major implications for our nation irrespective who wins the White House. Here's an update on eight of the top U.S. Senate races: **TEXAS **– Senator **Ted Cruz** (R) faces Congressman **Colin Allred** (D) who is backed by a mountain of liberal cash. Senate Democrats named Cruz as their #1 Target to flip a state from red to blue. A recent Emerson College poll shows that Allred's cash has pushed him to within 4 points. Now Ted Cruz is out with TV ads that expose how Colin Allred voted against a bill to keep boys out of girls' sports. **MONTANA** – Ex-Navy SEAL **Tim Sheehy** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jon Tester** (D) in the race that could strip the Democrats of their majority. Tester is the #1 recipient of lobbyist money and he's been a rubber stamp for the Biden-Harris agenda. Tester has tricked Montana voters for years, but they aren't being fooled this time. The Real Clear Politics polling average has Sheehy leading Tester by 5 points, which has Democrats on high alert. **WISCONSIN** – Businessman **Eric Hovde** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Tammy Baldwin** (D) in a presidential battleground state. Unlike many vulnerable Democrats running this year, Baldwin has actually embraced Kamala Harris and her extreme positions. Despite being attacked with millions on the other side, Hovde is exposing Baldwin's record and making the case for change. He trailed by 8 points back in June, but cut Baldwin's lead down to 4 points. **NEVADA** – Combat Army veteran **Sam Brown** (R) is challenging incumbent Senator **Jacky Rosen** (D). Brown nearly burned to death after he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban, and his vehicle hit a roadside bomb. But after 3 years and 30 surgeries, he recovered and is now running for the U.S. Senate. Brown trails Rosen by single digits according to recent polls, but the race will tighten as Brown spends his war chest and voters learn about the choice they have in this race.

The Kamala "interview"
Last week Kamala Harris did her first solo "interview" with Stephanie Ruhle on MSNBC. I used air quotes for a reason -- that wasn't an interview, it was an embarrassment on both sides.
A week ago, Stephanie Ruhle, an MSNBC host, went on Bill Maher's weekend HBO show and declared that Donald Trump was a threat to the country and democracy. She went even further and made the case that Kamala doesn't need to answer questions because, well, Trump is so bad, we shouldn't really care -- just take what ever the alternative is -- and that alternative is Harris. Here is the clip if you want to see what I'm talking about https://x.com/RoadMN/status/1839104722537512967
Well, last night was proof she really didn't to have answer questions...

[**If you are sick and tired of the Mainstream Media and Radical Left setting our country behind while they engage in forever wars abroad, I need you to donate to my campaign before midnight.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b83f67a28afa4774b8f205063b5ccc03&_e=-r_LUNEfbROW1VZeUZtnqb9j57MFGFBgKNXIpa4iolK5pW04clYVyDqX1tDbRFX7z-08NL4-wV1o39ipHsVEMtRpOGOKfYx225WbcphhqY97Ei2vyhijY-TmANeci7FcG32iBhGGiBsibjS90a0XDl6rQHJJOC5SqO24duzDbXefKCBx1BnexSElhSx9ngxsq0jf4pXYA87_IQbsjRMFs22XWGMze138LV3RIsunCn3hG-WLp9Zu_8W_unZB3uNuqgrBHOzP4iv70L9Uk81tAxMteZ7pAocudtqyAXJTEC23gUSsOlxMbNTrC9BhpMI8)

That’s why a lot of people duck around me.

Our country is bankrupt... Close the border and end the wars!

[**If you agree with me – even a little bit – you need to donate at least $5 to my campaign before midnight.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b83f67a28afa4774b8f205063b5ccc03&_e=-r_LUNEfbROW1VZeUZtnqb9j57MFGFBgKNXIpa4iolK5pW04clYVyDqX1tDbRFX7z-08NL4-wV1o39ipHsVEMtRpOGOKfYx225WbcphhqY97Ei2vyhijY-TmANeci7FcG32iBhGGiBsibjS90a0XDt2bOuq8_Cmn3AK_c0vY7xrOFkKPDR0bO07IKgYTXVx1YKWNry_9TAhrO0QpuY75m-ldpIy4Muk3nifHlWs-flv9iHQKaqbiNLqApdP7suHFMQbE3HuO8Woc9Jqo8oZkE4BHakSFQ12IyEvki6s7qdPABWK6FAFSnvZDnnu5TQCf)

I’m running for U.S. Senate – the first person born in the 1990s to do so – to break the wheel of political corruption and start putting Americans first.

Endless debt, forever wars abroad, and a wide-open border. That’s my opponent’s platform. Amy Klobuchar has been making our country worse off ever since she rode Obama’s coattails and took office in 2009.

[**I’m not asking for much, even $10 or $25 will make a huge difference.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b83f67a28afa4774b8f205063b5ccc03&_e=-r_LUNEfbROW1VZeUZtnqb9j57MFGFBgKNXIpa4iolK5pW04clYVyDqX1tDbRFX7z-08NL4-wV1o39ipHsVEMtRpOGOKfYx225WbcphhqY97Ei2vyhijY-TmANeci7FcG32iBhGGiBsibjS90a0XDl6rQHJJOC5SqO24duzDbXfpcRo-5RptPGgPH8ZwdMjSGS1gQ8yiQAlRHNtK46tTO4lNf8UAT0Lk-iB59EXTbortKRzBhx0ayqTBYBJl3gVl9wrpJ8EettSjClW_TshMJgH547X4a_s7Ildtj1d4oDBFUYoiBLnl5E94UCRi8S2W)

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: you did it, Peter!
body:
Dear Peter,

Because of your generosity, Students for Life Action blew past our $125,000 End of Quarter Matching Challenge goal and raised $XXX,XXX total!

With everything that’s at stake in 2024, I can’t even begin to tell you how much I appreciate the AMAZING generosity of all our supporters.

I know you’re getting A TON of emails asking for money (I am!).

And I know it probably feels sometimes like you can’t ever do enough.

But I don’t want you to feel like that, Peter.

I want you to know what a critical part of our team you are.

The truth is, your generosity is making a tremendous impact and is paving the way for that wonderful day when abortion is finally abolished in the United States!

Reaching this Matching Challenge goal, means a $XXX,XXX shot in the arm for Students for Life Action to kick off our fall programs, including:

>>> DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING.

Each door we knock on costs less than $3 each. And studies show that nothing makes more of an impact on a voter than a face-to-face conversation. And that impact lasts beyond one election cycle. Voters who are talked to personally in one election are more likely to vote in subsequent elections;

>>> THE “VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST” DIGITAL CAMPAIGN.

Our “Vote Pro-Life First” Digital Campaign runs targeted, survey-style ads to young people aged 18-35 who we’ve identified as swing voters with a low propensity to turn out. We’ve found we can secure a pledge to “Vote Pro-Life First” from these young voters for less than $2;

>>> CAMPUS OUTREACH.

Our student leaders will host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvassing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride;

>>> EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS.

The Left holds a big advantage in early voter turnout, which must be stopped. That’s why SFLAction is prepared to target ideal voter bases like mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting; and

>>> PHONE BANKS AND TEXTING.

Time-tested methods like peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.

And none of this is possible without your support.

Whether it’s giving financially, signing petitions, taking action, or keeping us in your prayers as we travel the nation to take on pro-abortion radicals, your support truly means the world to us.

None of what we do would be possible without you and the thousands of other supporters across the country.

Peter, from the bottom of my heart, thank you!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

Semper Fi,

**Kevin Lincoln**
Veteran, USMC
GOP Nominee, CA-9

| **Meet Kevin Lincoln
**
My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

Fellow Patriot,

I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today.

_**I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end.**_

Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT6QSwRH7ZAX7e7aHMJ-Zxgpwrvyze2zUeKC9Fksqorqp_YbsOk0sTajC1Nzw0ylIm99Jizwr8vGrj-EG5mfwiwqj2CM4_E3IV3aEUx7Z5AOLZ-E-s0vH9PsvkhVOuiSkunD-QzQQZ_Q_1u0vQcKVl8JA%3D%3D)

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT69YR8fceREKSyaqqLMiZebIwy4ZygPNCY2SDdPEIOjz6NdQrodpUbTo4zT8RZxOayCVVdLL6GeDVKhbBEcEG0WQWBaZDFAbUSEBLCrzod56tRVYtY9P2kp2v1JzPE-9fKE20UcS2L0010tJRg23PdKQ%3D%3D)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT6MMaV2LMmi7M3f9VGs7CmhagVwlLc0ZQFUYCuc2M3cs9b0CCM69p5xtOv2jNbvxAkb-1JmGjbeLs8ytd6Y3Xqen3hJCTotsolJKOaMWeB8CWqz-AB3ssIhFB6nkJLLq5LqiqJz-9KoKnlzYWItCyNuw%3D%3D)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT6b_NtPcoCaL3CphCVmRg_0LAQSw3TteU8YSKc9dkdCWiHi4TRWbOEVKZ6BMvCGDyf0faTRgwizSlFgfx0_IC7RoLgeaCIhHP_XaFuf7jqfcX31nLZZB0NdI_q6y_WaSRpDgACahddd_Ve5ZqBWo7ebQ%3D%3D)

I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg.

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT60bhfKiBIr8YCbdi8dEabbZr7ELAkitRNmwmF9IdDwmuvjAPy6_jbGl1kG3D96Vo77Eglezw5cgU2P_DdjcSiy7bmX8GuoAR3XJ9aXDifp_Th9bE7EErS_h7PpuMMH-ftIVJ0tT3bWqWoAgQeSZWOlg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT6_7Ioh6AtjrMWbnoj70zpFgh1UcUU2pBVHWdkAVZ7o9aCxSqLdUAbzvhiNyz_TsnZUPTpEAUx9nTFMfCmgE83RBOXdxDe58luaon8_v76tMkQzof4xBD5ikeLfsm1S5l4plOk_RZSIG42e6LfFIEiSg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT6BaNBeNqrXV8kqazCVJm2zA0sR6y2WZYj1-ZCf79JLUqRrhnZVV1eKaJTooRdNb3ZXmX5y6yin23oukGFx21fBq66sdOccm6zz1oAGmzI20f1pvV2-GcBcpbp7u1YC4X3d3gQXp3ChEvm4DKR2tAzsA%3D%3D)

[](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=6f42e93e38734933b7bbc3fdf08a8178&_e=760PiSXln8y5si2in-7RSzXX2SByM5z1Vi0A42d2mM-mLZE7Ui2mqTs2HyGuS8MuZc3dtOzvIvODAUch3LzIdzZqBZejbJj1iDr-1xu8YRqUcelynXt8FRJHw-j00iOhSzslDZ0EKVMlVXl2misEig_wjamvEa8U2vKV6ogXJQExGpQRpTlTByAhs9EnKfBqrXFj0kIZPRenDjc1Ejszf8YeqobfzToxqr-_MLss1kgWuiL0942M_Q4jX-NV7qT621o4xY5wIfOKE6l9cByD5DTElGJgWKkzO3gEOzGiyQw8eBRGLp0E02f7Jny1gvmQMhhppoj8oczIL6fpdX66UYcWJdAQWvENyN-4NLdScblI6N40GufmSZXzrYzoNFNZntzt5LdN8gciROxVeRyjYg%3D%3D)

clean_body: I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania Fellow Patriot, I recently went to my home county fair, and it got me thinking about how the small town of Bloomsburg, Pennsylvania and the great people of my county helped shape who I am today. I know this is a long message, but I hope you will read it all the way to the end. Growing up, my family lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road. I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms. My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh. I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg University) at only 34 years old. I'm so proud of my parents' teaching careers and to have been raised in Bloomsburg. It was there that I wrestled and played football and was nominated to the U.S. Military Academy at West Point. And it was there that I came home to a parade after serving in combat during the Gulf War. The small rural town of Bloomsburg shaped who I am. I’m proud to be a 7th–generation Pennsylvanian and I’m ready to get to work to help the great people of our state. All this is to say, I've lived the American Dream, and I am so grateful for the opportunities that America and Pennsylvania have afforded me. BUT, I am worried that the American Dream is slipping away.Career politicians like my opponent Bob Casey and Kamala Harris are doing NOTHING to stop inflation, allowing rampant crime to go unchecked, and allowing dangerous drugs to cross our borders in excess. Their policies have made America weaker, and I can't sit back and let that happen. I'm running for U.S. Senate to shake up the status quo. I know we've only got a little bit of time left until Election Day, and the latest poll has Bob Casey and me in a dead heat. That 's why every dollar during this final stretch is so important. We have a chance to send a leader to Washington who will look out for the great people of our state and put Pennsylvanians first. # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
OCTOBER 1, 2024
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com
**Kevin Faulconer Campaign Calls Out****Terra Lawson-Remer for Gaslighting Public****Over Homeless Task Force Attendance Record**
San Diego, CA – Today, the Kevin Faulconer for Supervisor campaign slammed incumbent Terra Lawson-Remer for gaslighting the public and her supporters after getting caught in a blatant lie about her attendance record at the County’s Regional Task Force on Homelessness. Despite mounting evidence and clear documentation showing Lawson-Remer’s role as vice chair of the task force, she has repeatedly attempted to mislead the public by denying her responsibilities and her failure to show up.
_**"Terra Lawson-Remer was caught red-handedly lying about her role and her attendance at the Regional Task Force on Homelessness," said Kevin Faulconer, candidate for San Diego County Supervisor. "Not only has she missed every single meeting during her time as vice chair, now she’s gaslighting the public and her own supporters by claiming she was never vice chair in the first place. This is an outrageous attempt to rewrite history, but the truth is clear: she’s failed to show up and do her job.”**_
The Regional Task Force on Homelessness [website clearly lists Lawson-Remer as a vice chair](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=31e4ed6239&e=784f78234b), a position that holds critical responsibility in addressing the homelessness crisis in San Diego County. Despite her high-ranking role as the only County representative on the board, she has consistently been absent from every single meeting, contributing to a worsening homelessness crisis under her watch, already at an all-time high.
_**“San Diegans deserve a leader who shows up and takes responsibility—not someone who lies and misleads the public when the truth comes to light,” Faulconer added. “As mayor, I worked across the aisle and brought real solutions to homelessness. It’s time for leadership that will act, not make excuses.”**_
Faulconer’s campaign has pledged to address the homelessness crisis head-on focusing on clearing out dangerous encampments, moving people into shelters, expanding current shelter capacity, and expanding access to mental health services to create wrap-around services to help save lives. Unlike Lawson-Remer, Faulconer will show up and deliver for the people of San Diego County who care deeply about helping people get off the street and into safety.
For more information on Kevin Faulconer’s campaign and his plan to reduce homelessness in San Diego, visit [www.kevinfaulconer.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=a75950ebd2&e=784f78234b)
For more information about Terra’s absences, visit [www.terraisntworking.com](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=9396ce4ac4&e=784f78234b)
###
---
| **Lawson-Remer’s Troubling Pattern of Absenteeism** Her lack of commitment extends beyond the Regional Task Force on Homelessness’ CoC Advisory Board:
* SANDAG Board of Directors: [Her attendance dropped from 90% in 2021 to 50% in 2022. She missed nearly half of all votes.](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=ac578d7e4a&e=784f78234b)

* Shoreline Preservation Group: [She was the sole member assigned and attended just one meeting.](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=bb853d7c0a&e=784f78234b)

* San Diego Air Pollution Control District: [Lawson-Remer missed 60% of meetings in 2022 and has missed every meeting in 2023 and 2024 so thusfar.](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=041475b1a9&e=784f78234b)

* San Diego County Water Authority: [Appointed to safeguard water rates, she has never attended a single meeting.](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=5b54bd9ffb&e=784f78234b)

* Mission Trails Regional Park Task Force: [Missed all but one meeting](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=26258f4c5a&e=784f78234b).

* North San Diego County Transit Development Board: [Zero attendance](https://kevinfaulconer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c8e1915e5d9cc8e4a2f64f766&id=98db860192&e=784f78234b).

body:
June Update

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/crouchforindiana/ppp2gaxknr-12710014?e=8f9fef7158)
September Update
Friends and Fellow Hoosiers,

September is Suicide Prevention Month.

Throughout September, we've taken time to remember those we have lost, support people who have been impacted suicide, and raise awareness.

If you or someone you know is looking for resources in Indiana, please click here (https://mentalhealthroundtable.org/resources/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f8e4d7fbf1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .
Suzanne Crouch
The Hunt Institute 2024 Early Childhood Leadership Summit
Earlier this month, I participated in the Hunt Institute's 2024 Early Childhood Leadership Summit to discuss youth mental health and the strides Indiana has made in early childhood education.

The Hunt Institute is affiliated with the Duke University Sanford School of Public Policy working to transform public education.
LEARN MORE (https://hunt-institute.org/news/policymakers-gubernatorial-staff-local-leaders-and-system-leaders-convene-in-las-vegas-for-the-2024-early-childhood-leadership-summit/?fbclid=IwY2xjawFnuA9leHRuA2FlbQIxMAABHfrQHs_k9AMrY9sIY4eGAkHr2uCiJnHTw8C-81FpcEHp-uOUokWVcYfT8Q_aem_JxW1eUPx857NDSMc9hHsiQ&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f8e4d7fbf1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Brain Days at the 79th United Nations General Assembly
It was an honor to participate in Brain Days at the Science Summit at the 79th United Nations General Assembly. I joined other leaders across the country who are taking steps to address youth mental health. We discussed school based initiatives that attendees could implement in their communities.

LEARN MORE (https://readthereporter.com/lt-gov-crouch-participates-as-panelist-during-brain-days-part-of-79th-united-nations-general-assembly/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f8e4d7fbf1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
In The News
Crouch in Vincennes to Discuss Mental Health
https://www.vincennespbs.org/2024/09/10/crouch-in-vincennes-to-discuss-mental-health/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f8e4d7fbf1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
This month, I continued to host mental health roundtables across the state, most recently in Knox and Hamilton Counties. It was an honor to have representatives from healthcare, education, law enforcement, government, and social services attended to learn about Indiana’s mental health initiatives.
READ MORE (https://www.vincennespbs.org/2024/09/10/crouch-in-vincennes-to-discuss-mental-health/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f8e4d7fbf1-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_04_15_02_29_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-bc92a6a86e-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

body:
I’m grateful beyond words.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20241001&t=1&akid=1248%2E587540%2EcJA5y5)
I’m reaching out today to say thank you, Peter.
Because of a massive show of support from people like you – **September was officially the best month EVER for the Leaders We Deserve email fundraising program.** I am grateful beyond words to everyone who helped make this happen.
When Kevin and I launched this organization last year, we certainly had our high hopes for what we could accomplish. But just more than a year later, the impact we’re already making is not something we could have anticipated or imagined.
Grassroots donations from this phenomenal team have already powered victories, like Nadarius Clark, now the youngest member of the Virginia legislature who already blocked a bill arming teachers, and Molly Cook, who we recently helped become the youngest and first openly-LGBTQ+ member of the Texas Senate.
With just about a month left until Election Day, we’re pulling out all the stops to support our slate of 13 endorsed candidates in must-win races across the nation
Our candidates are young, bold, and unbought by corporate interests. And they’re ready to get to work advocating for our progressive vision for this country’s future.
But here’s the thing: I’ve been on the ground working with these campaigns and I can tell you firsthand that many of them are operating under a shoestring budget. And since they don’t take corporate donations and are unapologetic progressives, **Leaders We Deserve is sometimes the biggest single contributor to their races.**
We are making a REAL difference in these campaigns. And because of people like you getting involved and supporting our mission, I am feeling more optimistic than ever about our chances of electing these young progressive leaders in November.
And I am so excited about the potential for the future – year after year, cycle after cycle, Leaders We Deserve will be here doing the important work of building the Democratic bench and supporting the next generation of progressive leadership. I would not be surprised at all if one of our candidates is elected president one day.
**[Peter, this work is only possible with support from people just like you. Can I count on you to pitch in $5 now in the final stretch before Election Day?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20241001?refcode=em20241001&amount=5&refcode2=1248_587540_cJA5y5&akid=1248%2E587540%2EcJA5y5)**

Thank you for being a part of this.
**David Hogg**
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. Raised by a single mother in public housing, Ritchie personally understands the hardships that working families endure. At age 25, Ritchie made history as the youngest elected official to serve on the New York City Council. Peter — Hurricane Helene has brought unprecedented devastation to our beloved western North Carolina and we’re coordinating a massive effort involving local, multiple state and federal officials and volunteers to help with rescue, food, water, medical supplies and more. Airlifts of supplies along with search and rescue are happening right now as some rivers are still rising. This catastrophic storm brought from 10 to 29 inches of rain in some areas. Hundreds of roads are impassable, power and communications are out in many places and people need both short- and long-term assistance. I and my team are giving this our full 24-7 attention and action. This unprecedented storm requires an unprecedented response and I know many of you want to help. **[Our government is doing everything possible to get assistance to people who need it, but this is a crisis situation, Peter. That’s why I’m personally asking if you could donate $5 or $10 directly to the North Carolina Disaster Relief Fund to ensure they have the resources to respond.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94066673/502399076/1381853763?refcode=ea.1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBhNjNmZC0zYzgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6u8ziaajcFtXojdX6vDgUisFCeyMGB7Ge1L9ZPyUgu8=&emci=b7000e4d-0880-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1049176)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94066674/502399083/1381853763?refcode=ea.1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzBhNjNmZC0zYzgwLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=6u8ziaajcFtXojdX6vDgUisFCeyMGB7Ge1L9ZPyUgu8=&emci=b7000e4d-0880-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=1c0a63fd-3c80-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=1049176)

Peter, it’s Ryan. You know, it’s a special type of gift to wake up and make history. It’s something else entirely to be able to do that _EVERY SINGLE DAY_ — sunrise to sunset. **But Peter, that’s exactly what we're doing. Making history.** Last night, we faced the last quarter-end fundraising deadline before election day — a critical opportunity for our Montana Movement to show our strength and get the resources we need to take on Greg Gianforte in just **35 days.** My team set an ambitious fundraising goal, but Team Busse — _as you always do_ — stepped up to bat when I needed you the most. Thank you for standing with me in this fight, Peter. This campaign has received support like no other in Montana’s history — and that’s for a reason. This isn’t a campaign, it’s a movement. Every day, we come together to push forward with folks who are done with Greg Gianforte’s extremist leadership. _Families who are tired of being ignored and outright harmed by his policies that hurt everyday Montanans and make our Montana unrecognizable._ Sure, I wish it were under better circumstances. I wish we didn’t have to fight this hard to have a governor who respects us and treats us as human beings instead of “needy peasant families.” **But Peter, that’s the reality we’re working with.** This is a real fight, and a tough one at that. But trust me when I say: **there’s no one else I’d rather have by my side to power through it than you.** Thank you for standing with me and telling Gianforte that his BS isn’t going to fly any longer. Now is the time to get our Montana back, so let’s go! — Ryan

body:
It's more important now than ever to show your support.
#
Peter — with so much on the line in this election, there are many reasons to support a candidate you really believe in.
Recently, we heard from some of Lucas’ supporters who shared their reasons for donating to our campaign. We wanted to share some of these reasons with you:
**[SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74597?refcode=em20241001-7887&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7887%2E614464%2EUxwwxc)**
_
**“Initially it was because he was willing to take on Hawley. But after hearing all he stands for, I continue to stand WITH Lucas Kunce solidly.”**
**“I believe we need honest people in Congress. Someone who is looking out for the middle class and seniors so our voices are heard.”**
**“As a veteran, I support those who have served our nation in the military. Hawley is a fraud, pretending to be a tough guy. Tough guys don't need to incite mobs...and they don't run when they see the results of their incitement. [Hawley is] in it for himself.”**
**“To restore reproductive rights to the citizens of Missouri.”**
**"The people of Missouri deserve a Senator who advocates for their needs and wants including abortion rights, voting rights, and Social Security. Lucas is that person — from his early life to years of military service, he has a deep regard for community and country."**

body:

Thank you to everyone who contributed ahead of the last quarterly FEC deadline of the election. With only five weeks left before Election Day, the money we raise now is being put to good use as we execute our voter outreach efforts between now and November 5—and not just to turn out voters for our race but for all the other races we’re involved in this year. That includes electing Vice President Harris, sending Colin Allred to the Senate, and much more.
#TeamLizzie has been hard at work to reach our goal of 25,000 new voter contacts . We’ve been making calls, sending postcards, knocking on doors, and meeting with our partners across Texas to ensure we’re implementing a strong field strategy from now through Election Day.
We’ve also loved being out and about in the district with Harris County Democrats.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2401001wu?refcode=lpfe2401001wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2401001wu?refcode=lpfe2401001wu]
There is less than a week left for Texans to check their registration statuses to ensure they can cast a ballot in the November 5 election. The deadline is this Monday, October 7!
Check your status here and get a registration form. [https://teamrv-mvp.sos.texas.gov/MVP/voterDetails.do] If you’re registered, forward this email to friends and family to make sure they’re registered and ready to vote, too.
We’re keeping our foot on the gas these next five weeks, and we have more volunteer opportunities coming up this week:
Our next phone bank [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678056/] is tomorrow, October 2, from 4-7 p.m.
Our next postcard party [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678043/] is this Thursday, October 3, with shifts from 10 a.m. to noon and 6-8 p.m.
Our next block walk [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/] is this Saturday, October 5, from 9 a.m. to noon and noon to 3 p.m.
If everyone reading this email knocked on one door, we’d reach our goal of 25,000 new voter contacts! So go ahead—sign up to volunteer with us and help us make a big impact during this critical election.
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

Friend — I want to be upfront with you regarding something alarming happening right here in Florida.
On Election Day, control of the Senate and who we send to the White House won't be the only things on the ballot. In Florida, we'll vote on an amendment to enshrine the right to abortion into our state constitution — thereby _overturning Rick Scott's extreme abortion ban._
But here's the disturbing part: State police are showing up to Floridians' homes and interrogating them about their support of a petition that paved the way for this constitutional amendment ballot initiative.

**As a child, I lived under a South American dictatorship with my mother and three older sisters. I remember the strongman tactics of an authoritarian regime — and _Ron DeSantis is replicating those tactics here in Florida_.**
Nobody's political beliefs should be questioned by authorities. And let's call out DeSantis' playbook for what it is: State-sanctioned voter intimidation, all in the name of eviscerating reproductive freedom.
It's obvious why they are resorting to authoritarian tactics. DeSantis and my opponent Rick Scott — who supports a nationwide ban on abortions — know voter turnout is going to _skyrocket_ in support of protecting reproductive rights.

These are precisely the voters we need to reach, speak with, and mobilize in support of our campaign because we share their values of freedom, opportunity, and the right to start a family when and how they choose — not when and how politicians like Rick Scott or Ron DeSantis say.

**But to win, to protect reproductive rights and defeat Rick Scott, I must hit my critical $500,000 fundraising goal before midnight. That's why I'm counting on you, more than ever, to give now.**

Reaching the thousands of undecided voters, especially rural voters, who will determine the outcome of Wisconsin’s battleground Senate race represents our campaign’s single most significant expense.

Our campaign staff and volunteers have traveled hundreds of thousands of miles, reaching voters in every neighborhood across Wisconsin. However, gas money alone is proving exceedingly expensive.

Disclaimer from their most recent newsletter.****The Pro-RCV group appears to be the “Dark Money” they were so worried about, Arabella Advisors and 1630 Fund are about as “Dark Money” as “Dark Money” gets.**_**Their new Incorporation is their top donor.**__**Then "Article Four from Virginia"**__**Then "1630 Fund in Washington D.C."**_

This is who is funding the [#RankedChoiceVoting](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66fc70f6062c1e7a01d6c796&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fhashtag%2FRankedChoiceVoting%3Fsrc%3Dhashtag_click&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_66fb90095de6aa4c0980143b&l=en-US&s=QtTGCKiNnWzayJG90Eutrx3pkhA%3D) group in Alaska 1630 Fund Swiss billionaire whose personal goal is to “(re)interpret the American Constitution in the light of progressive politics” has donated hundreds of millions of dollars to a left-wing group that is dumping millions into state ballot initiatives, a new report from Americans for Public Trust (APT) revealed. Hansjörg Wyss, through his Berger Action Fund, has donated $243 million to the Sixteen Thirty Fund, which “uses its war chest ... to support massive get-out-the-vote drives, issue advocacy campaigns bolstering President Biden’s agenda, liberal pet projects from abortion to immigration, and attack ads against Republican lawmakers,”

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. | | Dear Freedom Fighters,

Today, my campaign released its [third](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6977da5288&e=a7ab36849c)[ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c63c0fd90f&e=a7ab36849c)[ad](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=4c3160ed12&e=a7ab36849c). As many of you know, I have been a long-time education advocate. I have been a champion for educational freedom, school choice, and transparency long before I was elected to the state legislature.

I attended district K-12 public schools. My own children attended Arizona's public schools from Kindergarten through college. I have served on a few of Arizona's public charter school boards.

In 2015, Governor Doug Ducey appointed me to serve on the state’s Early Childhood Education and Health Board. During the same time period, I served on the Arizona State Board of Education’s Academic Standards Development Committee.

I understand the importance of investing in our teachers and classrooms. In addition to voting to increase education funding every year, I have consistently voted to increase the expenditure limit, allowing schools to spend the funding increases.

T**he future prosperity of Arizona is at stake in November. Can you help us invest in our third ad by **[chipping in today](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=3137832f53&e=a7ab36849c)**?**

A strong economy is dependent on a qualified workforce and I will continue to support all schools in Arizona. Please join our brigade today.

Take care,
Shawnna

body:
My life changed in November 2022...

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f01924a4f88dc-fa049201-3a49-4161-80f0-cf9a80f01fc0-000000/JITyUUPrvGwb1VDlO5tMJWnCIvs=179)
---
Hello Peter,
---
| | | My name is Allie Phillips, and I am running for the Tennessee House of Representatives in District 75. As a working mother and a dedicated advocate for women's health, I am reaching out to ask for your support to bring change and protect reproductive rights in our state.

My life changed in November 2022. My husband Bryan and I were elated to be pregnant with our second child, and then at a routine appointment we got news that would devastate any parent. We learned that our baby had severe congenital issues that were incompatible with life. My life was also at risk. I’m a lifelong Tennessean and I learned that because of our state’s restrictive abortion ban, my own doctors couldn’t help me. I was forced to travel to New York City and go to the clinic alone to receive the necessary medical care that saved my life.
---
| |
---
| | [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_21_AlliePhillips/1/010f01924a4f88dc-fa049201-3a49-4161-80f0-cf9a80f01fc0-000000/3v9K6m1fLNDWNwei0t6iW7JERHs=179 "Donate")
---
This personal nightmare highlighted the critical need for change in Tennessee's approach to reproductive healthcare. **This is not just my story. It’s a harsh reality for many women across our state.** We cannot continue to allow politics to dictate healthcare decisions that should be between a woman and her doctor. That’s why I decided to run for office: to fight for comprehensive healthcare, including reproductive rights, so no other woman has to endure what I went through.

But I can't do it alone. One voice isn't enough. We need more Democrats in Nashville to fight Tennessee's barbaric assault on women's healthcare. That's why I'm supporting Our Tennessee Future, to get more Democrats in the legislature to fight for reproductive rights. Join me in supporting Our Tennessee Future today, because none of us can do it alone.

Running a campaign that challenges the status quo and fights for progressive values requires significant resources. That’s why I am asking for your financial support. Your contribution to Our Tennessee Future will help ensure that we reach more voters, get the message out across the state, and ultimately elect more Democrats dedicated to protecting reproductive rights and improving the lives of Tennessee families like ours.
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_21_AlliePhillips/2/010f01924a4f88dc-fa049201-3a49-4161-80f0-cf9a80f01fc0-000000/qnCMW7wHXJ6vZSxz5ay5tDD-2yE=179 "Donate")
---
**Please consider making a donation today.** Every dollar brings us one step closer to a Tennessee where every woman has access to the healthcare she needs.

Thank you for standing with me in this fight. Together, we will make a difference.
---
In solidarity,
Allie Phillips
Candidate for State House, District 75
---
| [Donate](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN_24_EM_21_AlliePhillips/3/010f01924a4f88dc-fa049201-3a49-4161-80f0-cf9a80f01fc0-000000/4Q-0pBidkBYvI7Ko5daQ385fTMM=179 "Donate")

_Our Tennessee Future PAC has been established as a proactive response to the political landscape in Tennessee, which has been taken over by MAGA ideologies. This PAC is dedicated to supporting state-elected officials who represent alternative, more progressive values contrary to those of the MAGA Republicans who currently dominate the state legislature. Key strategies include voter registration drives and targeted advertising campaigns, especially in districts where MAGA-aligned candidates are entrenched or pose a strong threat in upcoming elections. By mobilizing pro-Democratic voters and enhancing electoral participation, Our Tennessee Future PAC aims to effect substantial change and balance within Tennessee's political sphere, ensuring the state's policies and leadership accurately reflect the diverse perspectives of its residents. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

After conducting indiscriminate airstrikes in Beirut, flattening apartment
buildings, and killing hundreds of civilians in the deadliest day for
Lebanon since 2006, the Israeli military has now begun a ground invasion
of southern Lebanon.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/oppose-netanyahus-ground-invasion-lebanon/?source=em20241001-36037&t=1002&akid=36037%2E1203867%2EbxRVdM ]CNN International: Israel begins ground operation in southern Lebanon,
the IDF says

Israeli tanks are entering cities and villages while bombs are dropped on
residential communities. In less than a month, the Israeli military has
already killed at least 1,000 people in Lebanon. If Israel is allowed to
continue this invasion, thousands more will be killed.

Even Ronald Reagan withheld weapons to Israel when it invaded Lebanon in
the 1980s. This is the bare minimum the United States should do to prevent
another endless war — but so far, our government has continued to send
billions in weapons and bombs to the Israeli military.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/oppose-netanyahus-ground-invasion-lebanon/?source=em20241001-36037&t=1003&akid=36037%2E1203867%2EbxRVdM ]It’s past time for a ceasefire: the U.S. must stop enabling Netanyahu’s
unchecked aggression against Palestine and now Lebanon. We demand that
Congress and the Biden Administration oppose this invasion NOW: add your
name if you agree.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/oppose-netanyahus-ground-invasion-lebanon/?source=em20241001-36037&t=1004&akid=36037%2E1203867%2EbxRVdM ]Add Your Name

Months ago, President Biden said Israel invading Rafah was a red line, but
continued sending weapons and bombs that were used to kill tens of
thousands of civilians across Gaza and the West Bank. Now, Israel is about
to do the same thing to Lebanon.

It’s time for our leaders to firmly oppose Netanyahu’s invasion and stop
sending him blank checks to commit war crimes.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

body:
We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. | | |

|
---
If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=28af9f770a6242a38386cde86c26c92a&_e=o-F5x6-RzUStfsmoyFW4YShWxw8DmkxBJP9StEdJa92haLzKBMSoaB5r7kDPLZ6pIN1t4V2o76_Ka1r0rwu0Lck0qFC9VE3G0Q23ZFO13xCrQwRdDqc3EZC0ZUqcK4H86pdxmVJdYlBI4diFn-Aux8v8PPjf6N87K615zrl_ni4S54DDTEXnNXJbIY1pYfQDGqZP2qHdyaecx4ZPb5z61nuCMaWrZPq7USsboYp3RvI%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=28af9f770a6242a38386cde86c26c92a&_e=o-F5x6-RzUStfsmoyFW4YShWxw8DmkxBJP9StEdJa92haLzKBMSoaB5r7kDPLZ6pIN1t4V2o76_Ka1r0rwu0Lbm9hTnybm1QDvac856GH6Lob4VwnBIC3v-38heOBtHxHs8MZEzZzw_2enjXsx9YcOgaNwU7bxVgjMmCQyXRFVHSRVienyMNUSJYT4Osdobp4CYBNzFbG7Nyh32XYWqaHEPkBY0n_JqwF-j-V6cVnlQ%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

**2024 Senate Candidates**

Here’s the list of Senate candidates we are supporting this year — three incumbents and five challengers. ▶︎ Sen. Ted Cruz (TX) ▶︎ Sen. Rick Scott (FL)
▶︎ Sen. Josh Hawley (MO)
▶︎ Bernie Moreno (OH)
▶︎ Kari Lake (AZ)
▶︎ Sam Brown (NV)
▶︎ Tim Sheehy (MT)

[**Contribute to these candidates through SCF so they have the funds to fight for our principles and win!**](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=28af9f770a6242a38386cde86c26c92a&_e=o-F5x6-RzUStfsmoyFW4YShWxw8DmkxBJP9StEdJa92haLzKBMSoaB5r7kDPLZ6pIN1t4V2o76_Ka1r0rwu0LX2URc2LASI2ZE9OdeUNXPKuH_WX0BeJf8KmSg8b1T-h5bflY9SULQrOAsxlEjMbhtgX6OJ-ZT86dEnJAMlfwNzf4po4z0sbwcCzkt4ok4HnuhCo1ANJ2Kg3PKd7TeC0nBh3aqiuLIc3tjx-GA1D4yY%3D) The clock is ticking, so please take action today. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: Our Ad will be aired DURING THE DEBATE!
body:
Dear Peter,

“Election Day” is here!

No, it’s not Tuesday, November 5th.

But early voting is already underway as of today in the swing state of Pennsylvania.

Which means our window to make an impact before the election is over is closing fast!

I need to make sure our 2024 Election Year Programs are running at full steam – especially our canvassing program, which we’ve found is the most effective way to convert pro-abortion/on-the-fence voters into PRO-LIFE FIRST voters!

But in order to keep our canvassers knocking on doors through Election Day, I’ll need to count on the generosity of pro-lifers like you.

So, will you please make your most generous contribution possible to Students for Life Action right away to help me make sure pro-lifers come out on top in November
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/jmYqTryjjDoEeGq0mXcD1Q~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
?

Peter, Students for Life Action has an army of door-to-door canvassers – largely comprised of young college and high school students.

These young people put in long, hard days knocking on doors, educating voters, converting them into Pro-Life First voters, and sometimes are even attacked by pro-abortion radicals whom they encounter.

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/K-hcutZVAoKYMM3-Bf-rIw~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~

I’d like to introduce you to one of our volunteers – Michael Merchant.

Michael is currently a senior at the University of Missouri – St. Louis where he’s majoring in Computer Science.

Michael said he’s in the Pro-Life Movement because abortion hurt his family, and he told us he just couldn’t stand by silently as women are lied to every day about abortion being their only option.

But standing up for what’s right hasn’t always been easy for Michael. He told us:

“Few people know how painful it is to be pro-life and stand alone. Not a single person in my life was pro-life, including my parents, siblings, and friends. I was hesitant to bring it up my entire life. I searched for a pro-life community, and I found Students for Life! You have no idea how happy I was to find a group of pro-life friends like you all. You are my family now. This couldn’t have been more impactful for me.”

The truth is, we have so many young people just like Michael who are helping us knock on doors this fall.

Michael and others are only able to do the work they do because they know they have the support of good folks like you –
folks who will cover their travel costs, pay for new election materials, and even buy them lunch during a long day of door knocking
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/whZCYSk9Vgh4tES9oYjcyA~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
.

Will you consider helping Michael in any of these ways so he can continue making an impact
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_TO8zNJ9yMbYREAY1jXHJw~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
?

Peter, passionate young people like Michael, who take time out of their busy college schedule to work with Students for Life Action as canvassers are one of our secret weapons – especially with how successful they are!

You see, though the 2022 Midterms didn’t help the GOP much on Capitol Hill – mostly due to a lack of resources and weak-kneed Republicans running away from the abortion issue – it wasn’t all bad news.

Not only did we learn which Republicans we could trust to run on a Pro-Life Platform (and which were traitors whom we’d need to hammer in their next primary), and were honored to educate voters to see dozens of key victories that turned state legislatures more pro-life... but we also collected some incredible data.

In Battleground States, such as Ohio, we found that we could convert ONE pro-abortion/on-the-fence youth voter for just $12!

That means the only thing stopping the Pro-Life Movement from sweeping Battleground States isn’t a lack of manpower – as you know we have plenty of that.

It’s a lack of resources.

Canvassers like Michael can only make an impact if they can afford to go on deployments to Battleground States, have the materials they need to succeed, and are taken care of while on the road.

That’s where you come in, Peter –
even if it’s only $12, $24, $60, or $120 to covert ONE, TWO, FIVE, or TEN Pro-Life First Voters
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/cnzeEex-lntBz8ZtVhzR7Q~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
.

With a deal like that, I’m calling on YOU and other pro-lifers like you to chip into the fight right away
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Lw3rmWepUYBxGIVDSImRVA~~/AAVkMwA~_GZU3kAvUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~
!

Michael and our other canvassers are counting on you!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

**" Hundreds of longshoremen picket at Port of Houston as strike begins,"** Houston Chronicle's**Erica Grieder** -- "A row of ship-to-shore cranes towered silently over Trinity Bay Tuesday morning, as seagulls cawed, passing trucks honked and members of International Longshoremen's Association Local 24 chanted slogans and waved signs.

Several hundred dockworkers had hit the picket line at the Port of Houston's Bayport Container Terminal, gathering shortly after midnight. Similar actions were taking place at the Port of New York and New Jersey, the Port of Baltimore, and more than 30 other ports along the East and Gulf Coasts. The contract between the International Longshoremen's Association and the United States Maritime Alliance, a group of carriers, employers and port associations, had expired at 12:00 AM, Eastern Time, at which point the ILA went on strike for the first time since 1977.

Although the ILA had asked union members not to speak to media, it had issued a statement for distribution.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/79092b57-85d2-42b4-a9e1-6f47207612ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Due to corporate greed, employers refuse to compensate the ILA's members fairly," the statement said. "Over the last several years, the net revenues of these companies have grown astronomically from hundreds of millions to billions of dollar while the ILA members' wage increases do not even cover the cost of inflation."

Automation is, along with wages, the other key issue behind the strike. The ILA is seeking a ban on automated cranes, gates and container-moving trucks.

($5/mo or $50/yr or $199 lifetime) TOP NEWS " Hundreds of longshoremen picket at Port of Houston as strike begins," Houston Chronicle'sErica Grieder -- "A row of ship-to-shore cranes towered silently over Trinity Bay Tuesday morning, as seagulls cawed, passing trucks honked and members of International Longshoremen's Association Local 24 chanted slogans and waved signs. Several hundred dockworkers had hit the picket line at the Port of Houston's Bayport Container Terminal, gathering shortly after midnight. Similar actions were taking place at the Port of New York and New Jersey, the Port of Baltimore, and more than 30 other ports along the East and Gulf Coasts. The contract between the International Longshoremen's Association and the United States Maritime Alliance, a group of carriers, employers and port associations, had expired at 12:00 AM, Eastern Time, at which point the ILA went on strike for the first time since 1977. Although the ILA had asked union members not to speak to media, it had issued a statement for distribution. "Due to corporate greed, employers refuse to compensate the ILA's members fairly," the statement said. "Over the last several years, the net revenues of these companies have grown astronomically from hundreds of millions to billions of dollar while the ILA members' wage increases do not even cover the cost of inflation." Automation is, along with wages, the other key issue behind the strike. The ILA is seeking a ban on automated cranes, gates and container-moving trucks. "Employers push automation under the guise of safety, but it is really about cutting labor costs to increase their already exceptionally high profits," the statement said. The strike could cost the United States economy , according to experts, as well as disrupting the trucking industry, creating supply chain issues for manufacturers, and sending grocery prices back up even as progress has been made on inflation. The signs at the picket--"ILA workers over machines"; "Fight automation. Save jobs"--reiterated the union's points. Several perched on a vintage Chevy sedan. If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=1cbaf6bff52a499995a1e3bdb2aac8fe&_e=Bf19CSPvo9WMaiJnQl6HNzVp5E1859qqFhPpVoAMAqCDHQNGBgm2KWLUjNhSfpeoc9dYYaXI9_H7fBCU4efFUyHjSk4ALHNvX3z5bqTKJ9VpB-IhbHHhzou7wGT5hpXMLwicfQrgszYGucPsxdm97unLtRZFRHSq7T404RzTNWfT3Kq0BMpuEHSIMLIWvdcpcO0Ek467dmXWSRa7XIwY4IU9GzmqCr8BVhlH99YNAcA%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. Candidates have to pay outside vendors to help them find new donors across the country, and this service is quite expensive. **That means that when you get an email or text message from a candidate and click on the link to donate $100 to that candidate, the candidate will often get less than $20 after expenses.** This is why you should [**donate to candidates through SCF**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=1cbaf6bff52a499995a1e3bdb2aac8fe&_e=Bf19CSPvo9WMaiJnQl6HNzVp5E1859qqFhPpVoAMAqCDHQNGBgm2KWLUjNhSfpeoc9dYYaXI9_H7fBCU4efFUyDGc5zLXYOGsjpKlah_3MXnwFK3hc9nNvC9tvpf0wLAQECWriWSK8cS4b-Cn2a6rMN6cT0__dt7I3DcNEXP_kYkOVMDTeah8EHQC8Ay1HoOUPmxVVM03ly0nR2hAu8KDZ8jxtoUD4Z4DAXloDv7_6E%3D) whenever possible. It’s one of the only ways to guarantee that the candidate will get 100% of your contribution with no hidden fees or expenses. And if you like our work and want to help us do more to promote good candidates, you can also contribute to SCF, which is our general fund. This will help us mobilize other patriots like you to help elect strong conservative leaders.

| Statement from MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale on Tonight's Debate and the Impact of Border Policies
---
---
| "Tonight's debate serves as a reminder of the critical issues facing our nation, including the overwhelming impact of the Biden-Harris Administration's failed border policies. Here in Massachusetts, these failures have directly contributed to a migrant crisis that's costing our taxpayers over $1 billion a year.
The Healey-Driscoll Administration, by mirroring the Biden-Harris failed approach to the border, has only exacerbated the problem in the Commonwealth. Local governments are now forced to seek tax overrides to compensate for the state's mismanagement, diverting funds away from essential services to cover the costs of a federal immigration crisis.
Republicans offer a different path--one that prioritizes securing our borders, protecting our communities, and ensuring taxpayer dollars are used to benefit the people of Massachusetts, not to patch up the consequences of failed national policies.
Our nation deserves leadership that addresses these challenges head-on and brings meaningful solutions to the table."
###
